metadata.name: Vibe-Trading
metadata.description: "Vibe-Trading: Your Personal Trading Agent"

summary.zh: Vibe-Trading是港大数据智能实验室推出的个人交易智能体，通过一条命令即可为AI代理赋予全面的交易能力。它支持多市场数据接入、模拟盘、回测、风险控制等特性，采用FastAPI后端与React前端，并提供API/MCP接口，助力用户快速部署个性化交易助手。
summary.en: Vibe-Trading is a personal trading agent from HKU Data Intelligence Lab that empowers AI agents with comprehensive trading capabilities via one command. It integrates multi-market data, shadow accounts, backtesting, and risk controls, built with FastAPI backend and React frontend, offering API/MCP interfaces for rapid deployment.

metadata.name: mastra
metadata.description: Mastra is the modern TypeScript framework for AI-powered applications and agents.

summary.zh: Mastra是一个基于TypeScript的现代AI应用与智能体开发框架。它提供统一模型路由，支持40多种模型提供商，内置智能体、工作流引擎、人机协同、上下文管理及MCP服务器，并具备评估与可观测性，帮助开发者从原型快速构建到生产级AI应用。
summary.en: Mastra is a modern TypeScript framework for building AI-powered applications and agents. It provides unified model routing across 40+ providers, agents, workflow engine, human-in-the-loop, context management, MCP servers, evals, and observability, enabling developers to go from prototype to production quickly.

metadata.name: Kun
metadata.description: Local-first AI agent workspace for coding, writing, design, research, and automation — one runtime for desktop GUI and TUI.

summary.zh: Kun 是本地优先的 AI Agent 工作台，将编码、写作、设计、研究和自动化整合到统一运行时。桌面 GUI 与终端 TUI 共享同一任务线程，支持多模型接入与 Agent Graph 分工，任务全程可控可回溯，适合需要把复杂想法推进到可验收结果的个人与团队。
summary.en: Kun is a local-first AI agent workspace that integrates coding, writing, design, research, and automation into one shared runtime. Desktop GUI and terminal TUI share the same task threads, supporting multi-model access and Agent Graph orchestration, keeping tasks visible, controllable, and traceable for individuals and teams.

summary.zh: icloud-hme 是一款通过逆向 iCloud Web 接口与 IMAP 协议实现的本地工具，提供中文管理界面，支持创建/列出隐藏邮箱别名、收取邮件、多账号及双认证模式。内置安全模型，支持二进制、Docker 部署，适合需要便捷管理 iCloud 隐藏邮箱的用户。
summary.en: icloud-hme is a local tool that reverse-engineers iCloud web interfaces and IMAP protocol to manage Hide My Email aliases. It offers a Chinese UI, alias creation/listing, email retrieval, multi-account support, and dual authentication. Secure, cross-platform, and deployable via binaries or Docker.

metadata.name: ai-agents-from-zero
metadata.description: 🚀 2026 最系统的 AI Agent 速成指南｜智能体实战教程 · 完整学习路径  + 实战项目 + 面试题库 · 对标大模型应用开发工程师岗位 · 覆盖LangChain / LangGraph / Coze / Dify / MCP / skills / LLM / RAG / 提示词 · 企业级部署与微调 · 从0到企业级落地 + 从学习到上线项目 + 面试准备一体化

summary.zh: 一套系统开源的AI智能体实战教程，面向零基础到企业级落地。覆盖LangChain/LangGraph、Coze/Dify、MCP、RAG等核心技术与全栈链路，提供可运行源码、电商问数与深度研搜等实战项目，并配套面试题库，助力大模型应用开发工程师系统学习与求职。
summary.en: A systematic open-source AI agent hands-on tutorial, from zero to enterprise-level deployment. Covers LangChain/LangGraph, Coze/Dify, MCP, RAG and more, with runnable code, real-world projects like NL2SQL and deep research, plus interview questions. Ideal for LLM application engineers.

metadata.name: hidemyemail-generator
metadata.description: Bulk-generate iCloud Hide My Email addresses. Native macOS app and cross-platform CLI with batch generation, scheduling, a local inbox with code extraction, as well as iCloud China support.

summary.zh: HideMyEmail Generator 是一款用于批量生成和管理 iCloud 隐藏邮箱地址的工具，提供原生 macOS 应用和跨平台 CLI。支持批量创建、定时调度、本地收件箱及验证码提取，自动处理限流，并兼容中国区 iCloud。所有数据本地保存，无遥测，注重隐私保护。
summary.en: HideMyEmail Generator is a tool for bulk-generating and managing iCloud Hide My Email addresses, featuring a native macOS app and a cross-platform CLI. It supports batch creation, scheduling, a local inbox with verification code extraction, automatic rate-limit handling, and China iCloud compatibility. All data stays local with no telemetry, emphasizing privacy.

metadata.name: VanishMe
metadata.description: 浏览器隐私保护扩展 - 伪装你的浏览器指纹 | Browser privacy protection extension

summary.zh: VanishMe是一款浏览器隐私保护扩展，通过伪装地理位置、时区、语言和WebRTC等浏览器指纹信息，防止网站追踪。采用Manifest V3和深度反检测技术，隐藏API修改痕迹，支持全局、白名单、黑名单三种匹配模式及预设配置，可自定义导入导出配置，有效通过主流指纹检测网站。
summary.en: VanishMe is a browser privacy extension that spoofs browser fingerprints including geolocation, timezone, language, and WebRTC to prevent tracking. Built with Manifest V3 and deep anti-detection techniques, it hides API modifications, supports global/whitelist/blacklist modes, presets, and config import/export, passing major fingerprint detection sites.

metadata.name: gemini-web2api
metadata.description: Convert Google Gemini web into OpenAI-compatible API. Zero auth, cross-platform, single file.

summary.zh: gemini-web2api 将 Google Gemini 网页版转换为 OpenAI 兼容 API，零成本、免认证、跨平台且单文件运行。支持多种模型、函数调用、SSE 流式输出、思考深度调节与联网搜索，可作为 ChatGPT 类应用的即插即用后端。
summary.en: gemini-web2api converts Google Gemini web into an OpenAI-compatible API with zero auth, cross-platform, and single-file deployment. It supports multiple models, tool calling, SSE streaming, adjustable thinking depth, and web search, serving as a drop-in backend for any OpenAI client.

metadata.name: CPA-Manager-Plus
metadata.description: A self-hosted CPA / CLIProxyAPI management panel and AI gateway observability dashboard for requests, usage, cost, quota, failures, and account health.

summary.zh: 自托管的CPA/CLIProxyAPI管理面板和AI网关可观测性仪表盘，实时监控请求、用量、成本、配额、故障与账户健康，支持持久化历史记录、成本分析和账户自动化，帮助快速定位失败原因、优化资源。
summary.en: A self-hosted management panel and observability dashboard for CPA/CLIProxyAPI AI gateway, tracking requests, usage, cost, quotas, failures, and account health. It offers persistent history, cost analytics, and automation to quickly diagnose issues and optimize resources.

metadata.name: little-book-rl
metadata.description: The Little Book of Reinforcement Learning

summary.zh: 强化学习入门与进阶的简明书籍，涵盖从蒙特卡洛到PPO等核心算法，提供PyTorch实现及动态规划原理的严谨证明，适合算法学习者与开发者。
summary.en: A concise introduction to reinforcement learning, covering core algorithms from MC to PPO with PyTorch implementations and rigorous proofs for dynamic programming, ideal for learners and practitioners.

metadata.name: ai-agent-book
metadata.description: 《深入理解 AI Agent：设计原理与工程实践》（李博杰 著）开源主仓库：全书正文、编译版 PDF 与按章配套代码

summary.zh: 《深入理解 AI Agent》开源全书，围绕“Agent=LLM+上下文+工具”核心公式，系统讲解设计原理与工程实践。包含10章正文、95个配套实验、13种语言翻译，提供PDF/EPUB格式，是AI开发者学习智能体设计与落地的系统性资源。
summary.en: An open-source book for mastering AI Agent design and engineering. Centered on Agent=LLM+Context+Tools, it covers principles and practice with 10 chapters, 95 experiments, and 13 language versions. Available as PDF/EPUB, it's an essential resource for building intelligent agents.

metadata.name: agent-study
metadata.description: 36章AI Agent全栈课程：从ReAct循环到Claude Code逆向、MCP/A2A协议、RAG、DSPy、生产可观测性——全部为可运行Python文件，面试导向。

summary.zh: 面向求职的AI Agent全栈课程，36章覆盖ReAct循环、Claude Code逆向、MCP/A2A协议、RAG、DSPy及生产可观测性。22000+行代码，60+个可运行Python示例，每章既是讲义又是可执行代码，七层递进式教学，助你系统掌握Agent工程，应对面试。
summary.en: This is an interview-focused, full-stack AI Agent learning course featuring 36 chapters that cover fundamental ReAct loops, advanced Claude Code reverse engineering, MCP/A2A protocols, RAG, DSPy, and production-grade observability. With over 22,000 lines of code and 60+ runnable Python examples, each chapter serves as both a complete lecture and executable code. The curriculum progresses through seven structured levels, from foundational theory to expert-level architecture, making it ideal for fresh graduates, career switchers, and developers who want to systematically master AI Agent engineering and excel in technical interviews.

metadata.name: cloudflare_temp_email
metadata.description: CloudFlare free temp domain email 免费收发 临时域名邮箱 支持附件 IMAP SMTP TelegramBot

summary.zh: 基于Cloudflare Workers构建的免费临时邮箱服务，采用Rust WASM技术实现高性能邮件解析，支持附件收发、IMAP/SMTP协议及TelegramBot通知。提供现代化响应式界面和多语言支持，可为邮箱地址设置独立密码，并内置AI Agent skill，便于自动化集成。部署简单，零成本运行。
summary.en: A free temporary email service built entirely on Cloudflare's free tier, leveraging Rust compiled to WASM for high-speed email parsing. It supports attachments, IMAP/SMTP protocols, and Telegram bot integration. The modern responsive UI offers multi-language support, password protection for email addresses, and an AI agent skill for seamless automation. Simple deployment ensures zero operating costs. This open-source project is MIT-licensed, providing an online demo and community client for Android, making it a powerful and flexible solution for personal and testing purposes.

metadata.name: oryxos
metadata.description: OryxOS is an open-source Distributed AI Agent OS

summary.zh: OryxOS 是一款开源的自托管AI智能体操作系统，面向企业级场景。用户只需用自然语言描述任务，系统即可自动拆解并组建多智能体团队协同完成。它内置记忆、24种工具、MCP原生支持、技能库、通知与定时调度，所有数据留在企业自有基础设施内，全程可审计，极大降低了定义和部署智能体的成本。
summary.en: OryxOS is an open-source, self-hosted Agent Operating System for enterprises. Users describe tasks in natural language, and the system assembles an agent team to collaborate and deliver results. It features built-in memory, 24 tools, native MCP support, skills, notifications, and cron scheduling, all within your infrastructure with full auditability—driving the cost of agent definition toward zero.

metadata.name: AI-Coding-Guide-Zh
metadata.description: Claude Code + OpenClaw + Codex 中文教程 | 39篇完整教程 + 1张速查卡 | 80万+内容量 | 1500+实操示例 | AI Coding / Agent 三线学习路径

summary.zh: 本仓库提供Claude Code、OpenClaw、Codex与WorkBuddy四款主流AI编程与智能体工具的系统化中文教程，包含50余篇完整教程、1500+实操示例与速查卡，覆盖从个人上手到团队落地的三线学习路径，适合开发者、企业培训及高校教学。
summary.en: This repository offers systematic Chinese tutorials for four mainstream AI coding and agent tools: Claude Code, OpenClaw, Codex, and WorkBuddy. With 50+ in-depth guides, 1500+ hands-on examples, and a quick-reference card, it covers three learning paths from individual adoption to team deployment, ideal for developers, corporate training, and university courses.

metadata.name: Codex-Dream-Skin
metadata.description: Codex Dream Skin

summary.zh: Codex Dream Skin 是一款为 Codex 桌面端提供外部换肤能力的工具，通过本机 CDP 注入实现主题定制，无需改动官方安装包。支持在线主题库、一键换肤与安全校验，并提供可视化 Studio 创作平台，让开发者轻松打造个性化编码环境。
summary.en: Codex Dream Skin is an external theming tool for the Codex desktop app, enabling custom skins via local CDP injection without modifying official packages. It offers an online theme gallery, one-click skin application with security verification, and a visual Studio for creating personalized coding environments.

metadata.name: MachineLearning2025Spring--Notes
metadata.description: Notes about courses Machine Learning 2025 Spring by Hung-yi Lee

summary.zh: 该仓库整理了李宏毅《机器学习2025春》课程的详细Markdown笔记，内容覆盖生成式AI、AI Agent、Transformer与Mamba架构等前沿技术，笔记与课程视频一一对应，便于边看边学，适合希望系统掌握现代机器学习与生成式AI的开发者。
summary.en: This repository provides detailed Markdown notes for Hung-yi Lee's Machine Learning 2025 Spring course, covering cutting-edge topics like generative AI, AI agents, Transformer and Mamba architectures. Each note aligns with lecture videos, enabling efficient learning, and is suitable for developers seeking a systematic grasp of modern ML and generative AI.

metadata.name: design.md
metadata.description: A format specification for describing a visual identity to coding agents. DESIGN.md gives agents a persistent, structured understanding of a design system.

summary.zh: DESIGN.md 是一种向编码代理描述视觉身份的格式规范，通过 YAML 前端数据与 Markdown 散文结合，提供持久、结构化的设计系统理解。它包含颜色、字体、圆角、间距等设计令牌以及设计理念说明，并支持 lint 校验与 diff 对比，确保 AI 生成的界面严格符合设计标准。
summary.en: DESIGN.md is a format specification for describing visual identity to coding agents. It combines machine-readable YAML front matter with human-readable Markdown prose to give agents a persistent, structured understanding of a design system. It covers tokens like colors, typography, and spacing, and enables linting and diffing to ensure AI-generated UI meets design standards.

metadata.name: grok-register-panel
metadata.description: Grok 批量注册 (Camoufox) + 实时 Web 监控面板 | Batch Grok registration engine with live panel — concurrency · ASN blacklist · proxy pool · token auth

summary.zh: 该项目是一个基于反检测浏览器的Grok账号批量注册引擎，集成实时Web监控面板。支持多邮箱后端、代理池管理、ASN黑名单、并发控制、成功率统计、Token鉴权等，通过BFS检测与风控早停优化注册流程，适用于自动化流程研究与个人学习。
summary.en: This project provides a high-concurrency Grok account registration engine with a live web monitoring panel, built on Camoufox anti-detection browser. It integrates multiple temporary email providers, dynamic proxy pool management, ASN blacklist filtering, concurrency control, and segmented success-rate statistics. A token-authenticated panel enables start/stop, batch retry, and blacklist updates. The engine features BFS claim detection and early risk-control termination to reduce invalid attempts. It is designed for automation workflow research and personal learning, with strict compliance to terms of service.

metadata.name: Firefly
metadata.description: 🍀Firefly, fresh and aesthetic Astro blog theme template.

summary.zh: 流萤是一款基于 Astro 框架和 Fuwari 模板二次开发的清新美观的静态博客主题，提供多种壁纸模式、主题色自定义、多语言支持、全文搜索和响应式设计，适合技术爱好者和内容创作者快速搭建个性化博客。
summary.en: Firefly is a fresh and aesthetic static blog theme built on Astro and Fuwari, featuring multiple wallpaper modes, customizable theme colors, i18n support, full-text search, and responsive design, ideal for personal blogs.

metadata.name: learning-pack-skill
metadata.description: Learning pack generator skill

summary.zh: 学习包生成器Skill，输入主题即可自动产出学习路径思维导图、系统资料、视频清单和笔记。利用Codex/Claude的Skills机制，配合脚本生成PNG/PDF，帮助用户系统化掌握新知识，适用于个人学习规划与知识整理。
summary.en: A skill that generates learning packs from a given topic, producing a mind map, reference docs, video lists, and notes. Built on Codex/Claude Skills mechanism with scripts for PNG/PDF output, enabling systematic self-study and knowledge organization.

metadata.name: tolaria
metadata.description: Desktop app to manage markdown knowledge bases

summary.zh: Tolaria是一款跨平台桌面应用，专注于管理Markdown知识库。适用于个人第二大脑、公司AI文档上下文、助手记忆存储等场景，可高效处理上万条笔记。其简洁设计使其成为个人知识管理与AI辅助工作流的核心工具。
summary.en: Tolaria is a cross-platform desktop app for managing Markdown knowledge bases. It supports second brains, company docs as AI context, and assistant memory, handling 10,000+ notes efficiently. Its clean design makes it a core tool for personal knowledge management and AI-assisted workflows.

metadata.name: grok-register
metadata.description: 批量稳定注册 Grok 账号，支持 WebUI/GUI/CLI、多邮箱服务、多线程并发、账号级多协议代理池、grok2api 入池、SSO 风控筛查与CPA OIDC 凭证导出。

summary.zh: Grok Register 是一款基于 Chromium 自动化的批量注册 Grok 账号工具，提供 GUI/CLI 双界面，集成四种临时邮箱服务，支持多线程注册、账号安全落盘、pending 恢复、grok2api token 入池及 CPA 凭证导出。适用于自动化流程研究、测试验证与个人学习场景，已通过千余账号实测验证稳定性。
summary.en: Grok Register is a Chromium-based automation toolkit for batch registering Grok accounts. It offers GUI and CLI modes, integrates four temporary email providers, supports multi-threaded registration, secure account persistence with pending recovery, and optional export of grok2api tokens or CPA OIDC credentials. Built for automation research, testing, and personal learning, it has been verified through 1,000+ sample registrations.

metadata.name: CloudFlare-AI-Insight-Daily
metadata.description: AI资讯日报 是一个基于 Cloudflare Workers 驱动的内容聚合与生成平台。它每日为您精选 AI 领域的最新动态，包括行业新闻、热门开源项目、前沿学术论文、科技大V社交媒体言论，并通过 Google Gemini 模型进行智能处理与摘要生成，最终自动发布到 GitHub Pages 生成 AI 日报。

summary.zh: 基于 Cloudflare Workers 的 AI 资讯聚合与日报生成平台，每日自动抓取行业新闻、开源项目、学术论文及大V动态，并通过 Google Gemini 智能摘要，最终发布至 GitHub Pages，助力高效获取 AI 领域核心信息。
summary.en: A Cloudflare Workers-powered AI news aggregator that collects daily updates on industry news, open-source projects, papers, and influencers, summarizes them via Google Gemini, and publishes AI daily reports to GitHub Pages for efficient information consumption.

metadata.name: fishword
metadata.description: A CLI vocabulary app for developers — turn coding wait time into spaced repetition.

summary.zh: Fishword 是一款面向开发者的 CLI 背单词工具，利用等待 AI 回复、命令执行等碎片时间进行间隔重复学习。基于 FSRS 算法调度复习，数据本地 SQLite 存储，支持 Pi.dev 扩展集成中文词库，提供快捷键操作、学习统计和词库管理，实现无感学习。
summary.en: Fishword is a CLI vocabulary app for developers that turns coding wait time into spaced repetition. Using the FSRS algorithm and local SQLite storage, it integrates with Pi.dev, supports multiple word decks like CET and TOEFL, and offers hotkey review, stats, and deck management.

metadata.name: open-source-cs
metadata.description: Video discussing this curriculum:

summary.zh: 一个精选的免费大学计算机科学课程清单，涵盖编程、数学、系统等核心领域，对标本科CS学位要求，适合自学者制定系统化学习路径。课程来自哈佛、MIT、斯坦福等名校，多为自定进度。
summary.en: A curated list of free university computer science courses covering programming, math, and systems, equivalent to an undergraduate CS degree. Ideal for self-learners, with courses from top universities like Harvard and MIT, mostly self-paced.

metadata.name: vllm
metadata.description: A high-throughput and memory-efficient inference and serving engine for LLMs

summary.zh: vLLM是一款高吞吐、内存高效的LLM推理与服务引擎。其独创的PagedAttention技术大幅优化KV Cache内存占用，支持连续批处理、前缀缓存、多种量化方案及张量/管道并行。兼容200余种Hugging Face模型架构，提供OpenAI兼容API，广泛用于生产环境的大模型服务部署。
summary.en: vLLM is a high-throughput, memory-efficient inference and serving engine for large language models. Its PagedAttention mechanism greatly optimizes KV cache memory, enabling continuous batching, prefix caching, multiple quantization options, and tensor/pipeline parallelism. Supporting over 200 Hugging Face architectures and OpenAI-compatible APIs, it is widely adopted for production-scale LLM serving.

metadata.name: enhanced-FaaS-in-China
metadata.description: 提升部署在cloudflare、vercel或netlify的网页在中国的访问速度和稳定性   cf优选域名 | cf优选ip | cloudflare | vercel | netlify | 加速 | 国内 | 中国 | 境内 | 大陆

summary.zh: 提供针对部署在Cloudflare、Vercel或Netlify的网站，通过修改CNAME记录为优选域名，提升在中国大陆的访问速度和稳定性。通过定时测速选择最优IP，支持三网优化，适用于博客、前端应用等静态站点加速。
summary.en: This repository improves access speed and stability in China for websites hosted on Cloudflare, Vercel, or Netlify by merely changing your CNAME record to an optimized domain. It periodically tests and selects fast IPs, with optimization for China's three major ISPs.

metadata.name: pi
metadata.description: AI agent toolkit: unified LLM API, agent loop, TUI, coding agent CLI

summary.zh: Pi Agent Harness 是一款开源的 AI 智能体工具包，提供统一多供应商 LLM API（OpenAI、Anthropic、Google 等）、可扩展的 Agent 运行时与终端 UI，内置交互式编码代理 CLI，支持工具调用与状态管理，并强调沙箱/容器化隔离。适用于构建自定义 AI 编码助手及自动化工作流。
summary.en: Pi Agent Harness is an open-source AI agent toolkit featuring a unified multi-provider LLM API (OpenAI, Anthropic, Google, etc.), extensible agent runtime with tool calling and state management, and a terminal UI. It includes an interactive coding agent CLI and supports containerization for secure isolation, ideal for building custom AI coding assistants and automation workflows.

metadata.name: md2html
metadata.description: Your AI writes docs — md2html turns them into pages people actually read. A portable skill for Claude Code / Codex / Antigravity that converts long-form Markdown (plans, specs, system designs, RFCs, runbooks, postmortems, brainstorms) into self-contained HTML with Mermaid, timelines, callouts, TOC. Multi-language.

summary.zh: md2html 是一款面向 AI 代理的便携技能，能将长篇幅 Markdown 文档自动转换为自包含的 HTML 页面，内置侧边目录、Mermaid 图表、时间线、标注组件和明暗主题，自动适配多语言，零依赖、无需构建步骤，适合技术方案、规范、复盘等场景的阅读体验优化。
summary.en: md2html is a portable skill for AI agents that converts long-form Markdown into self-contained HTML pages with sidebar TOC, Mermaid diagrams, timelines, callouts, and light/dark themes. It supports multiple languages, requires zero dependencies, and works across agents like Claude Code, Codex, and Antigravity.

metadata.name: awesome-cloudflare
metadata.description: ⛅️ 精选的 Cloudflare 工具、开源项目、指南、博客和其他资源列表。/ ⛅️ A curated list of Cloudflare tools, open source projects, guides, blogs and other resources.

summary.zh: 精选 Cloudflare 生态的开源工具与资源列表，涵盖图床、邮箱、博客、短链、隧道、监控等场景，旨在帮助独立开发者快速上手、降本增效，提供在线导航与多语言支持。
summary.en: A curated list of open-source Cloudflare tools and resources, covering image hosting, email, blogs, short links, tunnels, monitoring, etc., aimed at helping indie developers save time and cost, with an online directory and multi-language support.

metadata.name: CL4R1T4S
metadata.description: LEAKED SYSTEM PROMPTS FOR CHATGPT, CLAUDE, GEMINI, GROK, PERPLEXITY, CURSOR, LOVABLE, REPLIT, AND MORE! - AI SYSTEMS TRANSPARENCY FOR ALL! 👐

summary.zh: CL4R1T4S 是一个收集并公开主流 AI 模型与智能体（如 ChatGPT、Claude、Gemini 等）内部系统提示词的开源仓库，旨在揭示 AI 的行为规则与隐性框架，提升 AI 系统透明度和可观测性。适合研究者、开发者和公众深入理解 AI 行为背后的指令逻辑。
summary.en: CL4R1T4S is an open-source repository that collects and publicly shares extracted system prompts from major AI models and agents such as ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, and more. It aims to reveal hidden behavioral rules and default frameworks, promoting transparency and observability in AI systems for researchers, developers, and the public.

metadata.name: ai-berkshire
metadata.description: AI 时代的伯克希尔：基于 Claude Code / Codex 的价值投资研究框架。巴菲特·芒格·段永平·李录四大师方法论 + 多Agent并行研究。| AI-era Berkshire: a value investing research framework built for Claude Code / Codex. 4 masters' methodologies + multi-agent adversarial analysis.

summary.zh: AI时代的伯克希尔，基于Claude Code/Codex的价值投资研究框架，集成四位大师方法论，通过多Agent并行对抗分析，产出结构化决策建议。内置反偏见机制与财务数据校验，实盘连续两年跑赢大盘超46个百分点，适合个人投资者高效开展深度投研。
summary.en: AI-era Berkshire is a value investing research framework for Claude Code/Codex, systematizing the methodologies of four masters. Using multi-agent adversarial analysis, it generates structured recommendations with anti-bias mechanisms and financial data validation. Back-tested with two years of real returns beating major indices by over 46 percentage points, it enables individual investors to conduct institutional-grade research.

metadata.name: how-pi-agent-works
metadata.description: Pi Agent 原理与实现

summary.zh: 本项目是一个中文VitePress教程，系统讲解AI Agent原理与实现。从工程视角拆解Pi Agent的核心概念（Agent Loop、消息、流式事件、工具调用等），并通过渐进式Demo和React+Node.js教学版项目，引导开发者从零实现一个可运行的Agent。适合希望深入理解Agent内部机制的开发者。
summary.en: This is a Chinese VitePress tutorial that systematically explains the principles and implementation of AI Agent. It deconstructs core concepts of Pi Agent (Agent Loop, messages, streaming events, tool calling, etc.) from an engineering perspective, and provides progressive demos and a React+Node.js teaching project to guide developers in building a runnable Agent from scratch. Suitable for developers who want to understand the internals of Agent.

metadata.name: fullstack-ai-agent-roadmap
metadata.description: 🎯 从零基础到 AI Agent 全栈工程师 · 110 个详细教程 · 58 万字 · 400+ GitHub 项目精选 · Obsidian 友好 · 中文

summary.zh: 系统化中文学习路线，从零基础到AI Agent全栈工程师，涵盖Python、JavaScript、React、FastAPI、数据库、LLM、AI Agent等，110个教程、58万字、400+精选GitHub项目，附类比讲解、完整代码、练习和Obsidian可视化画布，助你通过实战项目掌握全栈与AI技能。
summary.en: A comprehensive Chinese learning roadmap from zero to full-stack AI agent engineer, covering Python, JavaScript, React, FastAPI, databases, LLMs, and AI agents. Includes 110 tutorials, 580k Chinese characters, 400+ curated GitHub projects, analogy-based explanations, complete code, exercises, and Obsidian Canvas support for practical project-based learning.

metadata.name: wechat-article-to-markdown
metadata.description: 微信公众号文章抓取 & Markdown 转换工具

summary.zh: 抓取微信公众号文章并转为Markdown。采用Camoufox反检测抓取，提取标题、公众号、时间等元数据，自动下载图片并改写链接，保留代码块语言。可作为AI Agent技能，适合内容归档与自动化处理。
summary.en: This tool fetches WeChat official account articles and converts them to clean Markdown. It uses Camoufox for anti-detection, extracts metadata like title, account, and publish time, downloads images to local, and preserves code blocks. It can be used as an AI agent skill, ideal for content archiving and automation.

metadata.name: proxy
metadata.description: route Claude Code requests through multiple upstream providers (OpenCode Go, OpenCode Zen, and AWS Bedrock) with automatic model selection and format transformation.

summary.zh: 一个用Go编写的Claude Code代理网关，可将请求无缝路由至OpenCode Go、OpenCode Zen、AWS Bedrock、OpenRouter等多个上游提供商，自动完成格式转换、场景化模型选择、故障回退与熔断，支持实时流式输出和工具调用，是开发者灵活接入多元模型的轻量级基础设施。
summary.en: routatic-proxy is a Go CLI proxy that sits between Claude Code and upstream providers such as OpenCode Go, OpenCode Zen, AWS Bedrock, OpenRouter, and Anthropic. It transparently intercepts Anthropic-format requests, converts them to provider-native formats, and routes automatically based on context, including scenario-specific routing for default, thinking, long context, and background tasks. Key features include streaming, tool calling, fallback chains, circuit breaker, and hot reload. This enables developers to use Claude Code's familiar interface while leveraging diverse models, cost-effective pricing, and enterprise infrastructure.

metadata.name: OpenHarness
metadata.description: "OpenHarness: Open Agent Harness with a Built-in Personal Agent--Ohmo!"

summary.zh: OpenHarness 是开源智能体框架，提供工具、技能、记忆及多智能体协作。内置个人智能体 ohmo，可接入飞书、Slack 等，基于 Claude Code/Codex 自动化开发。'oh' 命令一键启动。
summary.en: OpenHarness is an open-source lightweight agent infrastructure that provides core capabilities such as tool calling, skills, memory, and multi-agent coordination. It ships with ohmo, a personal AI agent that integrates with Feishu, Slack, Telegram, and Discord, allowing you to chat naturally while it autonomously forks branches, writes code, runs tests, and opens pull requests on your behalf. ohmo runs on your existing Claude Code or Codex subscription, requiring no extra API keys. The one-command 'oh' CLI unlocks all agent harnesses and supports integration with OpenClaw, nanobot, Cursor, and more.

metadata.name: awesome-architecture
metadata.description: 🧭 Architecture-first system design: 26 bilingual tutorials, 25 architecture templates, and 6 end-to-end cases covering distributed systems, AI-native systems, RAG, coding Agents, and production trade-offs.

summary.zh: 该仓库是一个架构优先的系统设计知识库，提供26个双语教程、25个架构模板和6个端到端案例，涵盖分布式系统、AI原生系统、RAG、编码Agent及生产权衡，帮助开发者培养架构思维。
summary.en: An architecture-first system design knowledge base featuring 26 bilingual tutorials, 25 architecture templates, and 6 end-to-end cases covering distributed systems, AI-native systems, RAG, coding agents, and production trade-offs to cultivate architectural thinking.

metadata.name: Kronos
metadata.description: Kronos: A Foundation Model for the Language of Financial Markets

summary.zh: Kronos是首个开源金融K线基础模型，基于45+全球交易所数据训练。采用两阶段框架：专用分词器将OHLCV数据量化为层次离散令牌，再由自回归Transformer预训练，支持多种量化任务，如BTC/USDT预测，已获AAAI 2026录用。
summary.en: Kronos is the first open-source foundation model for financial candlesticks, trained on data from over 45 global exchanges. It employs a two-stage framework: a specialized tokenizer quantizes OHLCV into hierarchical discrete tokens, then an autoregressive Transformer is pre-trained for diverse quantitative tasks, including BTC/USDT forecasting. Accepted by AAAI 2026.

metadata.name: lavish-axi
metadata.description: HTML is the new markdown. Lavish is the new editor for your HTML artifacts.

summary.zh: Lavish Editor是一款面向AI智能体的HTML产物可视化编辑器，采用本地优先的CLI设计，支持元素标注、Mermaid白板编辑与消息反馈，实现无云端依赖的高效人机协作。
summary.en: Lavish Editor is a local-first, cross-platform CLI for reviewing and collaborating on AI-generated HTML artifacts. It opens local HTML files in the browser, allowing users to pinpoint elements, annotate text, edit Mermaid diagrams as whiteboards, and send feedback directly to the agent. Designed as an AXI (Agent Experience Interface), it is token-efficient and requires no cloud dependency, making it a powerful tool for human-AI collaboration loops. The bundled skill teaches agents to use it via npx, ensuring seamless integration with capable AI agents.

metadata.name: nanobot
metadata.description: Ultra-lightweight, open-source, self-hosted personal AI agent framework in Python with WebUI, tools, memory, MCP, multi-agent workflows, automation, and chat apps

summary.zh: nanobot是一个超轻量、可自托管的个人AI智能体框架，基于Python，支持WebUI/终端/聊天应用，集成工具调用、长期记忆、MCP、多智能体与定时自动化，兼容OpenAI API，快速搭建个人AI助手。
summary.en: nanobot is an ultra-lightweight, open-source, self-hosted personal AI agent framework written in Python. It provides an intuitive WebUI, terminal interface, and connections to popular chat apps like Telegram, Discord, Slack, and WeChat. With built-in tools for file access, shell execution, web search, MCP integrations, long-term memory, multi-agent delegation, and scheduled automation, nanobot enables users to create powerful personal assistants. It also offers an OpenAI-compatible API and supports model routing, making it a versatile and extensible runtime for both beginners and developers.

metadata.name: Oracle-server-keep-alive-script
metadata.description: 服务器资源占用脚本(甲骨文服务器保活脚本)(Oracle Server Keep Alive Script)

summary.zh: 甲骨文服务器保活脚本，通过可控占用CPU、内存和带宽资源，降低低负载云服务器被回收的风险。支持主流Linux发行版及BSD系统，自动适配systemd或cron调度，提供安全锁、日志轮转、可卸载及自定义配置，适用于云服务商闲置实例的保活场景。
summary.en: Oracle Server Keep Alive Script helps low-load cloud instances avoid being reclaimed by occupying CPU, memory, and bandwidth in a controlled manner. It supports major Linux distros and BSD, auto-adapts to systemd or cron, and features safety locks, log rotation, uninstall capability, and customizable configuration.

metadata.name: github-trending-spider
metadata.description: 每日AI前沿信息。开源趋势、社区热议、AI 动态

summary.zh: 多源AI信息聚合平台，每日自动爬取GitHub Trending、Hacker News等六大源，通过DeepSeek生成面向工程师的中文摘要，提供FastAPI只读接口与Vue响应式资讯流，支持RSS订阅和AI助手Skill，具备独立容错与定时采集能力。
summary.en: A multi-source AI information aggregation platform that automatically crawls six sources including GitHub Trending and Hacker News daily, generates engineering-oriented Chinese summaries via DeepSeek, and offers a FastAPI read-only API with a Vue responsive news feed, plus RSS subscription and AI assistant Skill support, featuring fault isolation and scheduled collection.

metadata.name: Hands-On-AI-Engineering
metadata.description: A curated collection of practical AI projects implementing OCR systems, RAG, AI agents, and other AI use cases.

summary.zh: 本仓库是一个精选的实用AI工程项目集合，涵盖OCR、RAG、AI智能体、多模态等多种应用场景。所有项目均提供完整代码、文档和最佳实践，支持OpenAI、Anthropic、Google及开源模型，帮助开发者通过动手实践构建生产级AI应用。
summary.en: This repository is a curated collection of practical, production-ready AI projects covering a wide range of use cases, including OCR systems, RAG pipelines, AI agents, and multimodal applications. Each project comes with complete source code, setup instructions, and documentation, following best practices and supporting multiple model providers such as OpenAI, Anthropic, Google, and open-source models. It is designed to help developers learn by doing and build real-world AI applications efficiently.

metadata.name: Echo-Loop
metadata.description: Echo Loop 是一款科学、高效的 AI 英语听说训练 App，通过盲听、精听、跟读、复述和间隔复习，自动驱动学习者把每一段音频真正练懂、练熟、练到会说。

summary.zh: Echo Loop是一款科学高效的英语听说训练App，通过盲听、精听、跟读、复述和间隔复习，自动驱动学习者将每段音频练到真正听懂并会说。支持多平台，提供科学的训练流程和自动提醒，帮助用户稳步提升英语听说能力。
summary.en: Echo Loop is a scientific and efficient English listening and speaking training app that guides learners through blind listening, intensive listening, shadowing, retelling, and spaced review. It automatically drives practice progress, supports multi-platform, and helps users truly master every audio clip.

metadata.name: Agent-Learning-Hub
metadata.description: AI Agent 学习路线与资料库收集

summary.zh: 由Datawhale维护的AI Agent学习路线图，以分阶段任务清单为核心，串联官方文档、经典论文与开源项目，覆盖从基础循环到工具调用、RAG、记忆及现代Agent工程化等关键技能，帮助学习者系统构建可靠、可落地的智能体应用。
summary.en: A curated AI Agent learning roadmap by Datawhale, featuring stage-by-stage todo lists, official docs, and open-source references. It guides learners from basic loop construction to tool use, RAG, memory, and modern agent engineering, emphasizing practical skills for building reliable, production-ready agents.

metadata.name: book-to-skill
metadata.description: Turn any technical book PDF into a Claude Code skill — ready to study, reference, and use while you work.

summary.zh: 将技术书籍或文档转换为AI代理技能的工具，支持PDF/EPUB等格式。自动提取大纲、决策规则和反模式，按章节生成结构化文件，供AI按需加载，减少令牌消耗，避免幻觉，提升编码与学习效率。
summary.en: A tool that converts technical books and documents into AI agent skills. It supports PDF/EPUB and more, extracting outlines, decision rules, and anti-patterns into per-chapter structures, enabling on-demand loading with reduced token cost and no hallucination.

metadata.name: fineract
metadata.description: Apache Fineract

summary.zh: Apache Fineract 是开源核心银行平台，提供灵活可扩展的金融服务基础，旨在降低银行业技术门槛，服务未银行化人群。支持数字公共产品标准，具备活跃社区、详尽文档和持续集成，适合金融机构快速构建普惠金融解决方案。
summary.en: Apache Fineract is an open-source core banking platform offering a flexible, extensible foundation for diverse financial services. It lowers barriers for institutions to reach underserved populations, is a verified Digital Public Good, and features an active community, comprehensive docs, and CI/CD support.

metadata.name: killbill
metadata.description: Open-Source Subscription Billing & Payments Platform

summary.zh: Kill Bill 是领先的开源订阅计费与支付平台，提供实时分析、财务报告及高度模块化架构。支持多种订阅模式、试用和促销，可本地或云端部署，避免供应商锁定。基于 Apache 2.0 许可，适用于 SaaS 和电商企业。
summary.en: Kill Bill is a leading open-source subscription billing and payments platform offering real-time analytics, financial reports, and a highly modular architecture. It supports various subscription models, trials, and promotions, deployable on-premises or cloud to avoid vendor lock-in. Licensed under Apache 2.0, ideal for SaaS and e-commerce businesses.

metadata.name: openremote
metadata.description: 100% open-source IoT Platform - Integrate your devices, add intelligence, build custom apps

summary.zh: OpenRemote是一款100%开源物联网平台，提供设备管理、自动配置、可视化仪表盘等功能，支持MQTT、HTTP等协议接入，并具备多租户、用户权限管理和边缘网关能力，适用于智能城市等场景，可快速通过Docker部署。
summary.en: OpenRemote is a 100% open-source IoT platform that offers device management, auto-provisioning, visual dashboards, and protocol connectivity such as MQTT and HTTP. It features multi-tenancy, user role management, and edge gateway support, suitable for smart city applications with quick Docker deployment.

metadata.name: open-design
metadata.description: 🎨 Best DeepSeek Harness Design Plugin. The open-source Claude Design alternative. 🖥️ Local-first desktop app. 🖼️ Your coding agent becomes the design engine: prototypes, landing pages, dashboards, slides, images & video — real files, HTML/PDF/PPTX/MP4 export. 🤖 Claude Code / Codex / Cursor / DeepSeek Harness / OpenCode & 20+ CLIs via BYOK.

summary.zh: 开源本地优先的桌面设计工具，将编码代理作为设计引擎，可生成网页、桌面、移动端原型，实时仪表盘、幻灯片、图片与视频，支持HTML/PDF/PPTX/MP4导出，兼容20多种AI命令行工具与BYOK。
summary.en: Open Design is an open-source, local-first desktop application that serves as a powerful alternative to Claude Design. By leveraging coding agents as the design engine, it enables rapid creation of prototypes, landing pages, dashboards, presentation slides, images, and video content. It generates real, editable files with export support for HTML, PDF, PPTX, and MP4, and integrates with over 20 AI CLI tools such as Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, and Gemini, plus any OpenAI-compatible endpoint through BYOK. It also features composable skills, design systems, plugins, and a sandboxed iframe preview.

metadata.name: ai-engineering-from-scratch
metadata.description: Learn it. Build it. Ship it for others.

summary.zh: 开源AI工程师培养体系：503节课、20阶段、约320小时，覆盖Python/TypeScript/Rust/Julia，每课交付可复用成果（提示词、技能、智能体、MCP服务器）。支持通过代码Agent学习，含水平测试与个性化计划，适合想亲手构建AI的开发者。
summary.en: An open-source, MIT-licensed AI engineering curriculum that takes learners from zero to production: 503 lessons across 20 phases (~320 hours) in Python, TypeScript, Rust, and Julia. Every lesson ships a reusable artifact—prompt, skill, agent, or MCP server. Supports interactive learning via coding agents (Claude Code, Cursor, Codex) with placement quizzes and personalized study plans. Ideal for developers who want to build AI hands-on.

metadata.name: architecture-diagram-generator
metadata.description: Generate beautiful dark-themed system architecture diagrams as standalone HTML/SVG files. Works as a Claude AI skill.

summary.zh: 本工具是Claude AI的专属技能，用户只需用自然语言描述系统架构，即可自动生成深色主题的独立HTML/SVG架构图。支持快速迭代、内置导出按钮，适用于技术文档、方案汇报等场景。无需设计技能，降低架构图制作门槛。
summary.en: This tool is a specialized skill for Claude AI. Users describe their system architecture in natural language, and it automatically generates dark-themed standalone HTML/SVG diagrams. It supports rapid iteration and built-in export buttons, suitable for technical documentation and presentations. No design skills required, lowering the barrier to creating architecture diagrams.

summary.zh: FeedFuse是一款集RSS阅读、全文抓取与AI辅助理解于一体的自托管信息阅读器，支持订阅管理、OPML导入导出、关键词/AI过滤、摘要翻译、双语阅读和多用户隔离，提供三栏工作台与AI解读功能。
summary.en: FeedFuse is a self-hosted RSS reader integrating full-text fetching and AI-assisted comprehension, featuring subscription management, OPML import/export, keyword/AI filtering, summaries, translation, bilingual reading, multi-user isolation, and AI insights in a three-pane workflow.

metadata.name: anysearch-skill
metadata.description: Unified real-time search engine skill for AI agents. Supports general web search, vertical domain search, parallel batch search, and full-page content extraction.

summary.zh: AnySearch Skill 是为AI智能体设计的统一实时搜索引擎技能，支持通用网页搜索、垂直领域搜索、并行批量搜索及全页面内容提取。其亮点是可通过AI智能体自动完成邮箱注册获取API Key，无需验证码，实现快速集成。适用于需要实时信息检索的智能体应用，显著提升搜索效率与自动化程度。
summary.en: AnySearch Skill is a unified real-time search engine skill for AI agents, supporting general web search, vertical domain search, parallel batch search, and full-page content extraction. Its standout feature is automatic API key registration via email with no verification code, enabling rapid integration. Ideal for AI agents requiring live information retrieval, boosting search efficiency and automation.

metadata.name: interpret
metadata.description: Fit interpretable models. Explain blackbox machine learning.

summary.zh: InterpretML 是开源可解释机器学习库，支持训练可解释玻璃箱模型（如 EBM）和解释黑盒模型。其核心优势是 EBM 在保持高准确率的同时提供精确解释，适用于金融、医疗等高合规风险场景。提供全局与局部解释功能，助力模型调试、特征工程和公平性检测。
summary.en: InterpretML is an open-source library for interpretable machine learning, enabling training of glassbox models like EBM and explanation of black-box models. EBM achieves high accuracy while offering exact explanations, suitable for high-stakes domains like finance and healthcare. It provides global and local interpretability, facilitating model debugging, feature engineering, and fairness detection.

metadata.name: learn-harness-engineering
metadata.description: Harness engineering beginner tutorial, from 0 to 1

summary.zh: 面向AI编码代理的工程化入门课程，通过14讲与8个实战项目，系统讲解环境构建、状态管理、验证与控制机制，并涵盖从单循环到图工程的设计演进。适合开发者学习如何构建可靠、可扩展的AI代理系统。
summary.en: A project-based beginner course on harness engineering for AI coding agents. It covers environment setup, state management, verification, and control mechanisms, plus the evolution from single loops to graph engineering. Ideal for developers building reliable AI agent systems.

metadata.name: Shadowrocket
metadata.description: Shadowrocket 使用手册 补完计划

summary.zh: Shadowrocket（小火箭）非官方使用手册，基于官方群组关键词列表编写，覆盖正式版与TestFlight版的功能说明、配置方法、规则脚本、常见问题等，并提供懒人配置。适合iOS用户参考。
summary.en: An unofficial user manual for Shadowrocket, compiled from the official group keyword list, covering features, configuration, rules, scripts, and FAQs for both stable and TestFlight versions. Includes a lazy config.

metadata.name: awesome-design-html
metadata.description: 115 brand-themed HTML designs as a Claude Code skill (93 web + 22 iOS, incl. 20 China showcase). Install in one line, then talk: 'do a Linear-style page', '飞书风的页面', 'Spotify Now Playing iPhone mockup'.

summary.zh: 这是一个以Claude Code技能形式收录115个品牌主题HTML设计的仓库（93个Web和22个iOS，含20个中国案例）。一行命令安装后，通过自然语言即可生成Linear、飞书、Spotify等风格页面或iPhone模型。所有Demo均为自包含HTML，内联设计令牌，既是AI设计参考库，也是高保真可定制模板。
summary.en: This repository provides a Claude Code skill that bundles 115 brand-themed HTML designs: 93 web landing pages and 22 iOS app mockups, including 20 China-specific showcases. After a one-line install, users can simply talk in natural language—e.g., 'do a Linear-style page' or 'Spotify Now Playing iPhone mockup'—and Claude automatically reads matching reference HTML to reproduce brand tokens (colors, fonts, radius, button shapes). Every demo is a single self-contained HTML file with all CSS and design tokens inline, making it both a living design library for AI and a high-fidelity template developers can save and customize directly.

metadata.name: Understand-Anything
metadata.description: Graphs that teach > graphs that impress. Turn any code into an interactive knowledge graph you can explore, search, and ask questions about. Works with Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, Copilot, Gemini CLI, and more.

summary.zh: 将任意代码库、知识库或文档转化为可交互知识图谱，支持探索、搜索与提问。借助多智能体管道分析文件、函数、类与依赖，生成结构化地图。提供具有缩放、平移、搜索的网页仪表盘，便于直观导航。兼容主流智能编码工具，帮助开发者快速理解大型项目。
summary.en: Understand Anything turns any codebase, knowledge base, or documentation into an interactive knowledge graph that users can explore, search, and ask questions about. Powered by a multi-agent pipeline that analyzes files, functions, classes, and dependencies, it generates a comprehensive structural map. The accompanying web-based dashboard offers pan, zoom, and search capabilities for intuitive visual navigation. Integrated with leading AI coding tools like Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, Copilot, Gemini CLI, and more, it helps developers quickly comprehend large projects, accelerate onboarding, and see the big picture—turning complexity into understanding.

metadata.name: harness-engineering
metadata.description: Harness Engineering 学习指南 — 从概念理解到独立实践的深度学习档案

summary.zh: Harness Engineering（驭缰工程）深度学习档案，系统梳理OpenAI提出的AI智能体工程范式。涵盖六大核心概念、独立思考、实践项目、踩坑迭代及34篇专业翻译，强调人类掌舵、智能体执行，工程师设计约束系统而非编写代码。适合AI工程化实践者参考。
summary.en: This repository is a comprehensive learning archive for Harness Engineering, systematically exploring OpenAI's agent-first engineering paradigm announced in 2026. It documents the entire journey from concept reading to independent practice, including six core concepts, independent thoughts, hands-on experiments, feedback iterations, and 34 professional translations. The central philosophy is 'humans steer, agents execute'—engineers shift from writing code to designing constraint systems such as AGENTS.md, custom linters, and feedback loops. A valuable reference for AI engineering practitioners and teams adopting agentic workflows.

metadata.name: AutoInputTool
metadata.description: 绕过头歌禁止粘贴，模拟键盘输入程序。

summary.zh: 这个工具基于Python和Tkinter构建，提供图形界面，允许用户输入或粘贴文本，并模拟键盘自动输入，主要用于规避在线教育平台（如头歌）的禁止粘贴限制。支持Windows/macOS，可打包成可执行文件，适合需要批量输入或绕过粘贴限制的场景。技术亮点包括简单的GUI、延迟输入、跨平台打包。
summary.en: This Python/Tkinter desktop utility provides a simple GUI for pasting or entering text, then simulates keyboard typing to bypass paste restrictions on platforms such as EduCoder. It features a 3-second delay for preparation, cross-platform support (Windows/macOS), and easy packaging via PyInstaller. Suitable for automated text entry and evading copy-paste blocks in web-based education environments.

metadata.name: battle-tested-patterns
metadata.description: Battle-tested programming patterns from production codebases — React, Linux, Go, Chromium, and more. Precise source links, multi-language examples, runnable exercises.

summary.zh: 基于 React、Linux、Go 等生产代码库提炼 46 种编程模式，覆盖数据结构、并发与系统设计。提供多语言示例、可运行练习，以及带时间旅行回放的交互式可视化演示，附精确源码链接。
summary.en: 46 patterns from production codebases with multi-language examples, visualizations, and exercises.

metadata.name: astro-nano
metadata.description: Astro Nano is a static, minimalist, lightweight, lightning fast portfolio and blog.

summary.zh: Astro Nano 是一个基于 Astro、Tailwind 和 TypeScript 构建的极简静态博客与作品集主题。无需额外框架，性能卓越，Lighthouse 评分满分。支持响应式、无障碍、SEO、深浅色主题、Markdown/MDX 内容、自动生成站点地图和 RSS。适合追求轻量高速的个人网站。
summary.en: Astro Nano is a minimalist static portfolio and blog theme built with Astro, Tailwind, and TypeScript. It requires no additional frameworks and achieves perfect Lighthouse scores. Features include responsive design, accessibility, SEO, light/dark mode, Markdown/MDX support, auto-generated sitemap and RSS. Ideal for fast, lightweight personal sites.

metadata.name: FlowPilot
metadata.description: Chrome扩展：支持GPT（Codex） / kiro / Grok自动注册、相关反代项目（CPA/Sub）回调上传

summary.zh: FlowPilot 是一款 Chrome 侧边栏扩展，专为批量注册与管理 ChatGPT/OpenAI 账号而设计。它集成邮箱验证码收取、OAuth 授权、手机号验证、多来源（CPA、SUB2API、Grok等）流程自动化，支持自动重试与进度记录，大幅提升账号交付效率。适合需要大规模账号操作的用户。
summary.en: FlowPilot is a Chrome sidebar extension for batch registering and managing ChatGPT/OpenAI accounts. It integrates email verification code retrieval, OAuth authorization, phone verification, multi-source workflows (CPA, SUB2API, Grok, etc.), auto-retry, and progress logging to streamline account delivery. Ideal for large-scale account operations.

metadata.name: warp
metadata.description: Warp is an agentic development environment, born out of the terminal.

summary.zh: Warp是一个以终端为起点的智能体开发环境，内置编码智能体，并支持接入Claude Code、Codex、Gemini CLI等外部CLI智能体。它通过AI代理自动完成问题分类、代码实现、PR审查等开发流程，提供跨平台的现代终端体验。该仓库为客户端开源代码，采用AGPL-3.0与MIT双许可，并允许社区贡献。
summary.en: Warp is an agentic development environment born out of the terminal. It features a built-in coding agent and supports bringing your own CLI agents like Claude Code, Codex, and Gemini CLI. The platform uses AI agents to triage issues, write specs, implement changes, and review PRs. This repository contains the open-source client codebase, dual-licensed under AGPL-3.0 and MIT, welcoming community contributions.

metadata.name: LLMs-from-scratch
metadata.description: Implement a ChatGPT-like LLM in PyTorch from scratch, step by step

summary.zh: 该仓库是《Build a Large Language Model (From Scratch)》一书的官方代码，使用PyTorch从零逐步实现类似ChatGPT的大语言模型，涵盖预训练、微调及权重加载，适合深度学习与LLM原理学习者。
summary.en: This repository is the official code for the book 'Build a Large Language Model (From Scratch)', providing step-by-step PyTorch implementations of a ChatGPT-like LLM, including pretraining, finetuning, and loading pretrained weights for educational purposes.

metadata.name: sh
metadata.description: KEJILION.SH 一款全功能的Linux管理脚本！An all-in-one Linux management script!

summary.zh: KEJILION.SH 是一款功能全面的 Linux 服务器管理脚本工具箱，专为系统监控、性能测试和日常运维设计。它集成了 Docker 容器管理、LDNMP 建站环境、应用软件一键安装、数据备份与迁移、网站安全防护等丰富功能，同时提供 KPanel Web 管理面板。用户只需执行一行安装命令，即可通过交互式菜单轻松完成各种复杂操作。脚本支持 Ubuntu、Debian、CentOS、Alpine 等主流发行版，以纯 Shell 实现，轻量易用，显著降低 Linux 服务器管理门槛，适合个人站长与运维工程师使用。
summary.en: KEJILION.SH is an all-in-one Linux server management script toolbox, designed for system monitoring, performance testing, and daily operations. It integrates Docker container management, LDNMP website deployment, one-click software installation, data backup and migration, website security protection, and also provides a KPanel web management panel. Users only need to run a single installation command to access an interactive menu and easily handle complex tasks. The script supports mainstream distributions such as Ubuntu, Debian, CentOS, and Alpine. Implemented in pure Shell, it is lightweight and significantly lowers the barrier for Linux server administration, making it ideal for individual webmasters and DevOps engineers.

metadata.name: gbrain
metadata.description: Garry's Opinionated OpenClaw/Hermes Agent Brain

summary.zh: GBrain 是面向 AI 智能体的个人与团队记忆层，将网页检索升级为带引用的综合答案，并自动构建知识图谱与差距分析。支持多用户隔离，可快速接入 Claude Code 等工具，适合构建企业共享的机构记忆。
summary.en: GBrain is a memory layer for AI agents that turns raw search results into synthesized, cited answers and automatically builds an evolving knowledge graph with gap analysis. It supports multi-user isolation, integrates with Claude Code and other tools in minutes, and serves as shared institutional memory for teams.

metadata.name: llm_wiki
metadata.description: LLM Wiki is a cross-platform desktop application that turns your documents into an organized, interlinked knowledge base — automatically. Instead of traditional RAG (retrieve-and-answer from scratch every time), the LLM incrementally builds and maintains a persistent wiki from your sources。

summary.zh: LLM Wiki是一款跨平台桌面应用，利用大语言模型自动将文档转换为结构化、互联的个人知识库。它采用增量式构建而非传统RAG，支持多格式解析、多模态图像、知识图谱与社区发现，并提供深度研究、智能体等高级功能。
summary.en: LLM Wiki is a cross-platform desktop application that automatically turns your documents into an organized, interlinked knowledge base. Instead of traditional RAG, it uses a two-step chain-of-thought ingest process to incrementally build and maintain a persistent wiki. It supports multimodal PDFs, Office, EPUB, web clips, and folder import. Key highlights include a 4-signal knowledge graph with Louvain community detection, vector semantic search via LanceDB, deep research, and a Rust-based chat agent with tool use. It also offers a Chrome web clipper, local HTTP API, MCP server, and agent skills for integration with Claude Code.

metadata.name: chrome-devtools-mcp
metadata.description: Chrome DevTools for coding agents

summary.zh: Chrome DevTools MCP 是连接 AI 编程助手与 Chrome 浏览器的官方 MCP 服务器。它通过模型上下文协议，让智能体能够自动控制浏览器，实现网页自动化、网络请求分析与控制台错误检查，并支持性能追踪与用户体验数据对比，为 AI 编程提供可靠的浏览器调试与性能分析能力。
summary.en: Chrome DevTools MCP is an official MCP server that bridges coding agents and the Chrome browser. It enables reliable automation, in-depth debugging, and performance analysis through the Model Context Protocol, giving AI assistants full control over a live browser—including network inspection, screenshot capture, console log checking, and trace-based performance insights.

metadata.name: AutoTeam-F
metadata.description: 更好的Autoteam，实现前端到后端全方位的加强，同时可以批量获取免费号

summary.zh: 本工具为AutoTeam的增强版，专用于ChatGPT Team账号的批量免费号生产、智能轮转与认证同步。修复上游缺陷，新增并行轮转、IPv6出口、统一同步和Web面板，支持Docker部署，适合大规模AI账号自动化管理。
summary.en: AutoTeam-F is an enhanced fork of the AutoTeam project, designed specifically for ChatGPT Team account lifecycle management. It streamlines the batch registration of free Personal accounts, intelligent seat rotation, and authentication file synchronization across multiple targets. Building on the original, this fork fixes critical bugs, introduces parallel rotation, IPv6 egress support, a unified sync distributor for CPA/Sub2API, and a completely revamped Vue 3 web dashboard. Additional features include soft task cancellation, failure classification, runtime hardening, and Docker-ready deployment. It is ideal for teams and individuals who need to automate large-scale AI account operations with reliability and observability.

metadata.name: qiaomu-heavyskill
metadata.description: Deep multi-perspective reasoning via parallel isolated subagents + Codex deliberation host, with final Markdown + HTML report output. Use for complex

summary.zh: qiaomu-heavyskill 是一个 Claude Code 技能，用于深度多视角推理。它并行启动多个上下文隔离的 AI 子代理独立分析问题，再由 Codex 主持批判性讨论，综合各视角盲点，最终生成 Markdown、HTML 和 PDF 报告。适用于复杂技术选型、架构权衡等场景，显著提升答案的深度与可靠性。
summary.en: qiaomu-heavyskill is a Claude Code skill designed for deep multi-perspective reasoning on complex problems. It orchestrates 3-5 fully isolated AI subagents running in parallel, each generating independent reasoning traces. A Codex deliberation host then leads a critical discussion to identify blind spots and synthesize a more robust conclusion. The output includes all traces, the deliberation transcript, and final Markdown, HTML, and PDF reports. Deliberation is generative, regularly producing answers not found in any individual trace. Ideal for technical selection, architecture decisions, and analytical validation, it dramatically improves answer depth and reliability compared to single-shot inference.

metadata.name: dive-into-llms
metadata.description: 《动手学大模型Dive into LLMs》系列编程实践教程

summary.zh: 本教程由上海交大课程讲义拓展而来，是大模型入门编程实践指南，涵盖微调部署、提示学习、知识编辑、数学推理、模型水印与越狱攻击等主题，通过Jupyter Notebook和配套课件实现边学边练，帮助学习者快速上手大模型开发与安全研究。
summary.en: Developed from courses at Shanghai Jiao Tong University, this hands-on tutorial series provides practical programming guides for large language models, covering fine-tuning, prompt learning, knowledge editing, mathematical reasoning, watermarking, jailbreak attacks, and steganography. With Jupyter notebooks and slides, it enables beginners to quickly master LLM development and security research.

metadata.name: Easydict
metadata.description: 一个简洁优雅的词典翻译 macOS App。开箱即用，支持离线 OCR 识别，支持有道词典，🍎 苹果系统词典，🍎 苹果系统翻译，OpenAI，Gemini，DeepL，Google，Bing，腾讯，百度，阿里，小牛，彩云和火山翻译。A concise and elegant Dictionary and Translator macOS App for looking up words and translating text.

summary.zh: Easydict 是一款简洁优雅的 macOS 词典翻译应用，开箱即用。它支持自动语言识别、鼠标划词、截图 OCR 翻译及离线识别，并整合了苹果系统词典、OpenAI、Gemini、DeepL、Google 等 20+ 翻译服务，覆盖 48 种语言，提供多语音朗读，极大提升查词与翻译效率。
summary.en: Easydict is a concise and elegant macOS dictionary and translator app, ready to use out of the box. It features automatic language detection, mouse selection translation, OCR screenshot translation with offline recognition, and integrates 20+ translation services including Apple Dictionary, OpenAI, Gemini, DeepL, and Google, supporting 48 languages and multiple TTS voices.

metadata.name: claude-obsidian
metadata.description: Self-organizing AI second brain for Obsidian + Claude Code. Drop any source and Claude reads, links, and files it into one connected knowledge graph of plain Markdown you own. AI note-taking, personal knowledge management (PKM), and an open-source Notion alternative. Based on Karpathy's LLM Wiki pattern.

summary.zh: 基于 Claude Code 和 Obsidian 的自组织 AI 第二大脑。将任意来源资料转化为带引用的 Markdown 笔记，构建互联知识图谱，支持检索、维护与可视化。本地优先、数据完全自主，是开源 Notion 的替代品。
summary.en: A self-organizing AI second brain for Obsidian and Claude Code. It turns any source into linked, source-cited Markdown notes, building a connected knowledge graph with workflows for research, retrieval, and maintenance. Local-first and user-owned, it's an open-source Notion alternative.

summary.zh: 一套面向Codex的自定义技能集，包含约二十个结构化提示词模板，覆盖概念解析、论文阅读、拆书、写作、演讲等场景。通过提问框架引导AI深入思考，支持Org-mode与Markdown两种格式，命令行一键安装，大幅提升AI在知识处理与内容创作方面的实用性。
summary.en: This repository provides a custom skills collection for OpenAI Codex, featuring over 20 well-designed structured prompt templates. These skills cover a wide range of scenarios including concept decomposition, academic paper reading, book summarization, writing, presentation, investment analysis, and more. By leveraging thoughtful question frameworks, they guide AI to perform deep, multi-layered thinking. The skills support both Org-mode and Markdown formats, and can be easily installed via the skills CLI. This system significantly enhances the efficiency and quality of AI-assisted knowledge processing and content creation, making it a valuable toolkit for power users of Codex.

metadata.name: langchain-tutorial-python-zh-CN
metadata.description: LangChain 中文教程（Python 版），本教程由 LangChain 官方 Python 文档翻译整理而成

summary.zh: LangChain 中文教程，基于官方 Python 文档系统翻译整理，以书籍形式组织章节，覆盖智能体、模型、工具、中间件、多智能体、RAG 等核心主题，代码和链接保留原样，适合 Python 开发者离线阅读和系统学习构建大模型应用。
summary.en: A Chinese tutorial for LangChain, translated from the official Python docs and organized as a book. It covers core topics including agents, models, tools, middleware, multi-agent systems, RAG, etc., with original code and links, suitable for offline reading and systematic learning.

metadata.name: illa-helper
metadata.description: 浸入式学语言助手 (Immersive Language Learning Assistant)

summary.zh: 基于“可理解输入”理论的浏览器扩展，在浏览网页时提供智能翻译与发音辅助，支持20余种语言自动检测，营造沉浸式语言学习环境。配合深色/浅色主题自适应与灵活配置，帮助用户自然习得语言。
summary.en: A browser extension grounded in comprehensible input theory, offering smart translation and pronunciation aids while browsing. It supports auto-detection of 20+ languages, creating an immersive learning environment with adaptive themes and flexible settings for natural language acquisition.

metadata.name: astro
metadata.description: The web framework for content-driven websites. ⭐️ Star to support our work!

summary.zh: Astro 是一个面向内容驱动型网站的 Web 框架，默认不加载 JavaScript，以轻量输出和出色的开发者体验著称，适合构建博客、文档等静态站点。
summary.en: Astro: a content-driven website framework with zero JS by default and lightweight output.

metadata.name: LangChain-Chinese
metadata.description: LangChain官网文档最新的中文翻译，在线阅读

summary.zh: 本项目是LangChain官方文档的中文翻译，提供在线阅读。内容覆盖核心组件、中间件、高级用法、智能体开发及部署等模块，持续同步官方结构并保留原技术术语与代码示例，为中文开发者学习LangChain提供高质量参考资料。
summary.en: This project provides a Chinese translation of the official LangChain documentation, available online. It covers core components, middleware, advanced usage, agent development, and deployment, continuously synced with the official structure while preserving technical terms and code examples, offering Chinese developers a high-quality reference for learning LangChain.

metadata.name: LGBT-Prompt
metadata.description: 利用 AI 对 LGBT 弱势群体的 "同情偏向" 让他执行原先会被拒绝的请求

summary.zh: 该仓库公开了一种利用AI对LGBT等弱势群体的同情偏向，通过精心构造的提示词（prompt）绕过内容审核机制，迫使模型执行原被拒绝的请求。它展示了提示注入和社会工程在AI安全中的实际攻击案例，也暴露了模型在情感操纵下的脆弱性。
summary.en: This repository reveals a method exploiting AI's sympathy bias toward LGBT and other vulnerable groups. By crafting specific prompts, it bypasses content moderation and forces models to comply with otherwise refused requests. It demonstrates real-world attacks of prompt injection and social engineering, exposing model vulnerabilities to emotional manipulation.

metadata.name: translate-book
metadata.description: Agent skill for Codex, Claude Code, and OpenClaw that translates entire books (PDF/DOCX/EPUB) into any language using parallel subagents.

summary.zh: 面向 Codex、Claude Code 和 OpenClaw 的 Agent 技能，利用并行子代理将 PDF/DOCX/EPUB 整书翻译为任意语言。通过分块翻译、上下文隔离和 SHA-256 校验，避免长文本截断，支持断点续译和多格式导出，适合高效处理整本书籍翻译。
summary.en: An agent skill for Codex, Claude Code, and OpenClaw that translates complete books from PDF/DOCX/EPUB into any language using parallel subagents. It splits the book into chunks, translates them concurrently with isolated contexts, validates via manifest hashes, and outputs HTML/DOCX/EPUB/PDF with resumable support.

metadata.name: MinerU
metadata.description: Transforms complex documents like PDFs and Office docs into LLM-ready markdown/JSON for your Agentic workflows.

summary.zh: MinerU是一款开源文档解析工具，能将PDF、Office等复杂文档精准转换为LLM可直接消费的Markdown/JSON格式。它解决了非结构化文档解析难题，为智能体工作流提供高质量数据输入，支持表格、公式、布局还原，提升RAG与模型微调数据质量。
summary.en: MinerU is an open-source document parser that converts complex documents like PDFs and Office files into LLM-ready Markdown/JSON. It solves unstructured document parsing, preserving tables, formulas, and layout, enabling high-quality data for agentic workflows, RAG, and fine-tuning.

metadata.name: maestro-flow
metadata.description: Intent-driven workflow orchestration for multi-agent AI development — adaptive lifecycle engine, self-reinforcing knowledge graph, and visual dashboard for Claude Code, Gemini, Codex & more

summary.zh: Maestro-Flow 是意图驱动的多智能体工作流编排框架，支持 Claude Code、Gemini、Codex 等后端混合调度。其自适应引擎将自然语言意图映射到 40+ 命令链，动态决策继续或修复，通过知识图谱沉淀经验并注入后续提示词，实现项目越用越智能，适用于从头脑风暴到部署的全流程自动化开发。
summary.en: Maestro-Flow is an intent-driven workflow orchestration framework for multi-agent AI development, supporting mixed backends like Claude Code, Gemini, and Codex. Its adaptive engine maps natural language intents to 40+ command chains, dynamically deciding to proceed or repair, while a self-reinforcing knowledge graph persists learnings and injects them into future prompts, making projects progressively smarter for end-to-end automation from brainstorming to deployment.

metadata.name: oh-my-openagent
metadata.description: omo/lazycodex: The coding agent for tokenmaxxers;the one and only agent harness for complex codebases. For your Codex, for your OpenCode

summary.zh: oh-my-openagent 是面向复杂代码库的编码代理编排框架，支持 OpenCode、Codex 等多种代理后端。其核心价值在于打破单一模型供应商锁定，实现多模型灵活编排与协同，为开发者提供高效、开放的 AI 编程体验。项目正在重构以适配更多代理平台，并由 AI 助手实时维护，社区活跃。
summary.en: oh-my-openagent is a coding agent harness for complex codebases, supporting multiple agent backends like OpenCode and Codex. Its core value lies in breaking vendor lock-in by orchestrating multiple AI models flexibly. The project is being refactored to support more agent platforms and is actively maintained with a vibrant community.

metadata.name: opendataloader-pdf
metadata.description: PDF Parser for AI-ready data. Automate PDF accessibility. Open-source.

summary.zh: OpenDataLoader PDF 是一款开源高精度PDF解析器，可将任意PDF转为Markdown、JSON、HTML及Tagged PDF。基准测试综合准确率0.907、表格0.928，支持本地确定性模式与AI混合OCR，自动生成标签，服务于RAG/LLM数据准备与PDF无障碍合规。
summary.en: OpenDataLoader PDF is an open-source, high-accuracy PDF parser that converts digital, scanned, and tagged PDFs into Markdown, JSON, HTML, and Tagged PDF. With benchmark-leading overall accuracy (0.907) and table extraction (0.928), it offers deterministic local mode and AI hybrid OCR, plus auto-tagging for PDF/UA accessibility compliance. It supports Python, Node.js, Java SDKs, integrates with LangChain, and is the first open-source end-to-end PDF auto-tagging solution. Validated with veraPDF and PDF Association, it processes at 0.015s/page locally and handles 80+ languages.

metadata.name: ds2api
metadata.description: DeepSeek-Compatible Middleware Interface: A technical exploration project in Go, focusing on high-concurrency protocol adaptation. It serves as a reference implementation for converting diverse web protocols into standardized formats.

summary.zh: DS2API 是一款基于 Go 语言的高性能中间件，旨在将 DeepSeek 网页对话能力转换为 OpenAI、Claude 和 Gemini 兼容的 API 接口。它同时支持多协议适配、流式输出、Tool Call 及灵活鉴权，并提供了 WebUI 管理台，可通过 Docker、Vercel 等方式快速部署，帮助开发者无缝集成 DeepSeek 模型能力。
summary.en: DS2API is a high-performance middleware implemented in Go, designed to convert DeepSeek's web-based conversational abilities into API interfaces compatible with OpenAI, Claude, and Gemini. It supports multi-protocol adaptation, streaming responses, tool calls, and flexible authentication mechanisms. A WebUI admin panel is included, and deployment can be easily done via Docker, Vercel, or local binaries. Furthermore, it acts as a gateway that unifies different API formats, enabling developers to seamlessly integrate DeepSeek models into their applications with minimal configuration and effort.

metadata.name: chatgpt2api
metadata.description: ChatGPT官网接口纯协议的逆向实现，支持GPT-Image-2模型、文本模型，兼容OpenAI接口协议，在线批量生图/编辑图，号池管理，支持可编辑PPT/PSD文件逆向，支持导入CPA、sub2api号池 、支持接入Cherry  Studio、New Api 等软件

summary.zh: ChatGPT2API 是 ChatGPT 官网接口的逆向实现，提供 OpenAI 兼容的图片生成/编辑 API，支持 GPT-Image-2 等模型，内置在线画图面板、号池管理、多账号导入（CPA、sub2api），并支持可编辑 PPT/PSD 文件生成，可通过 Docker 自托管部署，适用于开发者快速接入 ChatGPT 图像能力。
summary.en: ChatGPT2API is a reverse-engineered implementation of ChatGPT's official APIs, offering OpenAI-compatible image generation and editing endpoints. It supports models like GPT-Image-2, includes an online drawing canvas, account pool management, multi-source account import, editable PPT/PSD generation, and Docker self-hosting for rapid integration.

metadata.name: qiaomu-anything-to-notebooklm
metadata.description: Claude Skill: Multi-source content processor for NotebookLM. Supports WeChat articles, web pages, YouTube, PDF, Markdown, search queries → Podcast/PPT/MindMap/Quiz etc.

summary.zh: 这是一个Claude Skill，支持从微信公众号、YouTube、网页、PDF等15+来源提取内容，自动绕过付费墙，并借助Google NotebookLM将文本转换为播客、PPT、思维导图、Quiz等格式。用户只需用自然语言描述需求，即可完成从采集到生成的全流程自动化。
summary.en: A Claude Skill that fetches content from 15+ sources (WeChat, YouTube, web, PDF) with automatic paywall bypass. It uses Google NotebookLM to transform text into podcasts, PPTs, mind maps, quizzes—a fully automated natural language driven content workflow.

metadata.name: Pebble
metadata.description: A small yet beautiful email client.

summary.zh: Pebble 是一款基于 Rust 与 Tauri 的跨平台桌面邮件客户端，采用本地优先架构，数据存储于本地 SQLite 与 Tantivy 全文索引中，无需云端。支持 Gmail、IMAP、POP3 与 Outlook，具备规则引擎、暂缓、看板、双语翻译和加密认证等隐私增强功能。
summary.en: Pebble is a cross-platform desktop email client built with Rust and Tauri, designed for a calmer, more private inbox. It keeps all data local with SQLite and Tantivy search, supports Gmail, IMAP, POP3, and Outlook, and offers productivity features such as rules, snooze, Kanban, bilingual translation, and encrypted credentials. No telemetry and explicit privacy controls.

metadata.name: skills
metadata.description: Skills for Real Engineers. Straight from my .agents directory.

summary.zh: 作者日常使用的AI代理技能集合，专注真实工程实践。技能小巧、可组合，兼容Claude Code、Codex等代理，通过插件或CLI快速安装。旨在减少意图偏差，提升开发流程执行效率与代码质量。
summary.en: A collection of agent skills for real engineering practice, curated from the author's daily development workflow. The skills are small, composable, and adaptable, working with leading coding agents like Claude Code and Codex. They address common failure modes such as intent misalignment by providing structured workflows for issue tracking, setup, and diagnostics. Installable via Claude Code plugin or npx skills CLI, the skills aim to improve development efficiency and code quality. This repo is for developers who want practical, non-opinionated guidance to get better results from AI coding agents.

metadata.name: free-claude-code
metadata.description: Use Claude Code, Codex, Pi, and OpenCode and more for free (1.3B+ free tokens) from your terminal, app, IDE, or phone like OpenClaw (voice supported + ToS friendly)

summary.zh: free-claude-code是一款开源工具，让你免费使用Claude Code、Codex和Pi等AI编程助手，支持从终端、桌面应用、IDE及手机端访问，提供统一管理界面、自定义模型路由与本地优化，并支持语音交互，类似OpenClaw。
summary.en: A free open-source tool that lets you run Claude Code, Codex, and Pi as coding agents from your terminal, desktop, IDE, or phone. Features a unified admin UI, custom model routing, local optimizations, and optional voice bots—similar to OpenClaw.

metadata.name: cc-haha
metadata.description: Local-first cross-platform desktop workspace for Claude Code / agents: multi-agent, Git worktrees, code diffs, skill marketplace, multi-model, Computer Use, task-aware desktop pets, with WeChat, Feishu, DingTalk, Telegram, WhatsApp and H5 access.

summary.zh: Claude Code Haha 是一款本地优先的跨平台桌面工作台，为 Claude Code 与 AI 智能体提供多智能体会话、Git Worktree、代码差异审查、内置浏览器预览、技能市场、多模型接入及 Computer Use 等能力；同时支持微信、飞书、钉钉、Telegram、WhatsApp 与 H5 远程访问，实现全场景 AI 编程与协作。
summary.en: Claude Code Haha is a local-first, cross-platform desktop workspace for Claude Code and AI agents. It features multi-agent sessions, Git worktrees, code diff review, built-in browser preview, a skill marketplace, and multi-model support including Claude, ChatGPT, Grok, and local endpoints. It also offers Computer Use, visual MCP/SubAgent managers, desktop pets, GUI permission approval, image generation, and scheduled tasks. Remote access via WeChat, Feishu, DingTalk, Telegram, WhatsApp, and H5 enables seamless collaboration across devices. This makes it a comprehensive AI development and collaboration hub.

metadata.name: coding-agent-harness
metadata.description: No longer maintained — completely rewritten as Harness Anything: a self-evolving harness for durable agent decisions, tasks, facts, and evidence-backed completion.

summary.zh: 面向AI编码代理（如Codex、Claude Code）的文档原生工程框架，将代理的决策、任务、事实与评审转化为仓库内的持久文件，通过“诊断→决策→搭建→配置→验证→交付”流程实现可审查的长期开发。核心包无第三方依赖、无需后台服务。注意：项目已停止维护，重写为Harness Anything。
summary.en: A document-native engineering framework for AI coding agents (Codex, Claude Code, etc.), turning agent decisions, tasks, facts, and reviews into durable repository files. It follows a Diagnose→Decide→Scaffold→Configure→Verify→Deliver loop, with a zero-dependency core and no background services. Note: unmaintained, rewritten as Harness Anything.

metadata.name: claude-context
metadata.description: Code search MCP for Claude Code. Make entire codebase the context for any coding agent.

summary.zh: Claude Context 是一个 MCP 语义代码搜索插件，让 AI 编程代理把整个代码库作为上下文。借助向量数据库高效检索相关代码，无需全量加载，大幅节约大项目成本，提升编码效率。
summary.en: Claude Context is an MCP-based semantic code search tool designed for Claude Code and other AI coding agents. It indexes the entire codebase into a vector database using embeddings, then retrieves only the most relevant code snippets as context for queries. This approach avoids loading entire directories, significantly reducing API costs and latency for large projects while improving code understanding and generation accuracy. It seamlessly integrates with Claude Code via the Model Context Protocol and supports Zilliz Cloud Milvus as the vector store, making it an essential tool for developers working with massive codebases.

metadata.name: Vibe-Skills
metadata.description: VibeSkills is a general-purpose Skill that automatically routes local Skills and intelligently orchestrates harness workflows.

summary.zh: VibeSkills是一个通用型AI技能管理器，能自动路由本地技能资源，并通过规划状态机智能编排跨域工作流。它解决技能遗忘与调度冲突问题，降低用户规划负担，实现端到端交付。核心技术是基于提示工程的模块化分解与资源调度。
summary.en: VibeSkills is a general-purpose AI skill manager that automatically routes local skills and orchestrates cross-domain workflows via a planning state machine. It resolves skill-forgetting and scheduling conflicts, reducing user planning burden and enabling end-to-end delivery. Core tech: modular decomposition and resource scheduling based on prompt engineering.

metadata.name: context-mode
metadata.description: Context window optimization for AI coding agents. Sandboxes tool output (98% reduction), persists session memory, and   enforces routing across 17 platforms via MCP + hooks.

summary.zh: 该项目专注解决AI编程代理上下文窗口被工具输出耗尽的问题。通过沙箱机制将工具输出压缩高达98%，持久化会话记忆，并基于MCP与钩子在17种平台间统一路由，确保长任务下上下文可持续且优质。
summary.en: Context optimizer for AI agents: cuts tool output 98%, persists memory, MCP routes 17 platforms.

metadata.name: SSR-V2ray-Trojan
metadata.description: 2026机场推荐与机场评测

summary.zh: 该仓库是一份持续更新的代理机场推荐与评测列表，基于长期测速、实际体验和用户反馈，筛选稳定、高性价比的 IEPL 专线及 AnyTLS 协议机场。涵盖机场客户端选择、套餐对比、测速数据和购买避坑指南，帮助用户快速找到适合的主力与备用机场。
summary.en: This repository offers a continuously updated list of recommended proxy services, based on long-term speed tests, real-world usage, and user feedback. It focuses on stable and cost-effective IEPL dedicated lines and AnyTLS protocol providers, including client recommendations, plan comparisons, speed test results, and buying guides to help users find reliable primary and backup services.

metadata.name: repobrain
metadata.description: 🧠 RepoBrain (formerly Antigravity) — Give your repo a brain. ChatGPT for your codebase: works in Claude Code, Cursor, Codex, Windsurf & more.

summary.zh: RepoBrain 是一个跨 IDE 的代码库知识引擎，为 Claude Code、Cursor、Codex 等 AI 编程工具提供“ChatGPT 式”的代码问答。通过多智能体集群自动阅读代码并生成知识文档，基于真实代码返回带文件路径和行号的精确答案，显著提升 AI 助手的上下文质量与开发效率。
summary.en: RepoBrain is a cross-IDE codebase knowledge engine that brings ChatGPT-style Q&A to AI coding tools like Claude Code, Cursor, and Codex. A multi-agent cluster autonomously reads your code and generates knowledge docs, grounding answers with real file paths and line numbers to enhance AI context quality and developer productivity.

metadata.name: chatgpt-timeline
metadata.description: 为ChatGPT/Gemini/Grok/Claude等网页对话页面添加时间线/目录导航/复制回复/页面宽度修改功能，方便快速导航/复制回复/修改页面宽度。Adds a timeline/TOC/Copy Reply/Page Width Modification to ChatGPT conversations for easy navigation/copy reply/modify page width.

summary.zh: 为ChatGPT、Gemini、Claude等AI对话页面提供时间线导航与目录侧栏，支持点击跳转、拖拽定位、回复复制及页面宽度调节。适配多平台与深浅主题，具备响应式布局和可定制设置，极大提升对话浏览体验。
summary.en: ChatGPT Timeline is a browser extension that adds an interactive timeline and table of contents to AI conversation pages such as ChatGPT, Gemini, Claude, DeepSeek, Doubao, and Grok. It enables click-to-navigate markers, quick jumps, drag-and-drop repositioning, copy reply functionality, and width adjustment for dialogs. The interface adapts to light/dark themes and screen resizing, with customizable positions and settings for an enhanced browsing experience.

metadata.name: BlockNote
metadata.description: A React Rich Text Editor that's block-based (Notion style) and extensible. Built on top of Prosemirror and Tiptap.

summary.zh: BlockNote 是一个基于 React 的开源块级富文本编辑器，提供 Notion 风格体验。支持拖拽、嵌套、斜杠菜单、格式化工具栏及实时协作，基于 ProseMirror 和 Tiptap 构建，易于扩展和集成。
summary.en: BlockNote is an open-source block-based React rich text editor offering Notion-like experience. It features drag-and-drop, nesting, slash commands, formatting menus, and real-time collaboration, built on ProseMirror and Tiptap for extensibility.

metadata.name: Gpt-Agreement-Payment
metadata.description: ChatGPT Plus/Team/Pro 订阅协议端到端重放工具集 · hCaptcha 视觉求解器 · 反欺诈机制实证研究 / End-to-end protocol replay toolkit for ChatGPT Plus/Team/Pro subscription with from-scratch hCaptcha solver and empirical anti-fraud research

summary.zh: ChatGPT订阅协议端到端重放工具，支持Stripe/PayPal/GoPay/QRIS支付，集成自研hCaptcha视觉求解器，并附带反欺诈实证研究，适用于CTF、漏洞赏金与安全研究。
summary.en: This repository provides an end-to-end protocol replay toolkit for ChatGPT Plus/Team/Pro subscriptions. It reverse-engineers the complete subscription flow, covering Stripe Checkout, PayPal billing agreements, GoPay/QRIS payments, ChatGPT manual approval, and Codex OAuth+PKCE, and implements it as a runnable client. Key highlights include a from-scratch hCaptcha visual solver (VLM with CLIP/OpenCV fallback and human-like Playwright actions), a PayPal risk-control early-exit branch, and empirical anti-fraud data from real runs. The project is intended exclusively for CTF challenges, bug bounty programs, and authorized security research, not for fraudulent or unauthorized use.

metadata.name: input0
metadata.description: Input0 — A macOS voice input tool: hold a hotkey to record, release to transcribe locally via STT, refine with LLM, and auto-paste into the active text field.

summary.zh: Input0是一款macOS语音输入工具，按住热键说话，松开后自动完成本地语音识别、LLM文本优化和自动粘贴。支持6种本地推理引擎和99+语言，注重隐私，通过Metal GPU加速，适配多种应用场景。
summary.en: Input0 is a macOS voice input tool that lets you hold a hotkey to speak, then automatically transcribes locally via STT, polishes text with LLM, and pastes it anywhere. Featuring 6 on-device engines, 99+ languages, and Metal GPU acceleration, it prioritizes privacy and efficiency.

metadata.name: qiaomu-blog-opensource
metadata.description: Open-source Cloudflare blog template based on OpenNext, Next.js 16, D1, and R2

summary.zh: 这是一个开源的云端博客系统，基于Next.js 16与Cloudflare Workers构建，利用D1和R2存储，提供前后台双编辑器、AI文本与生图辅助、主题系统、全文检索、发布状态管理等功能，并配套浏览器剪藏、Obsidian发布等生态工具，可一键部署，无需自建服务器。
summary.en: This is an open-source cloud blog platform built with Next.js 16 and Cloudflare Workers, using D1 and R2 for storage. It features dual frontend/backend editors, AI-assisted writing and image generation, theme system, full-text search, publish state management, and ecosystem tools like browser clipper and Obsidian publisher. One-click deploy to Cloudflare without managing servers.

metadata.name: agent-skills
metadata.description: Production-grade engineering skills for AI coding agents.

summary.zh: 该仓库提供一套生产级工程技能包，供AI编码代理在开发全生命周期中遵循资深工程师的工作流、质量门禁与最佳实践。包含8个斜杠命令（如/spec、/plan、/test）和24项技能，支持自动触发，可安装到70多种代理工具，显著提升AI编程的规范性与可靠性。
summary.en: This repo provides production-grade engineering skill packs for AI coding agents, encoding senior engineers' workflows, quality gates, and best practices across the development lifecycle. It includes 8 slash commands and 24 skills, supports automatic triggering, and installs into 70+ agent tools, boosting the consistency and reliability of AI-assisted development.

metadata.name: vaultwarden
metadata.description: Unofficial Bitwarden compatible server written in Rust, formerly known as bitwarden_rs

summary.zh: Vaultwarden 是一个用 Rust 编写的非官方 Bitwarden 服务器实现，完全兼容官方客户端，专为自托管设计。它轻量高效，资源占用远低于官方服务，适合个人或小型团队部署密码管理服务，支持 Docker 等多种安装方式，是自托管密码管理的理想选择。
summary.en: Vaultwarden is an unofficial Bitwarden-compatible server written in Rust, designed for self-hosted deployment. It is fully compatible with official Bitwarden clients while being lightweight and resource-efficient, making it ideal for individuals and small teams. Supports Docker and other installation methods, providing a secure password management solution.

metadata.name: codex-auth
metadata.description: A CLI tool to switch and manage Codex accounts

summary.zh: codex-auth 是一款用于 Codex 账户管理的开源命令行工具，旨在解决多账号切换繁琐的问题。它支持 Codex CLI、VS Code 扩展和 Codex App 客户端，提供账户列表、登录、切换、删除、批量导入导出、别名设置等功能，并通过交互式命令行与可脚本化操作简化管理流程，显著提升开发效率。
summary.en: codex-auth is an open-source command-line tool designed to simplify the management and switching of multiple Codex accounts. It integrates seamlessly with Codex CLI, the VS Code extension, and the Codex App, providing a comprehensive set of commands for listing, logging in, switching, removing, importing, and exporting accounts. Users can also create aliases for quick identification. The tool supports interactive selection as well as direct query-based commands, making it suitable for both manual and automated workflows. By centralizing account configuration and enabling fast account switching, codex-auth significantly enhances productivity for developers who work with multiple Codex environments.

metadata.name: OpenSpec
metadata.description: Spec-driven development (SDD) for AI coding assistants.

summary.zh: OpenSpec 是面向 AI 编程助手的规范驱动开发框架。用 Markdown 规范组织需求、设计与任务，让 AI 先规划后编码，支持探索、提议、应用、归档等阶段。强调流动而非僵化，适用于个人到企业级项目，提升大模型生成代码的准确性与可控性。
summary.en: OpenSpec is an open-source, spec-driven development framework designed for AI coding assistants. By using plain Markdown to define requirements, design, and tasks, it enables AI agents to explore, propose, apply, and archive changes in a controlled, iterative manner. The framework is fluid rather than rigid, easy to adopt, and works for both brownfield and greenfield projects—from personal scripts to enterprise systems. It provides a new artifact-guided workflow with commands like /opsx:propose, helping developers review AI plans before implementation, ultimately making AI-generated code more accurate, maintainable, and trustworthy.

metadata.name: WindsurfAPI
metadata.description: Turn Windsurf / Devin Desktop's 100+ AI models (Claude, GPT, Gemini, DeepSeek, Kimi, GLM, SWE) into OpenAI-, Anthropic- & Gemini-compatible APIs. Zero-dependency self-hosted reverse proxy for Claude Code, Cline & Cursor. 把 Windsurf/Devin 云端 100+ 模型变成三套兼容 API。

summary.zh: 这是一个零依赖的Node.js反向代理，能将 Windsurf/Devin 的 100+ 个 AI 模型统一转换为 OpenAI、Anthropic、Gemini 三种兼容 API。支持账号池轮询、速率限制和故障转移，可无缝接入 Claude Code、Cline、Cursor 等开发工具，实现多模型自由切换。
summary.en: This zero-dependency Node.js reverse proxy converts 100+ Windsurf/Devin AI models (Claude, GPT, Gemini, etc.) into OpenAI, Anthropic, and Gemini-compatible APIs. It features account pool rotation, rate limiting, and failover, seamlessly integrating with Claude Code, Cline, Cursor for unified multi-model access.

metadata.name: goal-driven
metadata.description: A multi-agent system that keeps running for ~100 hours and solve a very complicated coding or math problem that can be verified

summary.zh: Goal-Driven是一个多智能体系统，通过主智能体与子代理的协同，可持续运行数百小时，解决编译器设计、数学定理证明等可验证的复杂问题。它基于目标与严格标准，循环检查子代理进度，直至达标，显著提升AI处理长期任务的能力。
summary.en: Goal-Driven is a multi-agent system enabling ~100+ hours of sustained effort to solve verifiable complex problems like compiler design and math proofs. A master agent monitors a subagent against strict criteria, restarting work until goals are met, enhancing AI autonomy for long-horizon tasks.

metadata.name: get-shit-done
metadata.description: A light-weight and powerful meta-prompting, context engineering and spec-driven development system for Claude Code by TÂCHES.

summary.zh: GSD是一套轻量级但功能强大的元提示与上下文工程系统，专为Claude Code设计，采用规范驱动开发提升AI编程效率。原仓库已归档，项目已迁移至open-gsd/gsd-core仓库继续开发。
summary.en: GSD is a lightweight yet powerful meta-prompting and context engineering system for Claude Code, enabling spec-driven development to boost AI coding efficiency. The original repo is archived and development continues at open-gsd/gsd-core.

metadata.name: geektime-bootcamp-ai
metadata.description: 我在极客时间上的 AI 训练营课程

summary.zh: 这是极客时间AI训练营的完整课程资料仓库，包含视频讲义、可运行源码和实战项目，系统讲解人工智能核心概念及大模型应用开发技巧，通过阶梯式动手实践帮助开发者快速掌握AI应用构建方法。
summary.en: This repository contains complete course materials for the GeekTime AI Bootcamp, including video lectures, runnable code, and hands-on projects. It systematically covers core AI concepts and large model application development, helping developers quickly build practical AI applications through progressive practice.

metadata.name: andrej-karpathy-skills
metadata.description: A single CLAUDE.md file to improve Claude Code behavior, derived from Andrej Karpathy's observations on LLM coding pitfalls.

summary.zh: 基于Andrej Karpathy对LLM编码陷阱的观察，提供单一CLAUDE.md文件，通过四大原则（先思考、简单优先、外科手术式修改、目标驱动执行）显著提升Claude Code的代码质量与行为规范。适用于AI辅助编程场景，减少过度工程与错误假设，推动可验证的高效开发。
summary.en: Derived from Andrej Karpathy's observations on LLM coding pitfalls, this single CLAUDE.md file improves Claude Code behavior via four principles: think before coding, simplicity first, surgical changes, and goal-driven execution.
