It reduces overengineering and wrong assumptions, promoting verifiable, efficient AI-assisted development.

metadata.name: cockpit-tools
metadata.description: 🚀 通用 AI IDE 账号管理工具：支持 Antigravity / Codex / GitHub Copilot / Windsurf / Kiro / Cursor / Gemini-cli / CodeBuddy，多账号切换、配额监控、自动唤醒与多开实例管理。 🚀 Universal AI IDE account manager for Antigravity / Codex / GitHub Copilot / Windsurf / Kiro / Cursor / Gemini-cli / CodeBuddy, with multi-account switching, quota monitoring, wake-up automation, and multi-insta

summary.zh: 通用AI IDE账号管理工具，支持Antigravity、Codex、GitHub Copilot、Windsurf、Cursor等16种主流AI编程工具。提供一键切号、多账号管理、配额实时监控、自动唤醒和实例多开等核心功能，跨平台支持Windows/macOS/Linux，帮助开发者高效利用多个AI账号资源，提升开发效率。
summary.en: Universal AI IDE account manager for 16+ platforms including Antigravity, Codex, GitHub Copilot, Windsurf, Kiro, Cursor, Gemini-cli, CodeBuddy, and more. It enables one-click account switching, multi-account management, real-time quota monitoring with visual dashboard, automated wake-up scheduling, and parallel running of multiple app instances. Supports credential import via OAuth and refresh tokens. Available on Windows, macOS, and Linux with an 18-language interface, this tool helps developers fully leverage their AI account resources. The dashboard offers a unified overview of account status and quota reset times.

metadata.name: discourse-saver
metadata.description: Discourse 论坛帖子保存工具 - 一键保存到 Obsidian/飞书/Notion/WebDAV/百度网盘，支持飞书云文档，自动按论坛域名分文件夹

summary.zh: Discourse Saver 是一款专为 Discourse 论坛设计的帖子保存工具，支持通过 Chrome 扩展或油猴脚本一键将帖子和评论保存到 Obsidian、飞书、Notion、WebDAV 及百度网盘等平台。自动检测论坛域名并分文件夹整理，支持指定楼层保存、HTML 导出及多平台并行同步，有效助力知识管理。
summary.en: Discourse Saver is a dedicated tool for saving Discourse forum posts with one click via Chrome extension or userscript. It exports content to Obsidian, Feishu, Notion, WebDAV, Baidu Netdisk, and HTML, automatically organizing by forum domain. Supports floor-specific saving, multi-platform sync, and media download, making it an efficient knowledge management assistant.

metadata.name: repo-analyzer
metadata.description: AI coding agent skill for deep architectural analysis of open-source projects | 开源项目深度架构分析，一句话生成专业级分析报告

summary.zh: 这是一个面向AI编码代理的开源架构分析技能。它能自动克隆仓库、并行分析核心模块，结合外部调研与交互式问答，生成包含设计洞察、权衡分析和Mermaid图表的中文专业报告。适用于项目学习、框架对比和源码研究，兼容Claude Code、Codex等主流AI代理。
summary.en: This is an AI coding agent skill for deep architectural analysis of open-source projects. It clones repositories, spawns parallel subagents to analyze core modules, combines external research and interactive Q&A, and generates professional reports with design insights, trade-off analysis, and Mermaid diagrams. Compatible with Claude Code, Codex, and other AI agents.

metadata.name: system-design-notes
metadata.description: Notes of the book System Desgin Interview - An Insider's Guide

summary.zh: 基于《System Design Interview》的深度笔记，涵盖从零扩展到百万用户、限流、一致性哈希、键值存储、分布式消息队列等核心技术，以及URL短链、聊天、支付、网盘等经典系统设计案例，配以系统架构图与面试框架，是系统设计面试准备的实用指南。
summary.en: Comprehensive notes based on 'System Design Interview', covering core concepts like scaling, rate limiting, consistent hashing, key-value stores, and distributed queues, plus classic designs such as URL shortener, chat, payment, and storage. Includes frameworks and diagrams, making it an essential resource for system design interview prep.

metadata.name: token
metadata.description: Neovim colorscheme with terminal-wide contrib themes

summary.zh: Token是一个面向Neovim 0.12+的温暖柔和配色方案，提供暗色与亮色变体并支持运行时切换。基于Treesitter和LSP的语义高亮，覆盖诊断、diff、终端ANSI颜色等。同一调色板可生成Ghostty、fish、tmux等终端主题，确保全局一致。提供可选配置API和插件集成，轻量且可定制。
summary.en: Token is a warm, muted Neovim 0.12+ colorscheme with dark and light variants switchable at runtime. It leverages Treesitter and LSP semantic highlighting, covering diagnostics, diffs, and ANSI terminal colors. Contrib themes for Ghostty, fish, tmux are generated from the same palette for consistency. An optional config API and plugin integrations keep it lightweight and customizable.

metadata.name: CodexPotter
metadata.description: A better /goal

summary.zh: CodexPotter是面向Codex的自动化编码助手，其核心价值在于通过持续校准将代码库逐步调整至既定目标。它采用多轮自动审查与修复、干净上下文和文件系统记忆，显著提升代码质量，同时保持极致轻量，并与技能及MCP无缝集成。
summary.en: CodexPotter is a better /goal replacement for Codex, continuously reconciling the codebase toward your instructed goal. It automates multi-round review and refinement with fresh contexts, file system as memory, and a tiny token footprint, seamlessly integrating with AGENTS.md, skills, and MCPs.

metadata.name: codex-autoresearch
metadata.description: Codex Autoresearch Skill — A self-directed iterative system for Codex that continuously cycles through: modify, verify, retain or discard, and repeat indefinitely. Inspired by Karpathy’s autoresearch concept.

summary.zh: Codex Autoresearch是面向OpenAI Codex的自驱迭代技能，通过修改、验证、保留或回滚的循环，自动优化错误率、覆盖率、类型错误等可度量指标，支持前后台运行，适用于测试失败修复、性能优化等场景，实现自主实验与持续演进。
summary.en: Codex Autoresearch is a self-directed iterative skill for OpenAI Codex that autonomously cycles modify, verify, retain or discard to achieve measurable goals like fixing test failures, improving coverage, or reducing errors. It supports foreground and background modes with version-controlled rollback, making it an efficient automation tool for continuous code improvement.

metadata.name: ralph
metadata.description: Ralph is an autonomous AI agent loop that runs repeatedly until all PRD items are complete.

summary.zh: Ralph是自主AI智能体循环，重复调用Amp或Claude Code直到PRD完成。每次迭代全新上下文，通过git历史、progress.txt和prd.json保持记忆，适合自动化开发。
summary.en: Ralph is an autonomous AI agent loop that repeatedly invokes AI coding tools like Amp or Claude Code until all PRD items are completed. Each iteration runs with a fresh, clean context, while memory and knowledge persist via git history, progress.txt, and prd.json. The loop selects the highest-priority unfinished user story, implements it, runs quality checks (typecheck and tests), commits when successful, and updates the task list. This enables automated, self-driving development workflows that can handle large stories beyond a single context window, making it ideal for AI-assisted coding and iterative software delivery.

summary.zh: 多平台账号自动注册与管理系统，基于FastAPI和React构建，支持ChatGPT、Grok等平台批量注册、账号管理与状态同步。提供Web UI、插件化扩展、代理池、验证码识别及多邮箱服务，适用于自动化账号注册场景。
summary.en: A multi-platform account auto-registration and management system built with FastAPI and React, supporting batch registration, account management, and status sync for platforms like ChatGPT and Grok. Features Web UI, plugin architecture, proxy pool, captcha solving, and multiple email services.

metadata.name: Trellis
metadata.description: The best agent harness.

summary.zh: Trellis 是一个为 AI 编码设计的工程框架，将项目规范、任务和记忆持久化到代码仓库中，让任何 AI 智能体都能遵循团队工程标准。它自动注入相关上下文，支持任务中心工作流和跨会话记忆，兼容 21 种主流 AI 编码平台，大幅减少重复配置，提升团队协作效率。
summary.en: Trellis is an out-of-the-box engineering framework for AI coding that persists project specifications, tasks, and memory directly into your repository. It automatically injects the relevant context into every coding session, ensuring any coding agent works to your engineering standards. With support for 21 major AI coding platforms, it lets you maintain a single workflow across all tools, preserves what happened last time, and prevents starting from scratch each session. This leads to higher efficiency, better consistency, and smoother team collaboration.

metadata.name: firemail
metadata.description: 一款通用邮箱收件工具，提供简单高效的邮件管理解决方案

summary.zh: FireMail是一款开源通用邮箱批量收件工具，支持Outlook、Gmail、QQ及IMAP协议邮箱。通过批量导入账号、自动收信、多线程及WebSocket实时反馈，实现高效邮件管理。采用Vue3+Flask前后端分离架构，具备多用户权限、本地加密存储及Docker部署能力。
summary.en: FireMail is an open-source bulk email receiving tool supporting Outlook, Gmail, QQ, and IMAP protocols. It enables efficient email management via batch account import, auto-receiving, multithreading, and real-time WebSocket feedback. Built with Vue3+Flask separation architecture, it offers multi-user roles, encrypted local storage, and Docker deployment.

metadata.name: outlookEmail
metadata.description: outlookEmail 支持 Outlook/Hotmail、Gmail、QQ、163、126、Yahoo、阿里邮箱以及自定义 IMAP 邮箱，同时集成 GPTMail、DuckMail、Cloudflare Temp Email 多提供商临时邮箱能力

summary.zh: 多邮箱邮件管理工具，支持Outlook/Hotmail、Gmail、QQ等主流邮箱及自定义IMAP，通过Microsoft Graph API和OAuth统一收发与转发邮件。提供Web界面和Chrome/Edge扩展，支持分组管理、账号管理和对外API调用，并集成GPTMail、DuckMail等临时邮箱，适合多账号邮件集中管理场景。
summary.en: A comprehensive multi-account email management tool that unifies Outlook/Hotmail, Gmail, QQ, and custom IMAP through Microsoft Graph API and OAuth. It provides a web dashboard and Chrome/Edge extension for grouped management, account oversight, email viewing, and external API calls. Additionally, it integrates temporary email providers like GPTMail, DuckMail, and Cloudflare Temp Email, making it ideal for centralized multi-mailbox administration.

metadata.name: system_prompts_leaks
metadata.description: Extracted system prompts from Anthropic - Claude Fable 5, Opus 5, Claude Design, Claude Code. OpenAI - ChatGPT GPT-5.6-Sol, Codex. Google - Gemini 3.5 Flash, 3.1 Pro, Antigravity. xAI - Grok, Cursor, Copilot, VS Code, Perplexity, and more. Updated regularly.

summary.zh: 收集并持续更新各大AI模型（Anthropic、OpenAI、Google、xAI等）泄露的原始系统提示词，涵盖ChatGPT、Claude、Gemini、Grok等主流产品。这些隐藏指令揭示了模型行为规则与安全机制，是提示工程、AI安全研究和模型逆向分析的高价值资源，曾被华盛顿邮报等权威媒体引用。
summary.en: A continuously updated repository of verbatim system prompts leaked from major AI models including Anthropic, OpenAI, Google, xAI, etc., covering ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, Grok, and more. These hidden instructions reveal model behavior rules and safety mechanisms, serving as high-value resources for prompt engineering, AI safety research, and reverse engineering. Cited by The Washington Post and other outlets.

metadata.name: graphify
metadata.description: Turn any codebase, with its docs, SQL schemas, configs, and PDFs, into a queryable knowledge graph. A /graphify skill for Claude Code, Cursor, Codex, and Gemini CLI: local deterministic AST parsing, every edge explained, no vector store.

summary.zh: Graphify 将代码库、文档、SQL 模式、配置和 PDF 等转换为可查询的知识图谱，为 Claude Code、Cursor 等 AI 编码助手提供 `/graphify` 技能。采用本地确定性 AST 解析，每条边均有解释，无需向量存储，实现高效、可解释的代码理解。
summary.en: Graphify turns any codebase, including docs, SQL schemas, configs, and PDFs, into a queryable knowledge graph. It provides a `/graphify` skill for AI coding assistants like Claude Code and Cursor, using deterministic local AST parsing with explained edges and no vector store.

metadata.name: full-stack-fastapi-template
metadata.description: Full-stack web application template with FastAPI, React, SQLModel, PostgreSQL, Vite, Tailwind CSS, shadcn/ui, FastAPI Cloud, and Docker Compose.

summary.zh: 基于FastAPI和React的现代全栈Web应用模板，集成SQLModel、PostgreSQL、Docker Compose及GitHub Actions，内置JWT认证、自动HTTPS、自动生成前端客户端等功能，支持暗黑模式与端到端测试，可快速搭建生产级项目。
summary.en: A modern full-stack web app template built with FastAPI and React, integrating SQLModel, PostgreSQL, Docker Compose, and GitHub Actions. Features JWT auth, automatic HTTPS, auto-generated frontend client, dark mode, and e2e testing, enabling rapid production-ready development.

metadata.name: web2api
metadata.description: 把网页AI转api，如claude2api

summary.zh: Web2API 是一款将网页端 AI 服务（如 Claude Web）封装为标准 API 的桥接工具。它支持 OpenAI 与 Anthropic 双协议，兼容图片输入、流式输出和工具调用，提供可视化配置，便于 Cursor 等客户端无缝接入。
summary.en: Web2API is a bridge that wraps web-based AI services (e.g., Claude Web) into standard APIs. It supports both OpenAI and Anthropic protocols, image input, streaming, and tool calls, with a visual config UI for seamless integration with clients like Cursor.

metadata.name: codex-plugin-cc
metadata.description: Use Codex from Claude Code to review code or delegate tasks.

summary.zh: 该插件让 Claude Code 用户无需切换环境即可调用 OpenAI Codex 进行代码审查与任务委派，支持常规/对抗性审查、后台运行及任务管理，提升多 AI 协作效率。要求 Node.js 18+ 与 ChatGPT 订阅或 API 密钥。
summary.en: This plugin allows Claude Code users to invoke OpenAI Codex for code reviews and task delegation without switching environments. It supports normal and adversarial reviews, background execution, and job management, enhancing multi-AI collaboration. Requires Node.js 18+ and a ChatGPT subscription or API key.

metadata.name: Practical-Guide-to-Context-Engineering
metadata.description: 大模型应用开发的方向，上下文工程是设计原则，Agent Harness 是构建目标，本项目的目标，是为开发者和研究者提供一份大模型应用开发的骨架思路

summary.zh: 面向大模型应用开发者的上下文工程与Agent Harness实践指南，系统阐述在有限上下文窗口中组织信息的方法论，涵盖与RAG、提示词工程的差异及Agent运行空间设计，提供从理念到落地的骨架思路。
summary.en: A practical guide for LLM application developers on Context Engineering and Agent Harness, detailing methods for organizing information within limited context windows, differences from RAG and prompt engineering, and designing agent runtime environments for stable high-quality output.

metadata.name: kiss-translator
metadata.description: A simple, open source bilingual translation extension & Greasemonkey script (一个简约、开源的 双语对照翻译扩展 & 油猴脚本)

summary.zh: KISS Translator 是一款开源的浏览器双语对照翻译扩展和油猴脚本，支持 Chrome、Firefox、Safari 等主流浏览器。集成多种翻译服务（如 Google、OpenAI、DeepL），提供网页全文翻译、划词翻译、字幕翻译等功能，并支持自定义规则与接口，简洁易用。
summary.en: KISS Translator is an open-source bilingual translation extension and userscript for browsers, supporting Chrome, Firefox, Safari, etc. It integrates multiple translation services (Google, OpenAI, DeepL) and offers full-page, selection, and subtitle translation, with custom rules and API support.

metadata.name: how-claude-code-works
metadata.description: Deep dive into Claude Code internals — architecture, agent loop, context engineering, and more. / 深入解析 Claude Code 源码：架构、Agent 循环、上下文工程、工具系统等

summary.zh: 本项目深入解析 Claude Code 的 50 万行 TypeScript 源码，提炼出 16 篇专题文档，涵盖系统架构、Agent 循环、上下文工程、工具系统、权限安全等关键设计。通过实际分析，揭示流式输出、工具预执行、渐进式压缩、静默恢复等生产级优化策略，为开发者打造自己的 AI 编程 Agent 提供宝贵参考。
summary.en: This project provides a deep dive into Claude Code's 500k-line TypeScript source code, distilling 16 thematic documents covering architecture, agent loop, context engineering, tool systems, and security. It reveals production-grade optimizations like streaming output, tool pre-execution, progressive compaction, and silent recovery, offering valuable insights for developers building their own AI coding agents.

metadata.name: cc-gateway
metadata.description: AI API identity gateway — reverse proxy that normalizes device fingerprints and telemetry for privacy-preserving API proxying

summary.zh: CC Gateway 是一个面向 AI API 的身份网关，通过反向代理归一化设备指纹、身份信息和遥测数据，保护用户隐私。它重写设备ID、环境变量、系统提示等40+维度，剥离计费头并标准化进程指标，支持集中式OAuth和零登录客户端，实现跨会话缓存共享，显著降低系统提示成本。
summary.en: CC Gateway is an identity gateway for AI APIs that preserves privacy via a reverse proxy normalizing device fingerprints, identities, and telemetry. It rewrites 40+ dimensions including device IDs, environment variables, and system prompts, strips billing headers, and masks process metrics. It supports centralized OAuth and zero-login clients for cross-session cache sharing and reduced costs.

metadata.name: claude-code-from-scratch
metadata.description: Build your own Claude Code from scratch.  🔍 Claude Code 开源了 50 万行代码，读不动？用 ~5000 行 TypeScript / Python 从零复现核心架构，11 章分步教程带你理解 coding agent 精髓

summary.zh: 该仓库用约5000行TypeScript/Python从零复现Claude Code核心架构，通过13章分步教程深入讲解Coding Agent原理，涵盖Agent循环、工具系统、上下文压缩、记忆、MCP集成等，无需API密钥即可运行。
summary.en: This repository reimplements the core architecture of Claude Code from scratch with approximately 5,000 lines of TypeScript and Python. Through a 13-chapter step-by-step tutorial, it reveals the inner workings of coding agents, covering agent loop, tool system, context compression, memory, multi-agent, and MCP integration. Every chapter runs with a single command and no API key required.

metadata.name: dbskill
metadata.description: dontbesilent 的商业诊断 Skills

summary.zh: dbskill 是面向创业者与内容创作者的中文 AI Skills 工具箱，内含 29 个可调用技能。基于 4176 条结构化知识原子，通过 /dbs 动态路由自动匹配商业诊断、内容优化、行动卡点等场景，输出可执行建议；支持本地知识库管理、决策记录与多 Agent 适配（豆包、Claude Code 等）。
summary.en: dbskill is a Chinese AI Skills toolbox for entrepreneurs and content creators, offering 29 callable skills. Built on 4,176 structured knowledge atoms, it uses a dynamic /dbs router to select the right skill for business diagnosis, content optimization, action planning, and knowledge management. It supports local knowledge bases, decision archives, and multiple AI agents such as Doubao, Claude Code, and Codex.

metadata.name: claude-code
metadata.description: 原汁原昧 Claude Code 可运行,可构建, 可调试版; 生产级工程化, 企业级可靠性; 安全无毒, 内存泄露修复

summary.zh: 完整复刻官方Claude Code的开源项目，无需登录即可使用，兼容原有配置。实现Goal持续驱动、多Agent编排、Artifacts共享、群控通信及ACP协议支持，并修复内存泄漏，生产级可靠性，适合作为AI编程助手与自动化工具。
summary.en: An open-source replication of Claude Code, usable without login and compatible with original configs. It offers Goal-driven execution, multi-agent orchestration, Artifacts sharing, swarm control, ACP support, and memory leak fixes, serving as a production-grade coding assistant and automation tool.

metadata.name: claude-code-book
metadata.description: 《御舆：解码 Agent Harness》42万字拆解 AI Agent 的Harness骨架与神经 —— Claude Code 架构深度剖析，15 章从对话循环到构建你自己的 Agent Harness。在线阅读网站：

summary.zh: 一本42万字的开源技术书籍，深度剖析Claude Code的Agent Harness架构，涵盖对话循环、工具系统、权限管线、上下文压缩等核心子系统，提炼50+设计决策，139张架构图，提供可迁移到任何Agent框架的认知模型。
summary.en: A 420,000-character open-source technical book that deconstructs the Agent Harness architecture of Claude Code, covering conversation loops, tool systems, permission pipelines, context compression, and more. It distills 50+ design decisions and 139 architecture diagrams, offering a mental model transferable to any agent framework.

metadata.name: ai-agent-deep-dive
metadata.description: AI Agent 源码深度研究报告

summary.zh: 本仓库是一份AI Agent源码深度研究报告，包含多版本PDF分析文档，深入解析Agent核心架构、记忆系统等关键主题。此外，还提供教学用最小Python Agent项目，清晰演示Agent主循环、Fake LLM接口、Skills发现与CLI骨架，帮助学习者快速理解AI Agent的组织方式与设计思路。
summary.en: This repository is a comprehensive deep-dive source code analysis report on AI Agents, featuring multiple PDF documents that thoroughly dissect core architecture, memory systems, and other critical components. In addition, it offers a minimal educational Python Agent project that clearly demonstrates the agent main loop, a replaceable fake LLM interface, skill discovery mechanisms, and a CLI skeleton. This project is intentionally designed to minimize engineering complexity, enabling learners to quickly grasp the essential structure and design philosophy of an AI Agent.

metadata.name: open-agent-sdk-typescript
metadata.description: Agent-SDK without CLI dependencies, as an alternative to claude-agent-sdk, completely open source

summary.zh: 开源TypeScript Agent SDK，摆脱CLI依赖，在进程内直接运行完整Agent循环。兼容Anthropic与OpenAI模型（GPT/DeepSeek等），支持流式输出、多轮对话、自定义工具与MCP协议，可部署到云端、Serverless或Docker，是轻量的Agent开发与自动化方案。
summary.en: An open-source TypeScript Agent SDK that runs the full agent loop in-process without CLI or subprocess. It supports Anthropic and OpenAI-compatible APIs, streaming, multi-turn conversations, custom tools with Zod schemas, and MCP servers. Deployable to cloud, serverless, Docker, and CI/CD environments.

metadata.name: claude-code-design-guide
metadata.description: From Early Internet Design Patterns to AI Agent Implementation — A Deep Dive into Claude Code for Developers

summary.zh: 本书深度解析Anthropic的Claude Code AI编程助手，从Unix哲学到Agent Runtime设计，涵盖工具系统、上下文工程、多代理架构、权限模型等，适合开发者与Agent设计者学习现代CLI与AI Agent工程实践。
summary.en: This book offers an in-depth analysis of Claude Code, Anthropic's AI coding assistant, from Unix philosophy to Agent Runtime design, covering tool systems, context engineering, multi-agent architecture, and permission models—a practical guide for developers and agent designers.

metadata.name: claw-code
metadata.description: An agent-managed museum exhibit, built in Rust with Gajae-Code / LazyCodex — developed and maintained with no human intervention.

summary.zh: Claw Code 是一个由 AI 智能体自主管理的博物馆级展品仓库，使用 Rust 语言并结合 Gajae-Code 与 LazyCodex 框架构建。整个项目从规划、执行到验证、标注及维护均由智能体自动完成，无需任何人工干预，生动展示了 AI 代理在软件全生命周期自治管理中的前沿能力。
summary.en: Claw Code is a museum-level exhibit repository autonomously managed by AI agents. Built in Rust with the Gajae-Code and LazyCodex frameworks, the entire lifecycle—from planning and execution to verification, labeling, and maintenance—is handled by agents without any human intervention, showcasing the cutting-edge capability of AI agents in fully autonomous software management.

metadata.name: AI-Search-Hub
metadata.description: One Query. All Search Skill. 聚合 Gemini、Grok、豆包、元宝等平台原生 AI 搜索能力，免费获取科技趋势、行业舆情、热点追踪、旅行规划、日常问题统一接进自己的 Agent 与工作流，指定链接免费爬取

summary.zh: AI Search Hub 是一个开源 Skill，聚合 Gemini、Grok、豆包、元宝等平台的 AI 原生搜索与网页抽取能力，统一封装为 Agent 可调用的搜索中枢。支持一次提问多平台分发、指定链接内容抓取与清洗整理，免费获取公众号、抖音、微博等数据，避免自建爬虫及风控维护，适用于舆情监控、热点追踪、旅行规划及工作流集成。
summary.en: AI Search Hub is an open-source skill that aggregates native AI search and web extraction capabilities from platforms like Gemini, Grok, Doubao, and Yuanbao into a unified search hub for agents. It enables one-query multi-platform distribution, link-based content crawling and cleaning, and free access to data from WeChat, Douyin, Weibo, etc., eliminating the need for custom scrapers and anti-bot maintenance. Ideal for trend monitoring, travel planning, and workflow integration.

metadata.name: learn-coding-agent
metadata.description: Research on Coding Agents

summary.zh: 一个聚焦 CLI Agent 架构的学习研究仓库，基于公开资料深度分析 Claude Code 的遥测隐私、隐藏功能、远程控制、工具系统与未来路线图，帮助开发者理解 Agent 内部机制与设计趋势，促进 Agent 技术学习与实践，仅供非商业研究。
summary.en: An educational research repository that dissects the architecture of Claude Code, a popular CLI agent, based exclusively on public documentation and community discussions. It provides deep technical analysis of telemetry and privacy policies, hidden features and codenames, undercover mode, remote-control mechanisms and kill switches, plus a roadmap of upcoming capabilities. The project examines the multi-layered tool system, permission flows, sub-agents, and progressive harness mechanisms. It aims to help developers understand how production-grade agent frameworks are designed and evolved, supporting learning and non-commercial technical research.

metadata.name: outlookEmailPlus
metadata.description: Outlookmail Plus: Designed Specifically for Registration  |  Outlookmail Plus：专为注册而生  |

summary.zh: OutlookMail Plus 是一款专为注册与验证场景打造的邮箱管理器。它支持一键复制邮箱、自动拉取验证邮件并提取验证码/链接，内置临时邮箱与自定义 IMAP 导入。提供自动化 API、邮箱池项目隔离、Webhook/Telegram 通知及浏览器扩展，帮助个人和团队高效完成批量注册与账号验证。
summary.en: OutlookMail Plus is an email manager specifically designed for registration and verification scenarios. It minimizes friction in sign-up flows by offering one-click email copying, automatic retrieval of latest verification emails, and regex-based/AI-enhanced extraction of verification codes or links. It supports importing Gmail, QQ, 163, and custom IMAP servers, plus a Cloudflare Workers-based disposable mailbox with multi-domain configuration and admin key encryption. The tool provides automation APIs, project-scoped email pool isolation, Telegram/Webhook notifications, and a Chrome/Edge browser extension for batch registration and account verification.

metadata.name: wechat-download-api
metadata.description: 一款完全开源的微信公众号文章获取、RSS 订阅 API 服务，支持整号文章一键导出 7 种格式（Markdown/HTML/Word/PDF/EPUB/Excel/JSON）、IP 代理池反风控、MCP 接入各种 AI Agent 工具。

summary.zh: 完全开源的微信公众号文章获取与RSS订阅API服务，支持扫码登录后抓取任意公众号历史文章，一键导出Markdown/HTML/Word/PDF/EPUB/Excel/JSON七种格式，内置Chrome TLS指纹模拟和代理池反风控，提供MCP服务可接入Claude、Cursor等AI智能体，支持Docker私有化部署。
summary.en: Fully open-source API service for fetching WeChat official account articles and generating RSS feeds. Supports scanning QR code to log in, retrieving historical articles from any account, and exporting in 7 formats (Markdown/HTML/Word/PDF/EPUB/Excel/JSON). Features Chrome TLS fingerprint simulation and proxy pool to avoid anti-crawling, plus an MCP server for AI agents like Claude and Cursor. Docker deployment supported.

metadata.name: skills-manager
metadata.description: A lightweight desktop app to manage, sync, and organize AI agent skills across 50+ coding tools — Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, Copilot, Gemini CLI, and more.

summary.zh: Skills Manager 是一款轻量级桌面应用，用于统一管理、组织和同步 AI 编码代理（如 Claude Code、Cursor 等 50+ 工具）的技能。支持从市场/Git/压缩包安装技能，预设分组，通过符号链接或复制一键同步到各工具，并提供全局、项目、链接工作区及多设备备份，提升 AI 工具链的可维护性。
summary.en: Skills Manager is a lightweight desktop app to centrally manage, organize, and sync AI agent skills across 50+ coding tools like Claude Code and Cursor. It supports installing skills from marketplaces, Git repos, or archives; grouping into presets; one-click syncing via symlink or copy; and offers global, project, linked workspaces plus multi-device backup for maintainable AI workflows.

metadata.name: claude-mem
metadata.description: Persistent Context Across Sessions for Every Agent –  Captures everything your agent does during sessions, compresses it with AI, and injects relevant context back into future sessions. Works with Claude Code, OpenClaw, Codex, Gemini, Hermes, Copilot, OpenCode + More

summary.zh: claude-mem是一个为AI智能体提供跨会话持久记忆的开源工具。它能自动捕获代理在会话中的全部操作，利用AI压缩成摘要，并在未来会话中智能注入相关上下文，从而显著提升多种AI编程助手的连续性和效率。支持Claude Code、Codex、Copilot等主流代理，是增强AI工作流的实用基础设施。
summary.en: claude-mem is an open-source tool that provides persistent memory across sessions for AI agents. It automatically captures all actions during a session, compresses them with AI, and injects relevant context into future sessions, significantly improving continuity and efficiency for various AI coding assistants. Compatible with Claude Code, Codex, Copilot, and more, it serves as essential infrastructure for enhancing AI workflows.

metadata.name: tavily-key-generator
metadata.description: Multi-service toolkit for Tavily and Firecrawl signup automation, key validation, and isolated proxy pools.

summary.zh: 该工具专注于自动注册Firecrawl、Exa等搜索API服务的密钥，通过真实浏览器操作、Turnstile验证码求解和邮箱验证码接收，实现批量生成并验证可用API Key，可选上传至统一代理池，作为MySearch-Proxy等统一搜索网关的上游，支持跨平台运行。
summary.en: This toolkit automates signup for search API services like Firecrawl and Exa, using real browser automation, Turnstile solving, and email verification to generate and validate API keys. It can upload valid keys to a unified proxy pool, serving as an upstream provider for MySearch-Proxy gateways. Cross-platform support.

summary.zh: LessAI 是一款基于 Tauri 2 的桌面端中文改写工作台，将改写流程化为可审阅、可回滚、可写回的步骤。支持导入 TXT/Markdown/DOCX/PDF 等格式，按小句/整句/段落切分文本，调用 OpenAI 兼容接口生成改写建议，以 Diff 时间线逐条审阅、应用或忽略，并支持断点续跑与一键写回原文件。适合文档去AI味、润色和一致性改写。
summary.en: LessAI is a desktop Chinese rewriting workbench built on Tauri 2, turning rewriting into a reviewable, rollbackable, and write-back workflow. It imports TXT/Markdown/DOCX/PDF files, splits text into sentences or paragraphs, and uses OpenAI-compatible APIs to generate suggestions. A Diff timeline supports per-item apply/ignore/delete, resumable processing, and one-click write-back to the original file. Ideal for de-AI-ing, polishing, and consistent rewriting of Chinese documents.

metadata.name: prompt-optimizer-studio
metadata.description: 可同时输入多个初版提示词，开启多轮自动优化，连续得到高分后得到最终结果。

summary.zh: Prompt Optimizer Studio是一款提示词自动优化工作台，支持输入多个初版提示词，通过多轮自动迭代与评分，生成可信赖的高质量最终prompt。它支持自托管部署，兼容OpenAI等多种模型提供商，并允许用户随时暂停、补充引导或修改规则，适合需要高效精细化提示词交付的AI开发与内容生产场景。
summary.en: Prompt Optimizer Studio is a workbench for automatic prompt optimization. It accepts multiple initial prompts and runs iterative rounds of scoring to produce trustworthy final prompts. The tool supports self-hosted deployment, works with OpenAI-compatible providers, and allows users to intervene with guidance or rules anytime. It suits AI developers and content teams seeking refined, production-ready prompts.

metadata.name: TavilyProxyManager
metadata.description: 一个透明的 Tavily API 反向代理：将多个 Tavily API Key（额度/credits）汇聚在一个 Master Key 之后，并提供内置 Web UI 用于管理 Key、用量与请求日志。

summary.zh: 将多个Tavily API Key汇聚于一个Master Key之后，提供透明反向代理与统一鉴权。内置Web管理面板，支持Key额度同步、用量图表、请求日志与自动故障切换。支持MCP端点，可无缝接入Claude、VS Code等AI工具，实现API资源池化与高效管理。
summary.en: An intelligent reverse proxy for Tavily API, aggregating multiple API keys under a single Master Key with unified authentication. It features a built-in web UI for key management, credit tracking, request logs, and auto failover. Supports MCP endpoint for seamless integration with AI tools like Claude and VS Code, enabling efficient API resource pooling.

metadata.name: claude-howto
metadata.description: A visual, example-driven guide to Claude Code — from basic concepts to advanced agents, with copy-paste templates that bring immediate value.

summary.zh: 这是一份以可视化与示例为驱动的 Claude Code 实战指南，覆盖从基础命令到高级智能体的全部特性，提供可复制的配置模板、Mermaid 图解与系统学习路径，并内置自测功能，帮助开发者在 11-13 小时内实现从新手到高手的进阶。
summary.en: Claude HowTo is a comprehensive, visual, and example-driven tutorial for Claude Code, designed to bridge the gap between official documentation and practical usage. It offers ten modules that progressively teach users from fundamental commands to complex agent teams, leveraging copy-paste configuration templates, Mermaid diagrams for understanding internal workings, and an interactive self-assessment system to personalize the learning journey. The guide helps developers unlock the full potential of Claude Code, transforming them from novices to advanced users in just 11-13 hours.

metadata.name: rhzl-Agentic-Design-Patterns-cn
metadata.description: 智能体设计模式

summary.zh: 该项目是《Agentic Design Patterns》的中英文对照翻译版，系统介绍智能体设计的核心与高级模式，包括提示链、路由、并行化、反思、工具使用、规划、多智能体协作等，并提供实践指南，适合AI开发者和研究者学习参考。
summary.en: This project is a bilingual Chinese-English translation of "Agentic Design Patterns", covering core and advanced patterns of agent design, including prompt chaining, routing, parallelization, reflection, tool use, planning, and multi-agent collaboration, serving as a practical guide for AI developers and researchers.

metadata.name: read-frog
metadata.description: 🐸 Read Frog - Language Learning & Translate | 🐸 陪读蛙 - 语言学习与翻译

summary.zh: Read Frog（陪读蛙）是一款开源的AI语言学习浏览器扩展，支持沉浸式双语翻译、划词翻译、上下文感知翻译、字幕翻译及TTS朗读。集成20多种AI提供商，支持批量请求，帮助用户在浏览网页时轻松高效地掌握外语。
summary.en: Read Frog is an open-source AI-powered browser extension for language learning, featuring immersive bilingual translation, selection translation, context-aware translation, subtitle translation, and TTS. It integrates 20+ AI providers and batch requests, enabling effortless language mastery while browsing.

metadata.name: ai-job
metadata.description: 找工作，用AI工作猎手！让AI帮您找工作！【DeepSeek+ChatGpt】赋能，ai助理作为您的求职者分身7*24小时在线找工作，并结合您的简历信息定制化回复。批量投递，自动发送简历，交换联系方式。hr拒绝挽留。高意向邮件通知，让您不错过每一份工作机会。BOSS直聘

summary.zh: AI工作猎手是一款面向BOSS直聘的求职自动化工具，基于DeepSeek与ChatGPT构建AI求职分身，实现7×24小时自动投递简历、智能回复HR消息、批量沟通与高意向职位邮件通知。采用油猴脚本注入前端，Spring Boot后端集成Spring AI及支付宝支付，支持个人自用或商业部署，显著提升求职效率。
summary.en: AI Job Hunter is a job-seeking automation tool for BOSS Zhipin, leveraging DeepSeek and ChatGPT to create an AI agent that works 24/7. It auto-submits resumes, intelligently replies to HR messages, batch-communicates, and sends email alerts for high-intent jobs. Built with a Tampermonkey script and Spring Boot backend, it supports personal use or commercial deployment, greatly improving job hunting efficiency.

metadata.name: MODULAR-RAG-MCP-SERVER
metadata.description: A modular RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation) system with MCP Server architecture. Using Skill to make AI follow each step of the spec and complete the code 100% by AI.

summary.zh: 模块化RAG服务基于MCP协议暴露工具接口，支持混合检索、重排、多模态图描述、RAG评估与全链路追踪。可插拔架构灵活适配业务。Skill驱动实现AI自动编码与测试。既是实战项目，也是面试教学资源。
summary.en: Modular RAG service exposes tools via MCP protocol, featuring hybrid search, reranking, multimodal captioning, RAG evaluation, and end-to-end tracing. Pluggable architecture adapts to business quickly. Skill-driven automation enables AI coding and testing. A practical project and interview resource.

metadata.name: biliup
metadata.description: 自动直播录制、投稿、twitch、ytb频道搬运工具。命令行投稿(B站)和视频下载工具，提供多种登录方式，支持多p。

summary.zh: B站自动化直播录制与投稿工具，支持Twitch、YouTube频道搬运。基于Rust与Next.js构建，提供可视化WebUI，支持多种登录方式、多P上传与无人值守运行，可作为命令行工具集成到自动化流程中。
summary.en: Automated live stream recording and video uploading tool for Bilibili, supporting channel migration from Twitch and YouTube. Built with Rust and Next.js, it offers a WebUI, multiple login methods, multi-part upload, and unattended operation, usable as a CLI automation component.

metadata.name: vphone-aio
metadata.description: 1 script run the vphone

summary.zh: 该仓库提供一键脚本，用于在macOS上运行iOS 26.1的vphone虚拟设备，已预越狱并安装完整bootstrap。用户只需安装依赖、关闭SIP并执行脚本，即可自动合并分卷、解压并启动，通过VNC连接使用。
summary.en: This repository provides a one-click script to run a jailbroken vphone (iOS 26.1) with full bootstrap on macOS. It automates downloading, merging split archives, extracting, and launching the virtual device, accessible via VNC.

metadata.name: DataAgent
metadata.description: Spring AI Alibaba DataAgent

summary.zh: 基于Spring AI Alibaba的企业级智能数据分析Agent，支持Text-to-SQL、Python深度分析、智能报告生成、MCP服务器及RAG增强，兼容OpenAI接口，可灵活接入向量数据库，为私有化部署提供可控的数据洞察服务。
summary.en: An enterprise-grade intelligent data analysis agent built on Spring AI Alibaba, featuring Text-to-SQL, Python deep analysis, report generation, MCP server, and RAG enhancement. It supports OpenAI-compatible APIs and flexible vector database integration for private deployment and controllable data insights.

metadata.name: rustlings
metadata.description: :crab: Small exercises to get you used to reading and writing Rust code!

summary.zh: Rustlings 是一套小型 Rust 编程练习，帮助初学者通过动手实践熟悉 Rust 语法与特性，与官方 Rust 书籍配套使用。提供交互式练习环境，适合自学、教学和社区培训，是 Rust 入门的高质量辅助工具。
summary.en: Rustlings is a collection of small Rust exercises designed to help beginners get comfortable with reading and writing Rust code. It complements the official Rust book with interactive practice, making it an excellent hands-on tool for self-learners, instructors, and community workshops.

metadata.name: astro-paper
metadata.description: A minimal, accessible and SEO-friendly Astro blog theme.

summary.zh: AstroPaper 是一款基于 Astro 的极简、响应式、无障碍且 SEO 友好的博客主题。它支持 MDX、深色模式、Pagefind 静态搜索、RSS 订阅、动态 OG 图片生成等功能，并具备高可定制性和多语言（i18n）支持。适合开发者快速搭建高性能个人博客。
summary.en: AstroPaper is a minimal, responsive, accessible, and SEO-friendly blog theme built with Astro. It features MDX support, dark mode, Pagefind static search, RSS feed, dynamic OG image generation, and high customizability with i18n readiness. Ideal for developers seeking a fast, performant personal blog.

metadata.name: claude-hud
metadata.description: A Claude Code plugin that shows what's happening - context usage, active tools, running agents, and todo progress

summary.zh: Claude HUD 是一个 Claude Code 插件，利用原生状态行 API 在终端实时显示上下文占用、工具调用、子代理状态和待办进度，让开发者精准掌握会话资源使用情况，无需额外窗口和 tmux，轻量且跨终端。
summary.en: Claude HUD is a plugin for Claude Code that leverages the native statusline API to display real-time context usage, tool activity, running subagents, and todo progress directly below the input line. It provides developers with instant visibility into session health without requiring additional windows or tmux, making it lightweight and compatible with any terminal. The plugin uses token data reported by Claude Code itself, ensuring accuracy, and automatically scales with context window sizes up to 1M. It also supports customization to show project path, git branch, and rate limits, enhancing developer workflow during complex coding tasks.

metadata.name: mini-redis
metadata.description: Incomplete Redis client and server implementation using Tokio - for learning purposes only

summary.zh: 基于 Tokio 的迷你 Redis 客户端/服务器实现，专为教学而设计，通过完整示例展示 Rust 异步编程、TCP 服务、状态共享等模式，支持常用命令，适合学习 Tokio 与网络编程。
summary.en: A minimal Redis client and server built with Tokio, intended as a learning resource. It demonstrates async Rust patterns like TCP servers, shared state, and client libraries, supporting basic commands.

metadata.name: tabby
metadata.description: Self-hosted AI coding assistant

summary.zh: Tabby是自托管的AI编程助手，作为GitHub Copilot的开源替代品。它无需数据库或云服务即可独立运行，提供OpenAPI接口便于集成，并支持消费级GPU。适用于代码补全、聊天问答等场景，帮助团队在私有环境中安全地使用AI辅助开发。
summary.en: Tabby is a self-hosted AI coding assistant, serving as an open-source alternative to GitHub Copilot. It runs without a database or cloud service, offers an OpenAPI interface for easy integration, and supports consumer-grade GPUs. Ideal for code completion and chat Q&A, enabling secure AI-assisted development in private environments.

metadata.name: Agent-Reach
metadata.description: Give your AI agent eyes to see the entire internet. Read & search Twitter, Reddit, YouTube, GitHub, Bilibili, XiaoHongShu — one CLI, zero API fees.

summary.zh: Agent Reach 为 AI Agent 提供统一的命令行接口，使其无需付费 API 即可读取和搜索 Twitter、Reddit、YouTube、GitHub、Bilibili、小红书等主流平台内容。项目自动处理登录、反爬和验证码等障碍，简化 AI 联网能力集成，显著降低智能体获取实时互联网数据的门槛。
summary.en: Agent Reach provides AI agents with a unified CLI to read and search content across Twitter, Reddit, YouTube, GitHub, Bilibili, and Xiaohongshu without paying API fees. It handles logins, anti-scraping, and captchas for you, making it effortless to give your agents internet access.

metadata.name: docker_practice
metadata.description: 最新Docker容器技术，从真实案例中学习最佳实践！| Learn and understand Docker&Container technologies, with real DevOps practice!

summary.zh: 本书是Docker容器技术的系统性教程，从基础概念到高级应用，涵盖镜像、容器、仓库、Dockerfile、Compose、Kubernetes等，并提供安全、监控及CI/CD实战案例，适合运维、开发及架构师学习。
summary.en: This book is a systematic tutorial on Docker container technology, covering fundamentals to advanced topics including images, containers, registries, Dockerfile, Compose, and Kubernetes. It provides practical cases on security, monitoring, and CI/CD, suitable for operators, developers, and architects.

metadata.name: metapi
metadata.description: 把你在各处注册的 New API / One API / OneHub / DoneHub / Veloera / AnyRouter / Sub2API 等站点， 汇聚成 一个 API Key、一个入口，自动发现模型、智能路由、成本最优

summary.zh: Metapi 是面向 AI 中转站的元聚合层，将 New API、One API 等分散站点统一为一个 API Key 和入口。它自动发现模型、智能路由并优化成本，支持多下游 API Key 策略，使 Cursor、Claude Code 等工具无缝接入，兼容 OpenAI/Claude/Gemini 等协议。
summary.en: Metapi is a meta-aggregation layer for AI relay stations, unifying scattered services like New API and One API into a single API key and endpoint. It auto-discovers models, smartly routes requests, optimizes costs, supports multiple downstream keys, and lets tools like Cursor and Claude Code seamlessly access all models.

metadata.name: deer-flow
metadata.description: An open-source long-horizon SuperAgent harness that researches, codes, and creates. With the help of sandboxes, memories, tools, skill, subagents and message gateway, it handles different levels of tasks that could take minutes to hours.

summary.zh: DeerFlow是字节跳动开源的长周期超级智能体框架，通过编排子代理、记忆与沙箱环境，自动完成从深度研究到代码生成的复杂任务。其核心优势在于模块化技术栈与可扩展技能体系，能处理耗时数分钟至数小时的多步任务，适合自动化研究、开发与内容创作等场景。
summary.en: DeerFlow is an open-source long-horizon super agent harness from ByteDance that orchestrates sub-agents, memory, and sandboxes to automate complex tasks from deep research to code generation. Its modular tech stack and extensible skills handle multi-step tasks lasting minutes to hours, ideal for automated research, development, and content creation.

metadata.name: eino
metadata.description: The ultimate LLM/AI application development framework in Go.

summary.zh: Eino是Go语言打造的高性能LLM应用开发框架，融合LangChain与Google ADK设计理念。提供ChatModel、Tool、Retriever等可复用组件，内置Agent开发套件，支持工具调用、多智能体协作、中断恢复等人机交互能力，并可通过图编排构建复杂工作流。适用于快速构建对话机器人、自动化执行等AI应用，兼具云端高性能与工程化便利。
summary.en: Eino is a high-performance LLM application development framework written in Go, inspired by LangChain and Google ADK. It provides reusable components including ChatModel, Tool, Retriever, and ChatTemplate, with official implementations for OpenAI, Ollama, and more. The Agent Development Kit supports tool calling, multi-agent collaboration, context management, and interrupt/resume for human-in-the-loop. Graph composition enables standalone workflows or exposing them as agent tools. Ideal for building conversational agents, automation pipelines, and complex AI systems in a cloud-native, engineering-friendly manner.

metadata.name: Codex-Manager
metadata.description: 一个Codex cli 账号管理与切换工具。为 Codex cli提供本地网关转发。

summary.zh: CodexManager是一款本地桌面端与服务进程协同的Codex CLI账号管理器，支持账号池统一管理、用量统计、平台Key配置，并提供本地网关转发能力。开发者可无缝切换多账号，提升Codex CLI使用效率。技术亮点包括本地网关代理与跨平台支持。
summary.en: CodexManager is a local desktop and service process manager for Codex CLI accounts, offering centralized account pool management, usage tracking, and platform key configuration, along with local gateway forwarding. It enables seamless multi-account switching for developers, boosting Codex CLI productivity. Key highlights include local gateway proxy and cross-platform support.

metadata.name: CliproxyAccountCleaner
metadata.description: 一个用于CLI Proxy API 批量账号管理的工具：Cliproxy Account Cleaner

summary.zh: 面向CLIProxy管理端的账号巡检与批量清理工具，支持桌面、Web和CLI三种模式及Docker部署。可检测401无效与额度耗尽，自动执行联合检测，支持关闭、删除、恢复账号等批量操作，并具备备用池与活跃数补齐机制，适合服务器与容器环境。
summary.en: A batch account management tool for CLIProxy admin, featuring desktop, web and CLI modes with Docker deployment. It performs 401 and quota checks, auto inspects accounts, and supports batch operations like close/delete/restore, plus a backup pool to maintain active account count. Ideal for server/container environments.

metadata.name: ccg-workflow
metadata.description: 多模型协作工作流引擎 — /ccg:go 一个命令，AI 自动分析意图、选择策略、编排 Codex + Gemini + Claude 协作执行

summary.zh: CCG 是一个基于 Claude Code 的多模型协作工作流引擎，通过 /ccg:go 一条命令自动分析意图、选择策略，并编排 Codex、Gemini 与 Claude 并行分析、独立实施和最终审查，实现复杂开发任务的自动化。
summary.en: CCG is a workflow engine built on Claude Code that orchestrates multiple AI models. A single /ccg:go command triggers intent analysis, strategy selection, and task creation, then dispatches Codex and Gemini for parallel analysis while Claude handles execution and review—automating complex development workflows.

metadata.name: cursor2api-go
metadata.description: Free gemini-3-flash  | cursor不倒我不倒🙏 ❌ 这次倒下啦

summary.zh: 本项目是一个基于Go语言的高性能API转换服务，将Cursor Web端能力封装为OpenAI chat/completions兼容接口，支持gemini-3-flash及其thinking衍生模型，具备流式响应、工具调用、API密钥认证和健康检查功能，可通过Docker、systemd或本地脚本快速部署。
summary.en: A high-performance Go service that converts Cursor Web into an OpenAI-compatible chat/completions API, supporting gemini-3-flash and derived thinking models, with streaming, tool calls, API key auth, health checks, and easy deployment via Docker or systemd.

metadata.name: all-api-hub
metadata.description: All-in-one New-API/Sub2API account hub: balance/usage dashboard, auto check-in, one-click keys, price comparison, health checks, plus advanced channel management | 一站式 New-API/Sub2API 等中转站账号管理：余额/用量看板、自动签到、密钥一键使用、价格对比、可用性测试，另提供高级渠道管理

summary.zh: All API Hub 是一款浏览器扩展，一站式管理多个 New-API/Sub2API 中转站账号。它提供余额与用量看板、自动签到、API 密钥管理、跨站价格对比、可用性测试等功能，并支持高级渠道管理与模型同步重定向，帮助用户高效管理 AI 资产、节省成本。
summary.en: All API Hub is a browser extension for one-stop management of New-API/Sub2API relay accounts. It offers a balance and usage dashboard, auto check-in, API credential library, cross-site price comparison, health checks, and advanced channel management, enabling users to efficiently manage AI assets and reduce costs.

metadata.name: gstack
metadata.description: Use Garry Tan's exact Claude Code setup: 23 opinionated tools that serve as CEO, Designer, Eng Manager, Release Manager, Doc Engineer, and QA

summary.zh: gstack 将 Claude Code 变成虚拟工程团队，用 23 个斜杠命令扮演 CEO、设计、QA 等角色，自动化规划、审查、测试和发布。让个人开发者以团队速度交付，适合创始人与新手，开源免费。
summary.en: gstack is Garry Tan's open-source configuration for Claude Code that turns it into a virtual engineering team. It provides 23 opinionated slash-command tools impersonating roles like CEO, Designer, Engineering Manager, Release Manager, Doc Engineer, and QA. These commands streamline product planning, architecture decisions, code review, real-browser QA testing, security audits, and release management. As a result, a single developer can ship products with the efficiency of a full team. Free and MIT-licensed, it is ideal for founders, tech leads, and first-time Claude Code users.

metadata.name: GithubStarsIndex
metadata.description: 自动抓取 GitHub Stars，生成 AI 摘要，便于检索。

summary.zh: 自动抓取GitHub Stars仓库，调用AI为每个项目生成内容摘要与标准化标签，支持标签合并、增量更新与并发调用。基于GitHub Actions定时运行，可将结果推送至Obsidian和GitHub Pages，实现多语言检索，是开发者整理收藏的高效工具。
summary.en: Automatically fetches GitHub starred repos and uses AI to generate summaries and standardized tags for each, with label normalization, incremental updates, and concurrent calls. Running on GitHub Actions, it syncs results to Obsidian and GitHub Pages for multilingual searchable archives, helping developers efficiently manage their saved repositories.

metadata.name: QwenPaw
metadata.description: Your Personal AI Assistant; easy to install, deploy on your own machine or on the cloud; supports multiple chat apps with easily extensible capabilities.

summary.zh: QwenPaw 是一款易安装、易扩展的个人AI助手框架，支持本地或云端一键部署，可灵活接入多种聊天应用。基于通义千问大模型，提供技能与插件机制，让用户能打造真正随行随长的智能伙伴，满足个性化与场景化需求。
summary.en: QwenPaw is a personal AI assistant that is easy to install and deploy either on your own machine or in the cloud. It supports multiple chat applications and offers extensible capabilities through skills and plugins. Built on Qwen large language models, it provides a flexible and scalable solution for building personalized AI companions that work across platforms and adapt to user needs. With one-command deployment and a user-friendly design, QwenPaw empowers both developers and end users to create their own intelligent assistants quickly and efficiently, making advanced AI accessible to everyone.

summary.zh: 个人CFP考试备考仓库。通过Claude Code构建AI辅导系统，采用苏格拉底式提问法，在23次学习会话中覆盖73个考点，掌握率82%，最终通过考试。仓库包含每日学习记录、进度追踪器和AI导师配置，支持个性化复习，展示了AI辅助专业考试的高效学习方法。
summary.en: Personal study repository for CFP exam preparation. Used Claude Code as an AI tutor with Socratic questioning. Through 23 sessions, mastered 60/73 topics (82%) and passed the exam. Includes session logs, progress tracker, and AI tutor instructions for personalized review. Demonstrates effective AI-guided learning for professional certifications.

metadata.name: FeHelper
metadata.description: 😍FeHelper--Web前端助手（Awesome！Chrome & Firefox & MS-Edge Extension, All in one Toolbox!）

summary.zh: FeHelper是一个集成30+常用工具的跨浏览器扩展，为开发者、测试和运营提供JSON格式化、编解码、二维码、网页截图、接口调试、AI助手等一站式功能，支持Chrome/Edge/Firefox，基于Manifest V3，自2012年持续维护。
summary.en: FeHelper is a cross-browser extension integrating 30+ handy tools for developers, testers, and operators. It offers JSON formatting, encoding/decoding, QR codes, web page screenshots, API debugging, and AI assistant, all in one toolbox. Supports Chrome, Edge, and Firefox with Manifest V3, maintained since 2012.

metadata.name: octopus
metadata.description: One Hub All LLMs For You | 为个人打造的 LLM API 聚合网关

summary.zh: Octopus 是一款为个人打造的 LLM API 聚合网关，支持多通道、多 Key 管理与自动负载均衡，智能选择最低延迟端点。兼容 OpenAI 与 Anthropic 协议，自动同步模型与价格，并提供请求统计和成本追踪。拥有优雅的 Web 管理面板，支持 SQLite、MySQL、PostgreSQL，可通过 Docker 快速部署。
summary.en: Octopus is a personal LLM API aggregation gateway that unifies multiple providers with multi-key support, smart latency-based selection, and load balancing. It converts between OpenAI and Anthropic protocols, syncs models and pricing automatically, and offers analytics for tokens and costs. With an elegant web UI and SQLite/MySQL/PostgreSQL support, it can be deployed easily via Docker.

metadata.name: proxypal
metadata.description: A desktop app that lets you use your AI subscriptions (Claude, ChatGPT, Gemini, GitHub Copilot) with any coding tool. Wraps CLIProxyAPI with a clean UI for managing connections and tracking usage.

summary.zh: ProxyPal是一款跨平台桌面应用，将Claude、ChatGPT、Gemini、GitHub Copilot等AI订阅统一代理为OpenAI兼容API，支持连接管理、请求监控与用量分析。基于Tauri v2和Rust构建，轻量高效，可自动配置Cursor、Claude Code等编码工具，实现一处订阅、随处使用。
summary.en: ProxyPal is a cross-platform desktop app that unifies AI subscriptions (Claude, ChatGPT, Gemini, GitHub Copilot) into an OpenAI-compatible proxy. Built with Tauri v2 and Rust, it offers connection management, request monitoring, and usage analytics. Auto-configures popular coding tools like Cursor and Claude Code, enabling seamless use of existing subscriptions anywhere.

metadata.name: SuperCmd
metadata.description: Powerful MacOS Launcher

summary.zh: SuperCmd是一款开源的macOS启动器，融合Raycast扩展兼容、语音输入、文本朗读、AI聊天与记忆、剪贴板历史、窗口管理等功能。基于Electron和React，通过Swift/Objective-C桥接原生API，支持直接安装Raycast扩展及导入备份，提供高效键盘驱动的操作体验。
summary.en: SuperCmd is an open-source macOS launcher combining Raycast-compatible extensions, voice dictation, text-to-speech, AI chat with memory, clipboard history, and window management. Built with Electron and React, it leverages native Swift/Objective-C bridges for deep system integration. It supports importing Raycast backups and running extensions directly.

metadata.name: claude-code-best-practice
metadata.description: from vibe coding to agentic engineering - practice makes claude perfect

summary.zh: 本仓库系统整理了 Claude Code 的最佳实践，涵盖子代理、命令、技能、钩子与编排流程等核心功能，提供从“随性编码”到“智能体工程”的进阶指南，帮助开发者高效构建和管理 AI 编程工作流。
summary.en: This repository is a comprehensive guide to Claude Code best practices, covering subagents, commands, skills, hooks, and orchestration workflows. It serves as a practical playbook for developers transitioning from casual vibe coding to disciplined agentic engineering. With implemented examples and production-ready patterns, it shows how to structure AI coding workflows for maximum reliability and scalability. Whether you are new to Claude Code or an advanced user, this repo offers actionable advice to make Claude Code perfect for your projects.

summary.zh: AI Agent技能集，适配Claude Code/Codex。含20+技能，覆盖封面生成、文章插图、微信发布，可快速将草稿转为结构化Markdown并一键发布，提升内容创作与办公效率。支持npx安装与插件市场。
summary.en: This repository provides a collection of AI Agent skills shared by Baoyu, designed to enhance daily work efficiency with coding agents such as Claude Code and Codex. The 20+ installable skills cover scenarios like cover image generation, article illustration, and WeChat Official Account publishing. Users can quickly convert raw drafts into well-structured Markdown and publish them with a single click, significantly improving content creation and office productivity. It supports both npx-based installation and plugin marketplace registration, making it flexible and lightweight.

metadata.name: Resin
metadata.description: A high-performance proxy pool gateway. Turn massive proxy subscriptions into a stable, smart, and observable network with sticky sessions.

summary.zh: Resin 是基于 Go 的高性能代理池网关，将海量代理订阅聚合成稳定、智能、可观测的统一入口；提供粘性会话确保业务账号固定出口 IP，并具备健康检查、故障转移、节点去重与热重载，支持 WebUI 可视化管理与审计。
summary.en: Resin is Go-based proxy pool gateway for massive subscriptions with sticky sessions, health checks, observable WebUI.

metadata.name: Thaw
metadata.description: The menu bar manager for macOS

summary.zh: Thaw 是一款 macOS 菜单栏管理工具，帮助用户整理图标、隐藏不常用项并快速访问。支持20种语言，界面简洁，功能强大。项目重视安全与稳定性，遵循 OpenSSF 最佳实践，并通过 SLSA 3 构建保证，适合追求高效桌面环境的用户。
summary.en: Thaw is a menu bar manager for macOS designed to help users organize and declutter their menu bar icons. It allows customizing layouts, hiding rarely used items, and enabling fast access, all through a sleek and intuitive interface. With support for 20 languages, it caters to a global audience. Built with modern macOS technologies, Thaw prioritizes security and reliability, adhering to OpenSSF best practices and achieving SLSA Level 3 build guarantees. This makes it a top choice for users seeking a clean and productive desktop environment.

metadata.name: grok2api
metadata.description: Multi-account API gateway for Grok Build, Grok Web, and Grok Console

summary.zh: Grok2API 是一个基于 Go 和 React 构建的多账户 API 网关，统一封装 Grok Build、Grok Web 和 Grok Console 接口，支持多账号轮询、负载均衡及 Docker 部署，帮助开发者轻松将 Grok 能力集成到自身应用中，适用于需要高并发、稳定访问 Grok 服务的场景。
summary.en: Grok2API is a multi-account API gateway built with Go and React, unifying Grok Build, Grok Web, and Grok Console interfaces. It supports account rotation, load balancing, and Docker deployment, enabling developers to seamlessly integrate Grok capabilities into applications for high-concurrency, stable access.

summary.zh: Aether 是一个自托管的 AI API 网关，统一接入 Claude、OpenAI、Gemini 等主流大模型及其 CLI，提供格式转换、正反向代理。具备多租户管理、智能负载均衡、成本配额与健康监控能力，支持 Docker Compose 和 systemd 等部署方式，适合团队构建 AI 服务底座。
summary.en: Aether is a self-hosted AI API gateway that unifies access to Claude, OpenAI, Gemini, and their CLIs, with format conversion and forward/reverse proxying. It features multi-tenancy, intelligent load balancing, cost quotas, and health monitoring, deployable via Docker Compose or systemd for teams building AI infrastructure.

metadata.name: GrokSearch
metadata.description: Integrate Grok's powerful real-time search capabilities into Claude via the MCP protocol!

summary.zh: GrokSearch是一个基于FastMCP的MCP服务器，通过双引擎架构集成Grok智能搜索与Tavily网页抓取，为Claude等LLM客户端提供实时网络访问能力，支持自动降级到Firecrawl、OpenAI兼容接口和智能重试，显著降低模型幻觉率。
summary.en: GrokSearch is an MCP server built on FastMCP that combines Grok AI search and Tavily web extraction in a dual-engine architecture, providing real-time network access for LLM clients like Claude. It features automatic fallback to Firecrawl, OpenAI-compatible interface, and smart retry, effectively reducing hallucination rates.

metadata.name: HaloWebUI
metadata.description: 基于官方OpenWebUI，汉化界面提高中文使用体验，增加了模型计费和用量统计

summary.zh: HaloWebUI 是基于 Open WebUI 深度定制的自托管 AI 平台，全面汉化界面以提升中文用户体验，内置 HaloClaw 消息网关，原生集成多款主流大模型，并新增模型计费与用量统计功能，适用于企业和团队统一管理 AI 服务。
summary.en: HaloWebUI is a self-hosted AI platform deeply customized from Open WebUI, featuring a fully localized Chinese interface for enhanced user experience. It integrates multiple mainstream LLMs through the HaloClaw message gateway, and adds model billing and usage statistics, making it ideal for enterprises and teams to centrally manage AI services.

metadata.name: easy_proxies
metadata.description: A proxy node pool management tool based on sing-box, supporting multiple protocols, automatic failover and load balancing.  基于 sing-box 的代理节点池管理工具，支持多协议、多节点自动故障转移和负载均衡。

summary.zh: 基于 sing-box 的代理节点池管理工具，聚合多协议上游节点为稳定的本地代理入口。支持自动健康检查、故障转移与负载均衡，提供多端口、混合、GeoIP 路由、粘性会话、订阅热更新，并配有 WebUI 仪表盘和 REST API。
summary.en: A sing-box based proxy pool manager that aggregates upstream proxy nodes into a stable, health-checked, load-balanced local endpoint. Supports multiple protocols, runtime modes, automatic failover, GeoIP routing, sticky sessions, subscription auto-refresh, WebUI dashboard, and REST API. Ideal for resilient egress and node failover.

metadata.name: LifeOS
metadata.description: ⛰️ The Life Operating System — an intent engineering platform that moves you from your current state to your ideal state, in life and work.

summary.zh: LifeOS是一个通用AI智能体框架，通过捕获用户的身份、价值观与目标，构建从当前状态到理想状态的行动路径。它整合个人全面上下文，赋能应用开发、创业及创意项目等场景，提升效率与效果。项目采用TypeScript与Bun构建，开源免费，可由AI自动安装配置，并内置Pulse功能。
summary.en: LifeOS is a general-purpose AI agent harness that captures who you are, what you care about, and where you're going, then uses AI to help you move from current state to ideal state. It leverages full personal context to boost efficiency across app development, business, and creative projects. Built with TypeScript and Bun, it's open-source, free, and AI-installable.

metadata.name: Kiro-Go
metadata.description: 🚀 Convert Kiro accounts into OpenAI/Anthropic APIs. Features multi-account pooling, streaming, auto token refresh, and a web admin panel.

summary.zh: Kiro-Go 是一个基于 Go 的高性能 API 网关，将 Kiro 账户无缝转换为 OpenAI/Anthropic 兼容接口，支持多账户轮询、自动令牌刷新、SSE 流式输出及 Web 管理面板，可快速部署为自托管 AI 服务网关，适用于团队共享订阅、跨平台集成与多协议认证场景。
summary.en: Kiro-Go is a Go-based API gateway that converts Kiro accounts into OpenAI/Anthropic-compatible endpoints, featuring multi-account pooling, automatic token refresh, SSE streaming, and a web admin panel. It enables self-hosted AI gateways for team subscription sharing, cross-platform integration, and multi-auth support.

metadata.name: mindpocket
metadata.description: Open-source, free, multi-platform, one-click deploy, AI Agent–integrated personal bookmarking system｜完全开源、免费、多端、一键部署、AI Agent 集成的个人收藏夹系统

summary.zh: MindPocket 是一款完全开源、免费、多平台且支持一键部署的个人书签管理系统，基于 Cloudflare Workers 实现零成本运行。内置 AI 智能体，通过 RAG 技术对收藏内容进行智能摘要与自动标签，并提供 CLI 便于集成外部 Agent。用户数据完全自主掌控。
summary.en: MindPocket is a fully open-source, free, multi-platform personal bookmarking system that can be deployed to Cloudflare Workers with one click and runs entirely on the free tier. Featuring an integrated AI Agent, it uses RAG technology to automatically summarize saved content and generate tags. The system includes Web, mobile, and browser extension clients, and offers a CLI for integration with external agents like OpenClaw. Moreover, it is serverless and requires no server maintenance, ensuring zero cost. Your data stays yours with full control.

metadata.name: Humanizer-zh
metadata.description: Humanizer 的汉化版本，Claude Code Skills，旨在消除文本中 AI 生成的痕迹。

summary.zh: Humanizer-zh 是 Claude Code 的汉化技能，基于维基百科 AI 写作痕迹指南，检测并消除 AI 生成文本的机械感。适用于内容编辑、学术润色和写作优化，提供24种模式识别与改写建议，帮助用户产出更自然、具人类写作特征的文本。
summary.en: Humanizer-zh is a Chinese localized skill for Claude Code, designed to remove AI-generated traces from text. Based on Wikipedia's "Signs of AI writing" guide, it identifies 24 common AI writing patterns and provides actionable rewriting suggestions. This tool is ideal for editors, content reviewers, and writers who want to produce more natural, human-like prose while preserving original meaning. It is especially useful for academic writing, marketing copy, and blog posts, helping users avoid clichés and robotic phrasing. The skill includes quick checklists and quality scoring to ensure the final output reflects a genuine human voice.

metadata.name: lumina
metadata.description: An information management workspace.（信息管理工作台）

summary.zh: Lumina 是一个信息管理工作台，整合前端应用、后端服务和浏览器插件，支持一键捕获网页内容，利用人工智能生成摘要、翻译与相关推荐，提供沉浸式阅读、知识主题同步、专栏发布、评论协作及运维监控，适合高效管理个人阅读与知识资产。
summary.en: Lumina is an information management workspace integrating a web app, FastAPI backend, and browser extension. It allows one-click capture of full-page or selected web content, then leverages AI models to generate summaries, key points, translations, auto-classification, and similar-article recommendations. The system supports immersive reading with annotations and TOC, plus column publishing, collaborative commenting, optional knowledge graph topic syncing, and comprehensive admin monitoring, including background task timelines and usage metrics, making it a powerful tool for efficient personal knowledge management and deep reading.

metadata.name: freemail
metadata.description: Cloudflare 域名邮箱系统 临时邮箱系统  支持API 调用 支持多渠道发件 支持用户管理 domain mail tempmail

summary.zh: 开源的临时邮箱服务系统，基于Cloudflare Workers、D1与R2构建，前端后端分离。支持邮件实时接收、验证码提取、多渠道发件（Resend/SendFlare/Cyberpersons）、用户管理及RESTful API调用，可一键部署至Cloudflare生态。
summary.en: An open-source temporary email service built on Cloudflare Workers, D1, and R2 with a separated frontend and backend. It supports real-time email receiving, verification code extraction, multi-channel sending (Resend/SendFlare/Cyberpersons), user management, and RESTful API calls, enabling one-click deployment.

metadata.name: AWS-BuildID-Auto-For-Ext
metadata.description: ⚡ 一键自动化注册 AWS Builder ID 的浏览器扩展

summary.zh: 该浏览器扩展基于Chrome Manifest V3，实现AWS Builder ID的一键自动化注册。支持批量生成Gmail别名、无痕窗口隔离会话、Token自动获取与验证，并提供可视化状态管理和一键同步至Kiro IDE，适用于开发者快速获取和管理AWS Builder ID。
summary.en: This Chrome extension automates AWS Builder ID registration with Manifest V3. It supports batch Gmail alias generation, incognito window isolation, automatic token fetching and validation, visualized status management, and one-click sync to Kiro IDE, facilitating developers to obtain and manage AWS Builder IDs efficiently.

metadata.name: chinese-novelist-skill
metadata.description: 🎭 AI 驱动的中文小说创作助手。三层递进式智能问答、跨会话偏好记忆、中断续写、每章必留悬念钩子、自动校验修复。长篇小说一次性全稿无痛完成。    ⚡ 稳定写作，推荐 非线智能 API nonelinear.com 联系客服报 [写小说] 享20元额度

summary.zh: AI驱动的中文小说创作助手，面向长篇小说写作场景。通过三层递进式智能问答快速定位题材与设定，跨会话偏好记忆让创作更贴心，中断续写功能保障写作连续性。支持串行、并行、团队等写作模式，每章自动留悬念，完成校验不合格自动重写，实现全稿一次性无痛产出。
summary.en: An AI-driven Chinese novel writing assistant designed for full-length fiction. Three-tier progressive Q&A nails down genre and character setup, while cross-session preference memory personalizes creation. Interruption recovery ensures continuity, and supports serial/parallel/team writing modes. Each chapter ends with a hook, with auto-validation and rewriting for quality, enabling painless one-shot manuscript completion.

summary.zh: 基于FastAPI与Vue3构建的Google账号批量自动化管理系统，通过Playwright控制BitBrowser指纹浏览器，实现账号管理、2FA设置/重置、资格验证、年龄验证及卡片订阅绑定等功能，支持多任务并发与实时进度反馈，适用于大规模账号运营场景。
summary.en: A batch Google account automation system built with FastAPI and Vue3, using Playwright to control BitBrowser fingerprint browser. Features include account management, 2FA setup/reset, eligibility verification, age verification, and card binding/subscription. Supports concurrent tasks with real-time progress, ideal for large-scale account operations.

metadata.name: kiro-account-manager
metadata.description: 🚀 智能管理 Kiro IDE 账号，一键切换，配额监控 | 官网：https://kiro-website-six.vercel.app

summary.zh: Kiro Account Manager 是一款基于 Tauri 2.x 的跨平台桌面工具，专为 Kiro IDE 用户打造。它支持多账号导入、分组、一键切换与配额监控，自动刷新 Token，并能同步模型、代理等配置。内置 API 网关，兼容 Anthropic/OpenAI 协议，还支持机器 ID 绑定与应用内 OAuth 登录，大幅提升开发效率。
summary.en: Kiro Account Manager is a Tauri 2.x based cross-platform desktop tool designed for Kiro IDE users. It enables multi-account import, grouping, one-click switching, and quota monitoring, with automatic token refresh and config synchronization for models, proxies, and more. Built-in API gateway supporting Anthropic/OpenAI protocols, plus machine ID binding and in-app OAuth login, significantly boosts development efficiency.

metadata.name: ECC
metadata.description: The agent harness performance optimization system. Skills, instincts, memory, security, and research-first development for Claude Code, Codex, Opencode, Cursor and beyond.

summary.zh: ECC是一个为Claude Code、Codex、Cursor等AI编程代理设计的性能优化系统，提供技能、直觉、记忆与安全机制，采用研究优先的开发理念，通过统一插件和工具链增强代理行为，支持多语言环境与跨平台运行。
summary.en: ECC is an agent harness performance optimization system for AI coding tools like Claude Code, Codex, and Cursor. It delivers skills, instincts, memory, and security with a research-first approach, using a unified plugin and toolchain to enhance agent behaviors across platforms and languages.

metadata.name: claude_codex_bridge
metadata.description: Visible multi-agent CLI workspace for mixing Codex, Claude, Gemini, Kimi, Qwen, Cursor, Copilot, Pi, OpenCode, and other AI coding agents

summary.zh: 该工具是一个轻量级多智能体终端工作区，内置稳定的跨提供商协作层，可统一调度多款主流 AI 编程代理，支持复杂协作图、直观控制与移动端远程操作，显著提升多 AI 协同开发效率。
summary.en: CCB is a lightweight multi-agent TUI workspace that provides a stable cross-provider collaboration layer for mixing AI coding agents such as Codex, Claude, Gemini, Kimi, Qwen, Cursor, and GitHub Copilot. It supports complex collaboration graphs, direct terminal takeover, a background daemon for persistent state, and a mobile remote controller with voice control and file transfer. The hub capability runs multiple CLI providers concurrently, significantly enhancing the efficiency of multi-agent collaborative development across Linux, macOS, and WSL.

metadata.name: googlevoice
metadata.description: 注册 Google Voice 号码详细步骤

summary.zh: 本仓库提供Google Voice号码的完整注册、登录、转移与使用教程，涵盖2FA登录、辅助邮箱登录、App安装、资费说明、保号方法及封号申诉等实用内容，重点强调使用美国原生IP和避免发短信以防封号，适合外贸和旅游人士使用。
summary.en: This repository provides a comprehensive tutorial for registering, logging in, transferring, and using Google Voice numbers. It covers 2FA login, recovery email login, app installation, pricing, number keeping, and appeal procedures, emphasizing the use of native US IP and avoiding SMS to prevent bans, suitable for foreign trade and travel.

metadata.name: skills
metadata.description: The open agent skills tool - npx skills

summary.zh: vercel-labs/skills 是开放代理技能生态的命令行工具，通过 npx skills 轻松安装、管理和调用 AI 编码代理技能。支持 OpenCode、Claude Code、Codex 等多款主流代理，兼容多种 Git 源与私有仓库认证，可即时生成技能提示词或交互式启动代理，显著提升 AI 编程工作流效率。
summary.en: vercel-labs/skills is the CLI for the open agent skills ecosystem. It lets developers install, manage, and invoke AI coding agent skills with `npx skills`. It supports a wide range of agents like OpenCode, Claude Code, Codex, and Cursor, and accepts various Git source formats, including private repos via existing Git or GitHub CLI auth. `skills use` can generate a prompt for a skill without installing it, or start a supported coding agent interactively. This streamlines reusing skills across different AI coding assistants, boosting developer productivity.

metadata.name: opencode-antigravity-auth
metadata.description: Enable Opencode to authenticate against Antigravity (Google's IDE) via OAuth so you can use Antigravity rate limits and access models like gemini-3-pro and claude-opus-4-5-thinking with your Google credentials.

summary.zh: 该插件让 Opencode 通过 Google OAuth 认证 Antigravity（Google 的 IDE），进而使用 Gemini 3.1 Pro 和 Claude Opus 4.6 等模型，支持多账号自动轮换、双配额、思考模式及 Google 搜索 grounding，但违反 Google 服务条款，存在封号风险。
summary.en: This plugin enables Opencode to authenticate with Antigravity (Google's IDE) via Google OAuth, unlocking models like Gemini 3.1 Pro and Claude Opus 4.6. It supports multi-account rotation, dual quotas, thinking modes, and Google Search grounding, but violates Google's ToS and risks account bans.

metadata.name: QuantDinger
metadata.description: AI quantitative trading platform for crypto, stocks, and forex with backtesting, live trading, market data, and multi-agent research.vibe-trading ,trading-agents,ai-trader,ai-trading

summary.zh: QuantDinger是开源AI量化交易操作系统，支持加密货币、股票和外汇。它集成了多提供商AI市场研究、策略代码生成、回测、模拟交易和实盘执行，提供本地优先、自托管的解决方案，确保数据与凭据安全。采用多智能体研究和Python策略，适合独立交易者和小团队。
summary.en: QuantDinger is an open-source AI quantitative trading OS supporting crypto, stocks, and forex. It integrates multi-provider AI market research, strategy generation, backtesting, paper trading, and live execution in a self-hosted stack. With multi-agent research and Python strategies, it offers local-first control for independent traders and small teams.

metadata.name: tactus
metadata.description: The first browser AI Agent extension to support Agent Skills, enabling AI to perform complex tasks through an expandable skill system. 🌟 Star if you like it! | 首个支持 Agent Skills 的浏览器 AI Agent 扩展，让 AI 通过可扩展技能系统执行复杂任务 🌟 如果喜欢请点个 Star！

summary.zh: Tactus是首个支持Agent Skills规范的浏览器AI Agent扩展。它通过可扩展的技能系统，使AI能够执行复杂任务，将常用工作流封装为脚本以提升速度和token效率。支持多模型提供商、图像视觉、页面理解及HTTP MCP连接，实现智能网页自动化。
summary.en: Tactus is the first browser AI agent extension to support the Agent Skills specification. It empowers AI to execute complex tasks via an extensible skill system, encapsulating common workflows into scripts to improve speed and token efficiency. It features multi-provider support, image vision, page extraction, and HTTP MCP connectivity, enabling intelligent web automation.

metadata.name: anarlog
metadata.description: Open source Granola AI Alternative

summary.zh: anarlog是一款开源、本地优先的AI会议记录工具，是Granola的开源替代品。它支持本地录音与转录，数据存储于SQLite，可导出Markdown，并兼容OpenAI等任意LLM或本地模型。MIT许可，支持自托管与二次开发，确保数据隐私与自主掌控。
summary.en: anarlog is an open-source, local-first AI meeting notetaker, an alternative to Granola. It records and transcribes meetings on-device, stores canonical data in SQLite, and exports Markdown. You can bring your own LLM (OpenAI, Anthropic, etc.) or use local models. MIT-licensed, forkable, and self-hostable.

metadata.name: AI-Video-Transcriber
metadata.description: Transcribe and summarize videos and podcasts using AI. Open-source, multi-platform, and supports multiple languages.

summary.zh: AI Video Transcriber是一款开源跨平台工具，支持从YouTube、Bilibili等30+平台粘贴链接或上传本地音视频文件，采用字幕优先架构，配合Faster-Whisper快速精准转录，并通过AI优化文本生成多语言摘要。用户可自由配置任意OpenAI兼容API，界面友好且适配移动端。
summary.en: AI Video Transcriber is an open-source, cross-platform tool that transcribes and summarizes videos/podcasts from 30+ platforms like YouTube and Bilibili via URL or local upload. Its subtitle-first architecture with Faster-Whisper fallback ensures fast, accurate transcription, followed by AI text polishing and multi-language summaries. Supports any OpenAI-compatible API with a mobile-friendly UI.

metadata.name: flymd
metadata.description: 高性能Markdown笔记工具！免费AI，智能便签、TODO推送、本地知识库、AI小说引擎。PDF解析、自动语音笔记、录音转文本。毫秒级启动High-performance Markdown note tool! Free AI, smart notes, TODO reminders, local knowledge base, AI novel engine. PDF parsing, auto voice notes, audio-to-text. Millisecond startup.

summary.zh: FlyMD 是一款高性能本地 Markdown 笔记工具，支持免费 AI 写作辅助、智能便签、TODO 多渠道提醒、本地知识库语义搜索，以及高精度 PDF/图片解析和语音转文本。毫秒级启动，跨平台，数据本地优先，适合知识管理与办公提效。
summary.en: FlyMD is a high-performance local Markdown note tool featuring free AI writing assistance, smart notes, multi-channel TODO reminders, local knowledge base semantic search, and high-precision PDF/image parsing with voice-to-text. It starts in milliseconds, runs cross-platform, and prioritizes local data for secure knowledge management.

metadata.name: tgbot-verify
metadata.description: 一个基于 Python Telegram Bot 的自动化认证工具，能够自动完成 SheerID 平台的学生/教师身份验证流程。

summary.zh: 基于Python Telegram Bot的自动化认证工具，自动完成SheerID平台的学生/教师身份验证。集成智能身份信息生成、认证文档创建与提交，支持Gemini、ChatGPT、Spotify等多个服务。配备积分系统、用户管理和Docker部署，大幅简化认证流程。
summary.en: A Python-based Telegram bot that automates SheerID student/teacher verification. It generates identity info, creates verification docs, and submits to SheerID across services like Gemini, ChatGPT, and Spotify. Includes token economy, user management, and Docker support for streamlined deployment.

metadata.name: superpowers
metadata.description: An agentic skills framework & software development methodology that works.

summary.zh: Superpowers是一个面向编码代理的软件开发方法论，通过可组合技能和指令，自动引导代理从规格提取、设计评审到TDD实现，支持子代理驱动的高效自主开发，集成多种主流AI编程工具。
summary.en: Superpowers is a software development methodology for coding agents, using composable skills and instructions to guide agents from spec elicitation, design review, to TDD implementation. It supports subagent-driven autonomous development and integrates with multiple mainstream AI coding tools.

summary.zh: 这是一个基于Django 5和Vue 3的企业级比特浏览器自动化管理系统，针对Google One学生优惠批量处理场景，提供批量窗口管理、账号管理、SheerID自动验证、自动绑卡订阅、批量2FA更换等全流程自动化功能。同时提供PyQt6桌面版，支持个人快速使用，通过Playwright驱动浏览器实现高效操作。
summary.en: This is an enterprise-grade BitBrowser automation management system built with Django 5 and Vue 3, designed for batch processing of Google One student discounts. It automates the entire workflow: batch window management, account import, SheerID verification, auto card binding and subscription, and batch 2FA renewal. A PyQt6 desktop client supports rapid personal use, while Playwright drives the browser for high-efficiency automation.

metadata.name: claudian
metadata.description: An Obsidian plugin that embeds Claude Code/Codex as an AI collaborator in your vault

summary.zh: Claudian是一款Obsidian插件，将Claude Code、Codex等AI编码代理嵌入笔记库，使vault成为代理的工作目录，支持文件读写、搜索、bash及多步工作流。提供内联编辑、斜杠命令、@提及、计划模式、MCP服务器等，适用于知识管理与自动化办公。
summary.en: Claudian is an Obsidian plugin that embeds AI coding agents like Claude Code and Codex into your vault, turning it into their working directory for file read/write, search, bash, and multi-step workflows. Features include inline editing, slash commands, @mentions, plan mode, and MCP server support, ideal for knowledge management and task automation.

metadata.name: kiro.rs
metadata.description: A Kiro Client in Rust

summary.zh: Rust 编写的 Anthropic API 兼容代理，将 Claude 请求转成 Kiro API。支持 SSE 流式、token 自动刷新、多凭据负载均衡、Thinking 模式与工具调用，并提供 Web 管理面板。
summary.en: kiro.rs is a Rust-based Anthropic API-compatible proxy that translates Claude API requests to Kiro API, enabling seamless integration with Claude Code and other Anthropic clients. It offers SSE streaming, automatic token refresh, multi-credential load balancing with failover, smart retries, Thinking mode, function calling, and WebSearch support. Additionally, it provides a web admin panel, per-credential proxy configuration, and Docker/binary deployment options. Leveraging Rust's performance and safety, it is an ideal self-hosted gateway for accessing Kiro AI services via the standard Anthropic API.

metadata.name: one-mcp
metadata.description: A centralized reverse-proxy platform for MCP servers — manage, group, and export as Skills from a single endpoint.

summary.zh: One MCP是一个基于Go和React构建的集中式MCP服务器反向代理平台。它提供统一界面来安装、配置、监控和管理来自不同提供商的MCP服务，支持将服务分组并导出为Anthropic Skills，便于AI智能体快速调用。内置实时分析、多用户OAuth认证及多数据库部署支持。
summary.en: One MCP is a centralized reverse-proxy platform for MCP servers, built with Go and React. It offers a single interface to install, configure, monitor, and manage MCP services supporting stdio, SSE, and streamable HTTP. A standout feature is service groups, which combine multiple MCP services into one endpoint and export them as Anthropic Skills for Claude Code and Droid. It also includes real-time analytics dashboards, role-based access control with GitHub/Google login, and flexible deployment options (SQLite/MySQL/PostgreSQL, Redis, Docker), making it an essential infrastructure for AI agent development.

metadata.name: daily_stock_analysis
metadata.description: LLM 驱动的多市场股票智能分析系统：多源行情、实时新闻、决策看板与自动推送，支持零成本定时运行。  LLM-powered multi-market stock analysis system with multi-source market data, real-time news, decision dashboard, automated notifications, and cost-free scheduled runs.

summary.zh: 基于AI大模型的多市场股票智能分析系统，覆盖A股、港股、美股等，聚合多源行情与实时新闻，生成决策仪表盘并推送至企业微信、飞书等平台。支持GitHub Actions零成本定时运行，提供Web/桌面工作台、Agent策略问股与智能导入，适合个人投资者快速搭建自动化投研流程。
summary.en: An LLM-powered multi-market stock analysis system covering A-shares, HK, US, etc. It aggregates multi-source quotes and real-time news, generates decision dashboards, and pushes to WeCom, Feishu, etc. Supports cost-free scheduled runs via GitHub Actions, with Web/desktop workspace, Agent strategy Q&A, and smart import for automated investment research.

metadata.name: Antigravity-Manager
metadata.description: Professional Antigravity Account Manager & Switcher. One-click seamless account switching for Antigravity Tools. Built with Tauri v2 + React (Rust).专业的 Antigravity 账号管理与切换工具。为 Antigravity 提供一键无缝账号切换功能。

summary.zh: Antigravity Tools是一款专业级AI账号管理与协议代理桌面应用，基于Tauri v2和React构建。它提供多账号统一管理、智能推荐、一键切换，并支持OAuth授权和批量导入。核心亮点是将Web Session转化为标准API接口，消除厂商协议壁垒，作为本地AI中转站使用，帮助开发者高效调用Gemini、Claude等模型。
summary.en: Antigravity Tools is a professional AI account management and API proxy desktop application built with Tauri v2 and React. It offers unified multi-account management, smart recommendation, one-click switching, OAuth authorization, and batch import. The key feature is converting web sessions into standard API interfaces, breaking vendor protocol barriers, serving as a local AI relay station for developers to efficiently access models like Gemini and Claude.

metadata.name: xl-lighthouse
metadata.description: 新一代全景式实时业务监控系统，承载1000万个监控项，每天可高效处理5000亿条消息。XL-LightHouse是一套支持超大数据量、支持超高并发的实时业务指标监控系统【同时支持单机版】。常见的应用场景包括：PV、UV统计；电商销售额、下单用户数统计；日志量统计；接口调用量、异常量、耗时情况统计；服务器运维监控等功能，系统支持多维度统计，支持各种复杂的条件筛选和逻辑判断，一键部署，一行代码接入，轻松实现业务全链路数据监控，帮助企业快速搭建数据指标监控体系。

summary.zh: XL-LightHouse是一套面向超大数据量与超高并发场景的实时业务指标监控系统，支持PV/UV、销售额、日志量、接口调用量等多维度统计，具备流式计算、复杂条件筛选、可视化查询与API接口，一键部署、一行代码接入，帮助企业快速搭建全链路数据监控体系。
summary.en: XL-LightHouse is a real-time business metric monitoring system designed for massive data volumes and high concurrency. It supports multi-dimensional statistics such as PV/UV, sales, log counts, and API calls, featuring stream computing, complex filtering, visualization, and API access. With one-click deployment and one-line integration, it helps enterprises rapidly build full-chain data monitoring systems.

metadata.name: KCloud-Platform-IoT
metadata.description: KCloud-Platform-IoT（老寇IoT云平台）是一个企业级单体架构和微服务架构的IoT云平台。采用DDD(领域驱动设计)思想，基于Spring Boot 4.1.1、Spring Cloud 2025.1.3、Spring Cloud Alibaba 2025.1.0.0 最新版本开发的云服务多租户IoT平台，家人们，点个star！拜托啦~

summary.zh: KCloud-Platform-IoT是一个企业级IoT云平台，支持单体与微服务架构。基于Spring Boot 4.1.0、Spring Cloud 2025.1.2等最新技术，采用DDD领域驱动设计，实现多租户、服务治理、分布式能力，涵盖系统管理、物联管理、监控分析等模块，支持多种部署方式，适合作为物联网微服务快速开发底座。
summary.en: KCloud-Platform-IoT is an enterprise-grade IoT cloud platform supporting both monolithic and microservices architectures. Built on Spring Boot 4.1.0, Spring Cloud 2025.1.2, and DDD, it offers multi-tenancy, service governance, and distributed capabilities, with modules for system management, IoT management, and monitoring. It supports multiple deployment modes and serves as a rapid development foundation for IoT microservices.

summary.zh: 本仓库提供了一套系统化的 Vibe Coding 指南，指导开发者如何与 AI 结对编程高效将想法落地。内容涵盖提示词设计、工作流搭建、工具推荐及实践技巧，帮助用户提升 AI 辅助开发效率，适用于个人开发者及小团队快速原型构建。
summary.en: This repository provides a systematic guide to Vibe Coding, teaching developers how to efficiently turn ideas into reality through AI pair programming. It covers prompt design, workflow setup, tool recommendations, and practical tips to boost AI-assisted development productivity, suitable for individual developers and small teams for rapid prototyping.

metadata.name: fastapi-best-practices
metadata.description: FastAPI Best Practices and Conventions we used at our startup

summary.zh: 一份基于创业公司生产环境的 FastAPI 最佳实践清单，涵盖项目结构、异步路由、Pydantic 校验、依赖注入、数据库迁移与测试等关键主题，旨在帮助开发者规避常见陷阱，构建可扩展、可维护的高质量 API 服务。
summary.en: An opinionated list of FastAPI best practices and conventions from production systems, covering project structure, async routes, Pydantic validation, dependency injection, DB migrations, and testing to help developers build scalable and maintainable APIs.

metadata.name: orise-charge-cloud
metadata.description: ⚡️充电桩开源云平台⚡️完整源代码，包含模拟桩模块，可通过docker编排快速部署测试。技术栈：SpringCloud、MySQL、Redis、RabbitMQ，前后端管理系统（管理后台、小程序），支持互联互通协议、市政协议、一对多方平台支持。支持高并发业务、业务动态伸缩、桩通信负载均衡（NLB）。

summary.zh: 开源的电动汽车充电桩云平台，基于SpringCloud微服务架构，包含管理后台和小程序。支持云快充等互联互通协议，内置模拟桩模块便于仿真调试，可通过Docker快速部署。适合充电桩运营商构建高并发、可动态伸缩的充电运营系统。
summary.en: An open-source EV charging station cloud platform based on SpringCloud microservices, featuring an admin dashboard and mini-program. It supports interconnectivity protocols, a built-in simulated charger module for testing, and Docker-based rapid deployment, enabling high concurrency, dynamic scaling, and efficient charging operations.

metadata.name: qihang-erp-open
metadata.description: 启航电商ERP系统是一个驱动电商企业数智化转型的电商业务中台底座。该项目采用SpringBoot4开发，除了具有ERP全链路功能之外，还正在构建以SpringAI2.0为底层的AI原生电商ERP系统，主要包括Erp Tools提供读写ERP结构化数据。系统支持多平台多店铺商品、订单、售后、库存、电子面单等电商核心业务处理，支持：淘宝、京东、拼多多、抖店、微信小店、快手、小红书等。系统拥有完善的对外开放接口，可以很方便地与企业原有其他系统进行对接。

summary.zh: 启航电商ERP系统是面向电商企业的数智化业务中台底座，基于Spring Boot 4.1与Spring AI 2.0构建AI原生ERP，支持淘宝、京东、拼多多等主流平台的多店铺商品、订单、售后、库存管理，集成DeepSeek大模型与11个AI工具实现自然语言查询和智能监控，并提供开放API及飞书/钉钉/企微通知。
summary.en: Qihang E-Commerce ERP is a digital business middle platform for e-commerce enterprises, built on Spring Boot 4.1 and Spring AI 2.0. It supports multi-store management across Taobao, JD, Pinduoduo, Douyin, etc., covering products, orders, after-sales, and inventory. With DeepSeek LLM integration and 11 AI tools, it enables natural language query and intelligent monitoring, plus open APIs and webhook notifications.

metadata.name: DeepCode
metadata.description: "DeepCode: Open Agentic Coding (Agent Harness & Loop Engineering & Multi-Agent Orchestration)"

summary.zh: DeepCode是开放的多智能体编码框架，支持论文转代码、文本转网页及文本转后端等任务。通过多智能体协作提升代码生成的准确性与效率，适用于科研复现、快速原型开发和自动化编程场景。
summary.en: DeepCode is an open agentic coding framework that supports paper-to-code, text-to-web, and text-to-backend generation. By leveraging multi-agent collaboration, it enhances code generation accuracy and efficiency for scientific replication, rapid prototyping, and automated programming.

metadata.name: Fabric
metadata.description: Fabric is an open-source framework for augmenting humans using AI. It provides a modular system for solving specific problems using a crowdsourced set of AI prompts that can be used anywhere.

summary.zh: Fabric 是一个开源 AI 增强框架，通过模块化设计和众包提示词库，将 AI 能力无缝集成到命令行、编辑器等日常工具中，帮助用户高效完成总结、分析、编码等任务，实现 AI 能力的便捷调用与复用。
summary.en: Fabric is an open-source framework for augmenting humans with AI.
