It offers a modular system with a crowdsourced collection of prompts to solve specific problems, enabling seamless integration into various tools and command-line workflows for tasks like summarization, analysis, and coding.

metadata.name: vuepress-theme-vdoing
metadata.description: 🚀一款简洁高效的VuePress知识管理&博客(blog)主题

summary.zh: VuePress知识管理与博客主题，以Markdown为中心构建结构化知识库，支持博客与文档双形态，内置自动化工具和多维索引，帮助程序员高效整理与展示知识。
summary.en: A concise VuePress theme for knowledge management and blogging. It builds structured knowledge bases with Markdown, supports blog and docs modes, and features automation tools and multi-dimensional indexing for efficient knowledge organization.

metadata.name: claudekit-skills
metadata.description: All powerful skills of ClaudeKit.cc!

summary.zh: ClaudeKit Skills 是一个面向 Claude 智能体的技能集合与插件市场，提供认证、AI 代理开发、后端开发、多模态处理等强大技能。它通过任务简报、防护机制和集成提示，将通用 AI 辅助转化为规范化自动化，并支持通过命令行轻松安装与自动更新。
summary.en: ClaudeKit Skills is a plugin marketplace and collection of Agent Skills for Claude, featuring powerful skills like authentication, AI agent development, backend development, and multimodal processing. It transforms generic AI assistance into disciplined automation through mission briefs, guardrails, and integration hints, with easy CLI installation and auto-updates.

metadata.name: awesome-system-design-resources
metadata.description: Learn System Design concepts and prepare for interviews using free resources.

summary.zh: 该仓库汇总了大量免费系统设计学习资源，涵盖可扩展性、CAP定理、网络协议、API设计、数据库索引、缓存策略、消息队列等关键概念，并提供面试准备指南，适合软件工程师系统学习架构知识。
summary.en: This repository curates a wide range of free system design learning resources, covering key concepts such as scalability, CAP theorem, networking protocols, API design, database indexing, caching strategies, and message queues, along with interview preparation guides for software engineers.

metadata.name: ql-script-hub
metadata.description: 🎯 青龙面板自动化签到脚本集合 - 支持多平台签到、监控，含随机化功能     |顺丰速运|什么值得买|阿里云盘|恩山论坛|nodeseek|夸克网盘|贴吧|ikuuu|百度网盘|NGA论坛|天翼云盘|deepflood|成都地铁|塔斯汀汉堡|PassNAT

summary.zh: QL Script Hub是一个专为青龙面板打造的多平台自动化签到脚本库，覆盖顺丰速运、什么值得买、阿里云盘、恩山论坛、夸克网盘等20余个平台。所有脚本均经过测试，具备随机化功能，支持多账号管理、多通道消息推送，并提供统一配置与详细文档，便于快速部署和持续集成。
summary.en: QL Script Hub is a comprehensive automation script repository designed for Qinglong Panel, providing a one-stop solution for automated check-ins and monitoring across multiple platforms. It covers more than 20 services such as SF Express, Smzdm, Aliyun Drive, Enshan Forum, Quark Netdisk, and NGA. The project emphasizes easy configuration, modular design, and reliable performance. All scripts are tested, support random delays to avoid detection, multi-account handling, and integration with popular notification channels like Telegram, ServerChan, and DingTalk. Detailed documentation and a clean directory structure enable rapid deployment and long-term maintenance.

metadata.name: vibe-coding-cn
metadata.description: Vibe Coding 从入门到精通教程｜AI 结对编程工作流｜Prompt、Skill、Workflow、上下文管理、codex实战指南

summary.zh: 该仓库是中文Vibe Coding从入门到精通的系统性教程，覆盖AI结对编程工作流、Prompt工程、Skill技能、上下文管理与Codex实战。它提供从想法到产品的标准化工程闭环，包含关键词系统、企业架构模板及可一键安装的工具配置，帮助开发者高效利用AI编程，是AI辅助开发的实用指南。
summary.en: This repository is a comprehensive Chinese tutorial on Vibe Coding, covering AI pair programming workflows, prompt engineering, skills, context management, and Codex hands-on practices. It offers a standardized engineering loop from idea to product, including a keyword system, enterprise architecture templates, and one-click tool configurations, empowering developers to leverage AI effectively.

metadata.name: qinglong
metadata.description: 支持 Python3、JavaScript、Shell、Typescript 的定时任务管理平台（Timed task management platform supporting Python3, JavaScript, Shell, Typescript）

summary.zh: 青龙是一款支持 Python3、JavaScript、Shell、TypeScript 的定时任务管理平台，提供在线脚本编辑、环境变量配置、日志查看、秒级调度与系统通知，支持 Docker 部署和手机端操作，适合自动化运维与定时任务统一管理。
summary.en: Qinglong is a timed task management platform supporting Python3, JavaScript, Shell, and TypeScript. It offers online script management, environment variable configuration, log viewing, second-level scheduling, and system notifications. With Docker deployment and mobile support, it suits automation operations and centralized cron job management.

metadata.name: ZaiZaiCat-Checkin
metadata.description: 每日签到脚本(多账号),青龙脚本,签到脚本,签到列表:  🚚 顺丰速运 |  恩山论坛  |  看雪论坛  |  上海杨浦   |  华润通  |   鸿星尔克 |   WPS签到  |   什么值得买

summary.zh: 基于Python的多平台每日签到脚本集合，支持顺丰、恩山论坛、看雪论坛、WPS、什么值得买等十余个平台。针对青龙面板优化，支持多账号配置、统一通知推送及任务统计，部署文档完善，帮助用户一键自动化完成每日签到与积分任务。
summary.en: A Python-based multi-platform daily check-in script collection for SF Express, Enshan, Kanxue, WPS, SMZDM and more. Optimized for Qinglong Panel, it supports multi-account configuration, unified notifications, and task statistics for one-click automated check-ins and rewards.

metadata.name: newsnow
metadata.description: Elegant reading of real-time and hottest news

summary.zh: NewsNow是一款优雅的实时热点新闻阅读工具，聚合多源热门资讯并提供清爽界面。支持GitHub OAuth登录同步、自适应抓取间隔优化资源，同时提供MCP服务器接口，便于集成到AI工作流。适合新闻追踪与个性化阅读场景，部署灵活，支持Docker及Cloudflare Pages。
summary.en: NewsNow is an elegant real-time hot news reader that aggregates trending stories from multiple sources with a clean UI. It features GitHub OAuth login, adaptive scraping intervals to optimize resources, and an MCP server for AI workflow integration. Ideal for news tracking and personalized reading, with flexible deployment via Docker or Cloudflare Pages.

metadata.name: obsidian-simplemindmap
metadata.description: Provides a user-friendly mind map plugin for Obsidian. 思绪思维导图（SimpleMindMap）的Obsidian插件版。

summary.zh: 为 Obsidian 提供强大易用的思维导图插件，基于 mind-map 库实现。支持将 .smm.md 文件以思维导图或大纲模式编辑，集成 Obsidian 双链、嵌入预览、导入导出、多语言等功能，显著提升笔记关联与可视化梳理效率。
summary.en: A user-friendly mind map plugin for Obsidian, powered by the mind-map library. It enables opening .smm.md files in mind map or outline view, supports internal links, embedded previews, import/export, multi-language, and more—greatly enhancing visual thinking and note interconnection.

metadata.name: lx-doc
metadata.description: 理想文档。定位于个人和小团队的在线云文档。支持思维导图、白板、流程图、PPT、电子表格等

summary.zh: 理想文档是一款面向个人与小团队的在线云文档，专注私有化部署，确保数据自主可控。集成思维导图、白板、流程图、PPT、电子表格等多种编辑器，基于成熟开源项目二次开发，提供统一工作台与文件管理，适用于安全敏感或需定制化的文档管理场景。
summary.en: lx-doc is an online cloud document platform for individuals and small teams, emphasizing self-hosted deployment for full data control. It integrates multiple editors including mind maps, whiteboards, flowcharts, PPT, and spreadsheets, built on mature open-source projects with a unified workbench for file management, suitable for privacy-conscious or customizable document needs.

metadata.name: DouyinLiveRecorder
metadata.description: 可循环值守和多人录制的直播录制软件，支持抖音、TikTok、Youtube、快手、虎牙、斗鱼、B站、小红书、pandatv、sooplive、flextv、popkontv、twitcasting、winktv、百度、微博、酷狗、17Live、Twitch、Acfun、CHZZK、shopee等40+平台直播录制

summary.zh: 本工具是一款基于FFmpeg的多平台直播录制软件，支持抖音、TikTok、YouTube、快手等40多个平台。具备循环值守、多人同时录制、自定义画质与直播状态推送，支持代理和Docker部署，操作简单，适合长期自动监测和保存直播内容。
summary.en: This is a simple yet powerful live streaming recording tool based on FFmpeg, supporting over 40 platforms such as Douyin, TikTok, YouTube, Kuaishou, Huya, Douyu, and Bilibili. It enables automatic loop monitoring, simultaneous multi-user recording, custom video quality settings, and real-time live status push notifications. The tool also supports HTTP proxy configuration for overseas platforms and Docker deployment for easy setup. It is designed for long-term unattended operation, making it ideal for content creators and fans to automatically preserve live streams.

metadata.name: project-multilevel-index
metadata.description: 🎼 Fractal self-referential documentation system inspired by GEB. Auto-maintains code indexes, file headers & dependency graphs. Supports Claude Code (full auto) + VSCode/Cursor/Windsurf/Kiro (extension in dev).claude skill

summary.zh: 该项目是一个受《哥德尔、埃舍尔、巴赫》启发的分形自指文档系统，自动维护代码索引、文件头与依赖图。支持多语言，提供CLI与Claude Code插件，自动更新索引并生成Mermaid依赖图，降低文档维护成本，适合开发者与团队。
summary.en: This project presents a fractal self-referential documentation system, inspired by Gödel, Escher, and Bach, that automatically maintains code indexes, file headers, and dependency graphs for codebases written in over ten programming languages. It provides a standalone CLI and a Claude Code plugin, enabling automatic index updates on code changes, along with Mermaid-based dependency visualization. The plugin also triggers automatic refresh through hooks, while the CLI is suitable for CI/CD integration. With consistent three-level index structures, it reduces documentation overhead and improves project maintainability for both individual developers and teams.

metadata.name: hello-agents
metadata.description: 📚 《从零开始构建智能体》——从零开始的智能体原理与实践教程

summary.zh: 这本开源教程从零讲解智能体的原理与实践，覆盖经典范式、低代码平台、主流框架，并手把手实现一个基于OpenAI原生API的自研智能体框架，深入上下文工程、记忆、评估及Agentic RL训练，适合希望从LLM使用者进阶为智能体构建者的开发者。
summary.en: This open-source tutorial systematically covers the principles and practices of building AI agents from scratch, including classic paradigms, low-code platforms, and mainstream frameworks. It guides readers to implement their own agent framework using OpenAI's native API, delving into context engineering, memory, evaluation, and Agentic RL training—ideal for developers transitioning from LLM users to agent builders.

metadata.name: TelegramGroup
metadata.description: 2026最新悄咪咪收集的10000+个Telegram群合集、tg导航、电报导航、telegram导航，附全网最有趣好用的机器人BOT🤖【tg10000.com】

summary.zh: 项目收集超10000个Telegram群组、频道及机器人，提供全面的电报导航服务，涵盖搜索、加密交流、AI工具等实用资源，帮助用户快速发现优质社群，并附多种功能机器人，但需注意合规使用。
summary.en: This project aggregates over 10,000 Telegram groups, channels, and bots, offering a comprehensive directory for discovering high-quality communities. It includes search bots, crypto groups, AI tools, and utility bots, while reminding users to comply with local laws.

metadata.name: Shadowrocket-ADBlock-Rules-Forever
metadata.description: 提供多款 Shadowrocket 规则，拥有强劲的广告过滤功能。每日 8 时重新构建规则。

summary.zh: 提供多款Shadowrocket规则，基于GFWList和top500直连列表，集成EasyList等广告过滤，支持黑白名单、国内外划分、全局直连/代理等模式，每日自动更新，适用于iOS端网页、App及视频广告过滤，兼顾浏览速度与隐私保护。
summary.en: Provides multiple Shadowrocket rules with powerful ad blocking, based on GFWList and top500 direct-connect lists, integrating EasyList and other filters. Supports blacklist/whitelist, domestic/foreign split, global direct/proxy modes, and automated daily updates for iOS web, app, and video ad filtering.

metadata.name: obsidian-simplemindmap
metadata.description: Provides a user-friendly mind map plugin for Obsidian. 思绪思维导图（SimpleMindMap）的Obsidian插件版。

summary.zh: 为 Obsidian 设计的思维导图插件，基于开源 mind-map 库，支持多种主题与结构、内链、图片上传、命令操作和自动保存，多语言界面，可嵌入 Markdown 文档，便于知识整理与可视化。
summary.en: SimpleMindMap is an Obsidian plugin that brings powerful mind mapping capabilities into your notes. Built on the open-source mind-map library, it supports customizable themes and structures, Obsidian internal links, image hosting, commands, and automatic saving. The plugin offers multilingual support including Simplified Chinese, Traditional Chinese, English, and Vietnamese, and integrates seamlessly with Markdown documents. Users can create, edit, and visualize mind maps directly within Obsidian, enhancing knowledge organization and visual thinking. It also provides flexible file naming and storage options for better workflow integration.

metadata.name: Jimi
metadata.description: Jimi：打造Java程序员专属的开源ClaudeCode

summary.zh: Jimi是一款纯Java实现的开源AI编程代理，为Java开发者提供类似ClaudeCode的智能编码体验。它集成多Agent协作、Skills技能包、Hooks自动化、MCP协议及原生工具，支持多种大模型接入与/loop、/goal等循环工程原语，显著提升开发效率。
summary.en: Jimi is an open-source AI-powered coding agent implemented in pure Java, offering Java developers a ClaudeCode-like experience. It features multi-agent collaboration, skills packages, Hooks automation, MCP protocol support, and native tools, along with multiple LLM providers and Loop Engineering primitives such as /loop and /goal to boost productivity.

metadata.name: ueh
metadata.description: 告警管理，事件管理，统一告警、事件平台。告警事件统一接收、告警降噪、告警去重、合并、分类、告警升降级、告警屏蔽、告警通知。

summary.zh: UEH（Unified Event Handler）是一个可私有化部署的统一告警事件管理平台，能够汇聚Zabbix、Prometheus等各类监控工具产生的告警，进行去重、合并、分类、升降级、屏蔽与降噪，并通过通知组将精准告警推送给相关人员。其开放式架构支持Webhook、HTTP及REST API集成，适用于对数据安全要求高的金融、国央企等场景，能有效提升IT故障处理效率。
summary.en: UEH (Unified Event Handler) is a privately deployable unified alert and event management platform that aggregates alerts from monitoring tools like Zabbix and Prometheus. It performs deduplication, merging, classification, escalation, suppression, and noise reduction, then sends precise alerts to relevant personnel via notification groups. Its open architecture supports Webhook, HTTP, and REST API integration, making it ideal for security-sensitive sectors such as finance and state-owned enterprises to boost IT incident resolution efficiency.

metadata.name: Mole
metadata.description: 🐹 Clean, uninstall, analyze, optimize, and monitor your Mac. Free open-source CLI, plus a native Mac app.

summary.zh: Mole 是一款开源 macOS 命令行工具，集成系统清理、应用卸载、磁盘分析和实时监控功能，帮助用户安全释放空间并优化系统性能。支持 dry-run 预览，适合开发者和高级用户高效维护 Mac。
summary.en: Mole is an open-source macOS CLI that combines system cleaning, app uninstallation, disk analysis, and real-time monitoring. It helps users reclaim space and optimize performance with safe dry-run previews, making it ideal for developers and power users.

metadata.name: TrendRadar
metadata.description: ⭐AI-driven public opinion & trend monitor with multi-platform aggregation, RSS, and smart alerts.🎯 告别信息过载，你的 AI 舆情监控助手与热点筛选工具！聚合多平台热点 +  RSS 订阅，支持关键词精准筛选。AI 智能筛选新闻 + AI 翻译 +  AI 分析简报直推手机，也支持接入 MCP 架构，赋能 AI 自然语言对话分析、情感洞察与趋势预测等。支持 Docker ，数据本地/云端自持。集成微信/飞书/钉钉/Telegram/邮件/ntfy/bark/slack 等渠道智能推送。

summary.zh: TrendRadar是一款AI驱动的舆情监控与热点趋势分析工具，聚合多平台热点与RSS订阅，支持关键词精确筛选、AI智能翻译与新闻摘要，通过微信、钉钉、Telegram等多渠道推送。支持Docker一键部署，并兼容MCP协议，可赋能AI智能对话、情感洞察与趋势预测，帮助用户告别信息过载，高效获取关注资讯。
summary.en: TrendRadar is an AI-powered public opinion and trend monitoring tool that aggregates hotspots from multiple platforms and RSS feeds, with keyword filtering, AI translation, and smart alerts. It pushes insights via WeChat, DingTalk, Telegram, Email, etc., supports Docker deployment, and integrates MCP for AI-driven analysis and sentiment insights.

metadata.name: moai-adk
metadata.description: Agentic development harness for Claude Code — SPEC-driven plan/run/sync, TRUST 5 quality gates, model+effort routing, and Claude×GLM multi-LLM cost control. Single Go binary, 16 languages, zero deps.

summary.zh: MoAI-ADK是为Claude Code设计的代理开发套件，围绕成本、质量、自我改进三大轴，通过SPEC驱动的计划/运行/同步、TRUST 5质量门禁、模型路由及多模型成本控制，全面提升AI编程的可靠性与效率，并大幅降低token消耗。单一Go二进制，支持16种语言，零依赖，跨平台运行，易于部署。
summary.en: MoAI-ADK is an agentic development harness for Claude Code, centered on three core axes: cost control, quality assurance, and self-improvement. By leveraging SPEC-driven plan/run/sync workflows, TRUST 5 quality gates, model and effort routing, and Claude×GLM multi-LLM cost control, it significantly enhances the reliability and efficiency of AI-assisted coding while reducing token consumption. The tool is distributed as a single Go binary, supports 16 languages, has zero runtime dependencies, and operates seamlessly across macOS, Linux, and Windows, making it easy to integrate into any development workflow.

metadata.name: we-mp-rss
metadata.description: ✨符合阅读习惯的微信公众号助手、微信公众号转MarkDown、微信公众号转PDF、定时更新订阅公众号文章、生成微信公众号RSS订阅源、导出微信公众号订阅源、支持微信公众号Webhook/微信公众号API/AI Agent接入微信公众号微信公众号、订阅微信公众号、微信公众号助手 、微信公众号阅读、微信公众号接口、微信公众号爬虫、微信公众号监测、标签订阅微信公众号、微信公众号源、微信公众号读书、微信公众号文章、微信公众号框架、微信公众号管理、微信公众号源、微信公众号平台、微信公众号代码、微信公众号系统、微信公众号源码

summary.zh: 这是一个微信公众号订阅管理助手，可将公众号文章转换为RSS、Markdown、PDF等格式，支持定时更新、多种数据库存储，并提供Web管理界面和API/Webhook接口，方便接入AI Agent，实现公众号内容的聚合、监测与个性化阅读。
summary.en: We-MP-RSS is a WeChat Official Account subscription management tool that converts articles to RSS, Markdown, and PDF, supports scheduled updates, multiple databases, and offers a web UI with API/Webhook for AI Agent integration, enabling content aggregation and personalized reading.

metadata.name: wechat-article-exporter
metadata.description: 一款在线的 微信公众号文章批量下载 工具，支持导出阅读量与评论数据，无需搭建任何环境，可通过 在线网站 使用，支持 docker 私有化部署和 Cloudflare 部署。  支持下载各种文件格式，其中 HTML 格式可100%还原文章排版与样式。

summary.zh: 一款微信公众号文章批量导出工具，无需搭建环境即可在线使用，支持Docker和Cloudflare私有化部署。可导出HTML/JSON/Excel等格式，HTML可100%还原排版，并支持导出阅读量、评论等数据。项目依赖微信接口，已停止维护。
summary.en: A batch export tool for WeChat Official Account articles, usable online without setup, supporting Docker and Cloudflare deployment. It exports multiple formats like HTML/JSON/Excel, with HTML preserving original layout perfectly, and includes reading counts and comments. Note: the project has been discontinued.

metadata.name: wechatDownload
metadata.description: 微信公众号文章批量下载工具，支持评论、合集下载，支持保存html/mhtml/md/pdf/docx/csv文件，保存文章内图片、视频、音频文件，支持MCP/Skill调用

summary.zh: 该工具专为微信公众号文章批量下载设计，支持历史消息抓取，可导出HTML/MHTML/MD/PDF/DOCX/CSV等格式，并保存文章内图片、视频、音频及评论、合集内容。无需安装证书，兼容Windows/macOS，并支持MCP/Skill接口调用，便于集成到自动化工作流。
summary.en: This tool is designed for batch downloading WeChat Official Account articles, allowing users to crawl historical messages and export them as HTML, MHTML, Markdown, PDF, DOCX, or CSV files. It saves embedded images, videos, audio, comments, and collections. No certificate installation is required, and it works on Windows and macOS. It also supports MCP and Skill interfaces, enabling easy integration into automated workflows and AI agents, making it a versatile content archiving solution.

metadata.name: drawio-mcp-server
metadata.description: Draw.io Model Context Protocol (MCP) Server

summary.zh: Draw.io MCP服务器将Diagram.net图表工具与AI代理无缝集成，提供程序化创建、读取、更新图表元素的能力。支持内置编辑器与浏览器扩展两种模式，涵盖多文档多页面管理、Mermaid导入、XML/SVG/PNG导入导出等高级功能，让AI助手自动生成架构图、流程图和可视化文档，适用于各类MCP客户端。
summary.en: This MCP server integrates Draw.io (Diagrams.net) with AI agents, enabling programmatic creation, inspection, and modification of diagram elements. It offers a built-in editor and browser extension, supports multi-document/page workflows, Mermaid import, and XML/SVG/PNG import/export, allowing AI assistants to generate architecture diagrams, flowcharts, and visual documentation across various MCP clients.

metadata.name: joyagent-jdgenie
metadata.description: 开源的端到端产品级通用智能体

summary.zh: 京东开源的高完成度轻量级通用多智能体产品，提供端到端开箱即用解决方案。集成报告生成、代码、PPT等子智能体，支持多模态RAG和DataAgent，在GAIA基准上表现优异，可快速构建定制化智能体应用。
summary.en: JD open-sourced a high-completion lightweight general-purpose multi-agent product, offering an end-to-end out-of-box solution. It integrates report, code, PPT and file agents, plus multimodal RAG and DataAgent, achieving strong GAIA scores for building custom agent applications.

metadata.name: ai-agent-team
metadata.description: AI Agent Team-拥有24/7专业AI开发团队：产品经理、前端开发、后端开发、测试工程师、DevOps工程师、技术负责人。一键安装，支持中英文命令，大幅提升开发效率！

summary.zh: AI Agent Team是一款基于Claude Code的AI开发团队工具，集成了产品经理、前端、后端、测试、DevOps、技术负责人等八大专业智能体。支持Thread Manager记忆系统、语义搜索、自动Git版本控制，兼容50+运行时。一键安装，支持中英文命令，显著提升开发效率。
summary.en: AI Agent Team is a development tool built on Claude Code that integrates eight professional AI agents including product manager, frontend, backend, QA, DevOps, and tech lead. It features a Thread Manager memory system with semantic search and automatic Git version control, compatible with 50+ runtimes. One-click installation, supports Chinese and English commands, greatly improving development efficiency.

metadata.name: axonhub
metadata.description: ⚡️ Open-source AI Gateway — Use any SDK to call 100+ LLMs. Built-in failover, load balancing, cost control & end-to-end tracing.

summary.zh: AxonHub是一个开源AI网关，支持通过任意SDK零代码调用100多种大语言模型。内置故障转移、负载均衡、成本控制与端到端追踪，帮助开发者简化多模型集成，提升AI应用可靠性，适用于企业级生产环境。
summary.en: AxonHub is an open-source AI gateway that lets you use any SDK to call 100+ LLMs without code changes. It features built-in failover, load balancing, cost control, and end-to-end tracing, enabling reliable multi-model integration for enterprise AI applications.

metadata.name: yuque-tools
metadata.description: 🧰 玩转语雀-朴实无华的语雀资源导出工具，语雀知识库+团队资源批量导出/备份工具(无需Token)

summary.zh: 语雀知识库与团队资源批量导出/备份工具，无需Token即可使用，支持个人、团队及协作知识库，还涵盖小记功能。提供CLI和浏览器插件两种形式，方便用户快速备份、迁移语雀内容，工具设计注重实用性与易用性。
summary.en: A practical toolset for Yuque that batch exports and backs up knowledge bases and team resources without requiring a token. Supports personal, team, and collaborative knowledge bases as well as notes. Available as CLI and a browser extension for easy data migration and backup.

metadata.name: cloud-document-converter
metadata.description: Convert Lark Doc to Markdown

summary.zh: Cloud Document Converter是一款浏览器扩展，支持将飞书文档一键下载或复制为Markdown格式，方便内容迁移与本地保存。它广泛兼容各类文档块和行内样式，如标题、表格、代码块、列表等，并适配Chrome、Edge和Firefox等主流浏览器，是高效处理飞书文档的实用工具。
summary.en: Cloud Document Converter is a browser extension that enables one-click download or copy of Lark Doc as Markdown, facilitating content migration and local archiving. It supports a wide range of block and inline elements including headings, tables, code blocks, and lists, and works across Chrome, Edge, and Firefox browsers, making it a practical tool for Lark document processing.

metadata.name: how-to-build-a-coding-agent
metadata.description: A workshop that teaches you how to build your own coding agent. Similar to Roo code, Cline, Amp, Cursor, Windsurf or OpenCode.

summary.zh: 本仓库是一个逐步教学的工作坊，指导开发者用Go语言从零构建自己的AI编码代理。通过六个渐进版本，从基础聊天机器人逐步添加文件读取、目录浏览、Shell命令执行、文件编辑和代码搜索等工具，并实现智能体的核心事件循环。适合希望深入理解LLM工具调用和Agent架构的开发者。
summary.en: This repository is a hands-on workshop that teaches developers to build their own AI coding agent from scratch using Go. Through six progressive versions, it evolves from a basic chatbot to a full-featured assistant with file reading, directory listing, shell command execution, file editing, and code search tools, centered on an agent event loop. Ideal for developers seeking to understand LLM tool calling and agent architecture.

metadata.name: minimind
metadata.description: 🧠 Train a 64M-parameter LLM from scratch in just 2h!

summary.zh: MiniMind是一个从零开始训练64M参数超小语言模型的开源项目，仅需约2小时和3元GPU成本即可完成训练。项目覆盖预训练、SFT、LoRA、RLHF、RLAIF、工具调用等完整流程，核心代码基于PyTorch原生实现，不依赖高层封装，适合个人GPU学习和复现大模型技术。
summary.en: MiniMind is an open-source project that trains a 64M-parameter ultra-small language model from scratch in about 2 hours with only $0.4 GPU cost. It covers the full pipeline including pretraining, SFT, LoRA, RLHF, RLAIF, and tool use, with all core algorithms implemented natively in PyTorch for easy learning and reproduction on consumer GPUs.

metadata.name: Skill_Seekers
metadata.description: Convert documentation websites, GitHub repositories, and PDFs into Claude AI skills with automatic conflict detection

summary.zh: Skill Seekers是一个文档知识处理工具，可将文档网站、GitHub仓库、PDF等18种来源自动转换为结构化AI技能，支持Claude、Gemini、OpenAI等平台，并导出至RAG管道、AI编程助手等22种目标。具备冲突检测、MCP集成与AI驱动项目扫描，高效构建AI知识库。
summary.en: Skill Seekers is a documentation-to-knowledge tool that converts 18 source types, including documentation sites, GitHub repos, and PDFs, into structured AI skills for Claude, Gemini, and OpenAI. It exports to 22 targets like RAG pipelines and AI coding assistants, with conflict detection, MCP integration, and AI-driven project scanning.

metadata.name: Pensieve
metadata.description: tore your decisions and principles. Claude reads them to make better choices.

summary.zh: Pensieve 将项目决策、原则、事实与流程自动沉淀为结构化知识，以技能形式供 AI 代理按需调用，通过知识图谱语义链接实现规划验证与探索定位，显著节省上下文。
summary.en: Pensieve is a continuously growing project memory for AI agents. It runs as a skill, compatible with any AI tool that supports skills, and functions as a self-updating CLAUDE.md. The system automatically stores decisions, principles, facts, and workflows into a four-layer knowledge model connected by semantic links, building a knowledge graph. This structure allows on-demand context routing, keeping token usage minimal while providing accurate plan validation, targeted exploration, and dependency analysis. As a result, it reduces repeated explanations and helps agents make better choices over time.

metadata.name: sublime-scheme-alabaster
metadata.description: Minimalist color scheme for Sublime Text 3

summary.zh: Alabaster 是一款为 Sublime Text 3 设计的极简浅色配色方案。它仅用四种颜色高亮字符串、常量、注释和全局定义，不强调关键词和字体变化，让代码扫描更轻松。提供 Dark、Mono 等变体，深受追求专注的开发者喜爱。
summary.en: Alabaster is a minimalist light color scheme for Sublime Text 3. It highlights only strings, constants, comments, and global definitions with four colors, avoiding keyword emphasis and font variations for easier code scanning. Variants include Dark and Mono, popular among focused developers.

summary.zh: Done Hub 是基于 one-hub 二次开发的 AI API 网关，兼容原版数据库与镜像。新增 Codex、Claude Code、Gemini CLI 等新型客户端反向代理渠道，支持原生路由跨协议转换、渠道精细化管控、邀请返利、批量管理、实时指标与日志导出，修复多项计费与稳定性问题，适合多模型 API 的统一管理与分发。
summary.en: Done Hub is an AI API gateway forked from one-hub, fully compatible with the original databases and images. It introduces reverse proxy channels for new clients (Codex, Claude Code, Gemini CLI, etc.), cross-protocol native routing, fine-grained channel control, invite rebates, batch operations, real-time metrics, and CSV log export, with many bug fixes. Ideal for unified management and distribution of multi-model APIs.

metadata.name: proxify
metadata.description: An open-source, lightweight, and self-hosted reverse proxy gateway for AI APIs

summary.zh: Proxify 是一款基于 Go 的轻量级开源 AI API 反向代理网关，提供统一入口管理 OpenAI、Claude、Gemini 等大模型服务。它专为 LLM 流式响应优化，具备平滑输出、心跳保活和尾部加速功能，支持自托管部署，低至 0.5GB 内存即可运行，只需更换 BaseURL 即可无缝集成现有项目。
summary.en: Proxify is an open-source, lightweight reverse proxy gateway for AI APIs, built with Go. It offers a unified API entry for multiple LLM providers such as OpenAI, Azure, Claude, Gemini, and DeepSeek. The gateway is specifically optimized for streaming responses, featuring smooth output, heartbeat keepalive, and tail acceleration to enhance user experience. As a fully self-hosted solution, it guarantees data privacy and zero third-party risk. With minimal resource consumption (0.5GB RAM), it integrates easily by simply replacing the BaseURL, requiring no code changes.

metadata.name: CLIProxyAPI
metadata.description: Wrap Antigravity, ChatGPT Codex, Claude Code, Grok Build as an OpenAI/Gemini/Claude/Codex compatible API service, allowing you to enjoy the free Gemini 3.1 Pro, GPT 5.6 Series, Grok 4.5, Claude model through API

summary.zh: CLIProxyAPI 将多种命令行 AI 工具（如 Antigravity、Claude Code）封装为 OpenAI/Gemini/Claude 兼容 API，支持多账户本地访问，让用户通过标准客户端免费调用 Gemini、GPT、Claude 等模型，简化模型集成。
summary.en: CLIProxyAPI is a proxy server that wraps CLI-based AI tools like Antigravity, ChatGPT Codex, Claude Code, and Grok Build into OpenAI/Gemini/Claude/Codex-compatible APIs. It enables local access with multiple CLI accounts through any compatible client or SDK, allowing users to leverage models such as Gemini, GPT, and Claude via a standardized interface, simplifying integration and unlocking free access.

metadata.name: OpenHands
metadata.description: 🙌 OpenHands: AI-Driven Development

summary.zh: OpenHands Agent Canvas是一个自托管的开发者控制中心，用于统一管理和运行多种AI编码代理（如OpenHands、Claude Code、Codex等），支持本地、Docker、虚拟机及云环境。它可将编码代理转化为始终在线的工程团队，自动执行生成报告、分解GitHub问题等日常任务，并通过ACP协议集成Slack等工具，提升开发自动化水平。
summary.en: OpenHands Agent Canvas is a self-hosted developer control center for managing and running AI coding agents like OpenHands, Claude Code, and Codex across local, Docker, VM, or cloud backends. It turns coding agents into an always-on engineering team, automating tasks such as generating Slack reports and decomposing GitHub issues, with ACP-based integration for seamless workflows.

metadata.name: zai-api
metadata.description: ZAI-API：支持Tools、CCR转接CC、Kilo Code等

summary.zh: 本项目提供OpenAI兼容API服务器，将标准OpenAI格式请求转换为Z.AI API调用，支持glm-4.6v/glm-5/glm-4.7等模型，兼容Cline、Roo Code、Kilo Code等第三方插件，具备流式响应、Docker部署、健康检查等特性，便于开发者快速接入大模型能力。
summary.en: This project is an OpenAI-compatible API server that converts standard OpenAI requests to Z.AI API calls. It supports glm-4.6v/glm-5/glm-4.7 models, integrates with Cline, Roo Code, Kilo Code, and offers streaming, Docker deployment, health checks, and more for seamless LLM integration.

metadata.name: claude-code-infrastructure-showcase
metadata.description: Examples of my Claude Code infrastructure with skill auto-activation, hooks, and agents

summary.zh: 这是一个Claude Code基础设施的参考库，基于6个月实际项目经验，提供技能自动激活、钩子和智能体的生产级配置。通过skill-rules.json实现技能按需触发，支持模块化技能模式和专用智能体，可快速集成到现有项目，显著提升AI编码助手的自动化与可维护性。
summary.en: This repository is a curated reference library of production-tested Claude Code infrastructure, developed from six months of real-world use managing a complex TypeScript microservices project. It demonstrates how to solve the problem of skills not activating automatically by using hooks and skill-rules.json. Showcased patterns include modular skill design with progressive disclosure, specialized agents for complex tasks, and a documentation system that survives context resets. It provides a setup wizard with eight health checks and integrates into projects in 15-30 minutes. This is not a working app but a collection of copy-paste-ready examples for scaling Claude Code in enterprise development.

summary.zh: 该仓库提供 blackbox 服务的逆向接口，兼容 OpenAI 聊天 API 格式。基于 FastAPI，支持流式与非流式响应、CORS、日志，可部署为 Docker。支持 gpt-4o、Gemini、Claude 等多种模型，通过 APP_SECRET 认证，可作为通用 AI 代理服务。
summary.en: This repository provides a reverse-engineered API for the blackbox service, compatible with OpenAI chat API format. Built on FastAPI, it supports streaming and non-streaming responses, CORS, logging, and Docker deployment. It supports models like gpt-4o, Gemini, and Claude, with APP_SECRET authentication, serving as a universal AI proxy.

metadata.name: z.ai2api_python
metadata.description: 将Z.ai转换为OpenAI兼容格式的高性能代理，无缝接入 GLM-4.5 系列模型

summary.zh: 基于FastAPI的轻量级代理服务，将Z.ai转换为OpenAI兼容API，支持GLM-4.5系列模型无缝接入。提供SSE流式响应、Function Call工具调用与思考模式，兼容Cline等AI客户端，支持Docker部署，是大模型应用集成的桥梁。
summary.en: A lightweight FastAPI-based proxy that converts Z.ai into an OpenAI-compatible API, enabling seamless integration with GLM-4.5 series models. Supports SSE streaming, function calling, and thinking mode, compatible with AI clients like Cline, and Docker deployment.

metadata.name: z.ai2api_python
metadata.description: 仅供学习

summary.zh: 基于 FastAPI 与 Granian 的 GLM 代理服务，兼容 OpenAI、Claude Code 和 Anthropic 接口，支持流式响应与工具调用。内置 Token 池管理、熔断恢复、SQLite 存储及可视化后台，适合本地开发与自托管部署，可通过 Docker 快速启动。
summary.en: A GLM proxy service built with FastAPI and Granian, compatible with OpenAI, Claude Code, and Anthropic APIs, supporting streaming and tool calls. Features token pool management, circuit breaking, SQLite storage, and an admin dashboard for local development and self-hosted deployment via Docker.

metadata.name: nanoGPT
metadata.description: The simplest, fastest repository for training/finetuning medium-sized GPTs.

summary.zh: 用于训练和微调中型GPT的极简仓库。核心代码仅数百行，可完整复现GPT-2经典模型的训练。模型代码清晰，支持加载预训练权重，便于从零训练或迁移学习。附带字符级数据集示例，数分钟内即可上手体验。其设计重点是训练速度与代码可读性，适合快速迭代。
summary.en: nanoGPT is a minimal and efficient repository for training and fine-tuning medium-sized GPT models. With roughly 300 lines of training loop and model definition, it reproduces GPT-2 124M training on OpenWebText. The code is clean and easily hackable, supporting OpenAI pretrained weights. Ideal for training from scratch or fine-tuning existing models, with a character-level Shakespeare generation example for quick start. The project prioritizes simplicity and speed, making it easy to adapt to custom needs. It is under active development and provides configs for reproducible runs.

summary.zh: 这是一个多渠道AI API统一转换代理系统，支持OpenAI、Anthropic Claude、Google Gemini三种API格式的相互转换，实现请求格式识别、渠道路由、格式转换、转发与响应转换，具备流式响应、函数调用等高级功能，并提供多格式模型列表与能力检测。
summary.en: This is a multi-channel AI API unified conversion proxy system supporting mutual conversion among OpenAI, Anthropic Claude, and Google Gemini API formats. It implements format detection, channel routing, format conversion, request forwarding, and response conversion, with advanced features like streaming, function calling, and multi-format model listing.

metadata.name: OpenAI-Compatible-API-Proxy-for-Z
metadata.description: 这是一个为 Zai 提供 OpenAI API 兼容接口的代理服务，允许开发者通过标准的 OpenAI API 格式访问 Zai 的 GLM-4.5 模型。

summary.zh: 这是一个为Z.ai GLM-4.5模型提供OpenAI兼容API接口的代理服务，使开发者能够使用标准OpenAI格式调用模型。支持流式响应、自定义密钥和模型名，可一键部署到Render，便于无缝集成已有OpenAI生态。
summary.en: This proxy service provides an OpenAI-compatible API for Z.ai's GLM-4.5 model, allowing developers to use standard OpenAI format to access the model. It supports streaming, custom keys, and model names, and can be deployed to Render easily for seamless integration.

summary.zh: 一个OpenAI兼容的API代理服务器，统一访问Anthropic、OpenAI、Google等LLM模型。支持智能推理级别控制、自动格式转换、流式响应、多重认证授权，并提供Docker部署与Claude Code无缝集成，简化多模型接入与管理。
summary.en: An OpenAI-compatible API proxy server that unifies access to multiple LLM providers including Anthropic, OpenAI, and Google Gemini. It offers intelligent reasoning level control with five modes, automatic format conversion, streaming response, and flexible authentication with priority fallback. Built on Node.js and Express, it supports Docker deployment, proxy round-robin, and seamless Claude Code integration. Additionally, it handles token refresh and system prompt injection, making it a production-ready gateway for diverse model ecosystems and AI agents.

metadata.name: yuque-chrome-extension
metadata.description: 🚀🚀🚀 语雀浏览器插件

summary.zh: 语雀官方浏览器插件，支持 Chrome 和 Edge，提供网页一键剪藏、笔记保存与知识管理功能，帮助用户高效收集和整理信息。基于浏览器扩展技术，深度集成语雀 API，操作简便，提升工作效率。
summary.en: Official Yuque browser extension supporting Chrome and Edge, offering one-click web clipping, note saving, and knowledge management. Built with browser extension technologies and deeply integrated with Yuque API for efficient information collection and organization.

metadata.name: ZtoApi
metadata.description: 佛法GLM-4.6 For Kilo CODE、Roo Code

summary.zh: 本仓库实现OpenAI兼容API代理，将Z.ai的GLM-4.6模型接口转换为标准OpenAI格式，支持流式输出、API密钥验证与Docker部署，并内置实时监控仪表板。适用于需要以OpenAI API方式调用GLM-4.6的开发者，解决了2025年客户端验证问题，确保稳定访问。
summary.en: This project provides an OpenAI-compatible API proxy for Z.ai GLM-4.6, converting the model's native endpoint into standard OpenAI format. It supports streaming, API key authentication, Docker deployment, and a real-time dashboard. Developers can integrate GLM-4.6 seamlessly, with fixes for the 2025 client verification issue ensuring reliable access.

metadata.name: new-api
metadata.description: A unified AI model hub for aggregation & distribution. It supports cross-converting various LLMs into OpenAI-compatible, Claude-compatible, or Gemini-compatible formats. A centralized gateway for personal and enterprise model management.

summary.zh: new-api 是一个新一代大语言模型网关与AI资产管理平台，支持将多种LLM统一转换为OpenAI、Claude或Gemini兼容API，实现集中式模型接入与分发。适用于个人与企业私有化部署，提供认证、计费、用量分析与成本核算等能力，是高效的AI模型管理基础设施。
summary.en: new-api is a next-generation LLM gateway and AI asset management platform that aggregates diverse language models and exposes them through OpenAI-, Claude-, or Gemini-compatible APIs. It enables centralized model access, authentication, usage analytics, and cost tracking for both personal and enterprise deployments, making it a robust foundation for AI model management.

metadata.name: claude-code-spec-workflow
metadata.description: Automated workflows for Claude Code. Features spec-driven development for new features (Requirements → Design → Tasks → Implementation) and streamlined bug fix workflow for quick issue resolution (Report → Analyze → Fix → Verify).

summary.zh: 这个工具为 Claude Code 提供自动化开发工作流，支持规格驱动开发（需求→设计→任务→实现）和高效 Bug 修复（报告→分析→修复→验证）。它包含智能代理、实时仪表盘和项目导引，能结构化分解任务并自动执行，显著提升开发效率。
summary.en: This tool provides automated workflows for Claude Code, featuring spec-driven development (Requirements→Design→Tasks→Implementation) and streamlined bug-fix flow (Report→Analyze→Fix→Verify). It includes intelligent agents, real-time dashboard, and project steering, enabling structured task breakdown and automated execution to boost development efficiency.

metadata.name: SuperClaude_Framework
metadata.description: A configuration framework that enhances Claude Code with specialized commands, cognitive personas, and development methodologies.

summary.zh: SuperClaude 是一个基于 Claude Code 的元编程配置框架，通过注入行为指令和组件编排，提供30个斜杠命令、20个AI代理、7种模式和8个MCP服务器集成，将 Claude Code 转变为结构化开发平台，覆盖从需求分析到部署的完整开发流程，提升开发自动化水平。
summary.en: SuperClaude is a meta-programming configuration framework that enhances Claude Code with specialized commands, cognitive personas, and development methodologies. It provides 30 slash commands, 20 AI agents, 7 modes, and 8 MCP server integrations, transforming Claude Code into a structured development platform covering the full lifecycle from brainstorming to deployment.

metadata.name: Handy
metadata.description: A free, open source, and extensible speech-to-text application that works completely offline.

summary.zh: Handy 是一款免费开源的离线语音转文字桌面应用，支持 Windows、macOS 和 Linux。基于 Tauri（React + Rust）构建，利用 Whisper 和 Parakeet 模型实现本地实时转录，无需联网，保护隐私。支持全局快捷键、VAD 静音检测及 GPU 加速，具备高度可扩展性，适用于无障碍输入和高效办公场景。
summary.en: Handy is a free, open-source, offline speech-to-text desktop app for Windows, macOS, and Linux. Built with Tauri (React + Rust), it leverages Whisper and Parakeet models for local real-time transcription, ensuring privacy by keeping audio on-device. Features include global shortcuts, VAD, GPU acceleration, and extensibility, ideal for accessibility and productivity.

metadata.name: CCometixLine
metadata.description: Claude Code statusline tool written in Rust

summary.zh: CCometixLine是一款用Rust编写的高性能状态行工具，专为Claude Code设计。它集成Git信息、模型显示、使用统计和目录展示，提供交互式TUI配置与多主题定制，还能禁用上下文警告、启用详细模式，并自动备份，提升Claude Code的整体使用体验。
summary.en: CCometixLine is a high-performance statusline tool written in Rust for Claude Code. It integrates Git info, model display, usage tracking, and directory view, offers interactive TUI configuration with multiple themes, and can disable context warnings, enable verbose mode, with automatic backups, enhancing the Claude Code experience.

metadata.name: cc-sdd
metadata.description: Turn approved specs into long-running autonomous implementation. A minimal, adaptable SDD harness with Agent Skills for Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, Copilot, Windsurf, OpenCode, Gemini CLI, and Antigravity.

summary.zh: cc-sdd 是一个规范驱动的 AI 编程代理自动化框架，能将已批准的需求规格自动转化为长期运行的自主实现流程。它内置 17 种 Agent Skills，支持 Claude Code、Codex 等 8 种主流编程代理，通过边界优先设计、任务级独立审查和 TDD 循环，实现从发现、设计到实现的多代理协作与持续演进。
summary.en: cc-sdd is a spec-driven automation framework for AI coding agents that turns approved specifications into long-running autonomous implementation. It provides 17 Agent Skills across 8 coding agents, featuring boundary-first discipline, per-task independent review, and TDD loops, enabling multi-agent collaboration from discovery to deployment.

metadata.name: spec-kit
metadata.description: 💫 Toolkit to help you get started with Spec-Driven Development

summary.zh: Spec Kit 是一个开源工具包，用于推动规范驱动开发（SDD），让规范直接生成可运行代码，而非仅作参考。它提供 Specify CLI，支持初始化项目、管理模板，并能与任意 AI 编程代理（如 Copilot）集成，帮助团队在编码前明确需求，提升软件质量与开发效率。
summary.en: Spec Kit is an open-source toolkit enabling Spec-Driven Development, turning specifications into executable implementations. It provides the Specify CLI for project initialization and template management, integrates with any AI coding agent like Copilot, and helps teams clarify requirements before coding to boost quality and efficiency.

metadata.name: blinko
metadata.description: An open-source, self-hosted personal AI note tool prioritizing privacy, built using TypeScript .

summary.zh: Blinko 是一款开源、自托管的 AI 笔记工具，基于 TypeScript 和 Tauri 构建，支持多平台部署。它利用 RAG 技术实现自然语言检索，帮助用户快速捕捉和组织灵感，数据完全由用户掌控，注重隐私保护。轻量高效，支持 Docker 一键部署，适合个人知识管理与快速记录。
summary.en: Blinko is an open-source, self-hosted AI note-taking tool built with TypeScript and Tauri, supporting multi-platform deployment. It leverages RAG for natural language search, helping users quickly capture and organize ideas. Data stays in your control, ensuring privacy. Lightweight and efficient, with one-click Docker setup, ideal for personal knowledge management.

metadata.name: myclaude
metadata.description: Multi-agent orchestration workflow (Claude Code  Codex Gemini OpenCode)

summary.zh: 多智能体编排框架，集成Claude Code、Codex、Gemini、OpenCode，以模块化技能覆盖开发全流程，npx一键安装提升AI开发自动化。
summary.en: Multi-agent orchestration for AI dev unifying Claude, Codex, Gemini, OpenCode. Modular skills automate lifecycle via npx.

metadata.name: Google-AI-Studio-Gemini-Key-Scripts
metadata.description: 本仓库包含了 3 个核心脚本，帮助你批量创建 Google Cloud 项目并获取 Google AI Studio（Gemini）API Key。适用于需要大量管理 Key 或频繁创建新项目的场景。

summary.zh: 本仓库提供3个核心脚本，用于批量创建Google Cloud项目并自动获取或管理Google AI Studio（Gemini）API Key。支持油猴脚本和浏览器控制台脚本，可高效批量生成密钥、提取现有密钥，适用于需要大规模管理API Key或频繁创建项目的开发场景。
summary.en: This repository contains 3 core scripts to batch-create Google Cloud projects and automatically obtain or manage Google AI Studio (Gemini) API keys. It supports Tampermonkey user scripts and browser console scripts, enabling bulk key generation and existing key extraction, ideal for developers managing many API keys or creating projects frequently.

metadata.name: auto-cursor-releases
metadata.description: 源代码

summary.zh: 基于Tauri 2、React与Rust的跨平台桌面应用，专为Cursor账号管理打造。提供Token批量管理、Machine ID备份恢复、无感换号、自动化注册及验证码兜底流程，支持浅/深色主题。通过本地文件操作与系统集成，帮助开发者高效维护多个Cursor账号，降低手动操作成本。
summary.en: Auto Cursor is a cross-platform desktop application built with Tauri 2, React, and Rust, designed for efficient Cursor account management. It offers batch token import/export, Machine ID backup/restore, quick account switching, and automated registration with CAPTCHA auto-fill and manual fallback. Additionally, it manages Codex token files, displays subscription information, and provides a light/dark theme UI. Operating locally on system configurations, it protects user privacy and significantly boosts productivity for developers handling multiple Cursor accounts across platforms. Overall, it combines power and simplicity for everyday tasks.

metadata.name: fuclaude-switcher
metadata.description: 简洁优雅的fuclaude工具

summary.zh: FuClaude切换器是一款基于Next.js的现代化Web应用，用于无缝管理Claude访问。它支持手机、桌面和平板等多平台，无需VPN即可一键访问，自动生成带隔离的访问链接，并提供会话密钥管理与分享功能。集成了Clerk社交登录和Neon数据库，部署于Vercel，界面清爽直观，适合追求快速便捷访问Claude的用户。
summary.en: FuClaude Switcher is a modern web app built with Next.js for seamless Claude access management. It supports multiple platforms like mobile, desktop, and tablet, enabling one-click Claude access without VPN. It auto-generates isolated access links, manages session keys, and offers link sharing. With Clerk social login, Neon database, and Vercel deployment, it provides a clean and intuitive UI for effortless Claude usage.

metadata.name: Claude-Code-Workflow
metadata.description: JSON-driven multi-agent  cadence-team development framework with   intelligent CLI orchestration (Gemini/Qwen/Codex),   context-first architecture, and automated workflow   execution

summary.zh: 基于 JSON 驱动的多智能体开发框架，通过 Gemini、Qwen、Codex 等 CLI 智能编排，实现自动化工作流执行。支持技能化工作流、会话生命周期、终端仪表盘与团队协作，采用上下文优先架构，提升复杂 AI 编程效率。
summary.en: A JSON-driven multi-agent development framework that orchestrates CLI tools like Gemini, Qwen, and Codex for automated workflow execution. It features skill-based workflows, session lifecycle management, terminal dashboards, and team collaboration, all built on a context-first architecture to streamline complex AI programming tasks.

metadata.name: zcf
metadata.description: Zero-Config Code Flow for Claude code & Codex

summary.zh: ZCF 是面向 Claude Code 与 Codex 的零配置命令行工具，一键完成初始化、工作流、API/CCR 与 MCP 配置，支持双语与交互式菜单，内置智能体系统，大幅提升 AI 编程效率。
summary.en: ZCF is a zero-config CLI for Claude Code & Codex: one-command setup of workflows, API/CCR, and MCP, with an interactive menu, bilingual support, and an intelligent agent system to boost AI coding efficiency.

metadata.name: gcli2api
metadata.description: 将 GeminiCLI 和 Antigravity 转换为 OpenAI 、GEMINI 和 Claude API 接口

summary.zh: gcli2api 将 GeminiCLI 和 Antigravity 转换为 OpenAI、Gemini 和 Claude 兼容的 API 服务，支持多端点自动格式检测与转换，提供安全的认证机制，并支持 Docker、Termux、Windows、Linux、macOS 等主流平台快速部署，降低了 AI 模型调用的接入门槛，适合开发者构建统一 API 网关。
summary.en: gcli2api converts GeminiCLI and Antigravity into OpenAI, Gemini, and Claude compatible APIs. It offers multiple endpoints with automatic format detection, supports multimodal inputs, and provides simple deployment via Docker, Termux, Windows, Linux, and macOS. Ideal for developers seeking a unified API gateway for AI models.

metadata.name: gemini-balance-lite
metadata.description: Gemini API 代理, 把Gemini API免费中转到国内。还可以聚合多个Gemini API Key，随机选取API Key的使用实现负载均衡，使得Gemini API免费成倍增加。

summary.zh: 该项目是一个Gemini API代理服务，基于无服务器边缘函数部署，可将Gemini API免费中转至国内使用。支持聚合多个API Key，随机选取实现负载均衡，使免费额度成倍增加。兼容OpenAI格式，支持流式输出，可一键部署到Vercel、Deno、Cloudflare Workers等平台。
summary.en: This project is a Gemini API proxy service built on serverless edge functions, providing free relay of Gemini API to mainland China. It aggregates multiple API keys and randomly selects one for load balancing, effectively multiplying free quota. Compatible with OpenAI API format, supports streaming, and can be deployed to Vercel, Deno, Cloudflare Workers, etc.

metadata.name: cc-switch
metadata.description: A cross-platform desktop All-in-One assistant for Claude Code, Codex, OpenCode, OpenClaw, Grok Build & Hermes Agent. Only official website: ccswitch.io

summary.zh: CC Switch是一款基于Tauri构建的跨平台桌面助手，集中管理Claude Code、Codex、OpenCode、Grok Build等多个AI编码与代理工具的配置。支持快速切换API端点、模型提供商与预设，简化开发者环境配置，提升工作效率。
summary.en: CC Switch is a Tauri-based cross-platform desktop assistant that centrally manages configurations for Claude Code, Codex, OpenCode, Grok Build, and other AI coding and agent tools. It enables quick switching between API endpoints, model providers, and presets, simplifying developer environment setup and boosting productivity.

metadata.name: gpt-load
metadata.description: Multi-channel AI proxy with intelligent key rotation. 智能密钥轮询的多渠道 AI 代理。

summary.zh: GPT-Load是一个用Go编写的高性能AI API透明代理服务，支持多渠道接入，智能密钥轮询与负载均衡，确保高并发生产环境下的稳定与可用。具备动态配置热加载、集群部署和监控管理，简化企业AI服务集成。
summary.en: GPT-Load is a high-performance AI API transparent proxy built in Go, enabling multi-channel integration with intelligent key rotation and load balancing for high-concurrency production environments. It features hot-reload configuration, distributed deployment, and comprehensive monitoring, simplifying enterprise AI service aggregation.

metadata.name: AIClient2API
metadata.description: Self-hosted multi-protocol AI API proxy for Antigravity, Codex, Grok, Kiro, OpenAI, Claude, and custom providers. Supports OpenAI-compatible API, Claude API, Gemini protocol conversion, GPT, Grok Build, Claude Opus, Gemini Pro, Kimi, MiniMax, provider pools, smart routing, and automatic failover.

summary.zh: AIClient2API 是一个自托管的高性能 AI API 代理网关，将 Gemini CLI、Antigravity、Codex、Grok 等客户端专用模型接口统一转换为 OpenAI 兼容的 API。支持多协议转换、智能路由、自动故障转移和模型池，基于 Node.js 和 Docker 部署，Docker 下载量超 10 万，是构建企业级 AI 接入层的高效开源方案。
summary.en: AIClient2API is a powerful, self-hosted multi-protocol AI API proxy gateway that converts various client-only large model APIs (e.g., Gemini CLI, Antigravity, Codex, Grok, Kiro) into a local OpenAI-compatible interface. It features provider pools, smart routing, automatic failover, and supports OpenAI-compatible, Claude, Gemini, GPT, Grok, Kimi, and MiniMax protocols. Built on Node.js and deployable via Docker, it has surpassed 100k Docker pulls and is ranked #2 on Trendshift, making it a highly effective open-source solution for building enterprise-grade AI access infrastructure.

metadata.name: agents
metadata.description: sharing current agents in use

summary.zh: 该仓库是Contains Studio的AI智能体集合，包含设计、工程、产品、营销等领域的30余个专业子智能体（如快速原型、趋势研究、品牌守护）。用户可将其一键安装至Claude Code环境，按需触发以加速产品开发、设计迭代与增长运营，实现端到端的自动化协作。
summary.en: This repository is Contains Studio's collection of specialized AI agents covering design, engineering, product, marketing, and operations. With 30+ expert sub-agents (e.g., rapid prototyper, trend researcher, brand guardian), users can install them into Claude Code and trigger on demand to accelerate development, design iteration, and growth operations.

metadata.name: learn-claude-code
metadata.description: Bash is all you need -  A nano claude code–like 「agent harness」, built from 0 to 1

summary.zh: 以Bash从零构建一个极简Claude Code式Agent Harness，系统阐述智能体产品=模型+基础设施的核心理念。通过DQN、OpenAI Five等历史案例，阐明智能源自模型训练而非外部编排，并教你打造承载模型的“车辆”。适合想深入理解Agent内部机制的开发者。
summary.en: Build a nano Claude Code-like agent harness from scratch using Bash. It systematically explains the principle that an agent product equals model plus harness, showing agency comes from model training via cases like DQN and OpenAI Five, and teaches you to build the vehicle that carries the model. Ideal for developers seeking deep insight into agent internals.

metadata.name: claude-relay-service
metadata.description: CRS-自建Claude Code镜像，一站式开源中转服务，让 Claude、OpenAI、Gemini、Droid 订阅统一接入，支持拼车共享，更高效分摊成本，原生工具无缝使用。

summary.zh: CRS是一款开源的Claude Code中转服务，支持多账户轮换、统一API接入，整合Claude/OpenAI/Gemini等订阅，实现拼车共享成本。提供Web监控面板、智能切换、访问控制等功能，支持Docker与一键脚本部署，适合解决地区限制、隐私保护及稳定性问题。
summary.en: CRS is an open-source relay service for Claude Code, offering multi-account rotation and unified API access to Claude, OpenAI, Gemini, and more. It enables shared subscription cost splitting, with features like a web dashboard, smart failover, and access control. Supports Docker and one-click script deployment, ideal for bypassing regional restrictions, ensuring privacy, and improving stability.

metadata.name: BMAD-METHOD
metadata.description: Breakthrough Method for Agile Ai Driven Development

summary.zh: 本方法是一套敏捷式人工智能驱动开发方法论，通过澄清、规划、构建、学习循环将需求转化为可运行软件。它使决策显式化、上下文持续传递，适配新旧代码库，从原型到复杂系统均适用，帮助开发者在人工智能辅助下保持掌控。
summary.en: Agile AI-driven dev: turns ideas into software via structured loops, keeping decisions explicit.

metadata.name: playwright-mcp
metadata.description: Playwright MCP server

summary.zh: 微软推出的 Playwright MCP 服务器，将浏览器自动化能力封装为 MCP 接口，让 LLM 基于结构化可访问性快照与网页交互，无需截图或视觉模型。轻量快速、确定性高，适用于 AI 智能体、自愈测试与长期自主工作流，兼容 VS Code、Claude Desktop 等 MCP 客户端。
summary.en: Microsoft's Playwright MCP server wraps Playwright browser automation as a Model Context Protocol interface, letting LLMs interact with web pages via structured accessibility snapshots without screenshots or vision models. It is lightweight, fast, and deterministic, ideal for AI agents, self-healing tests, and long-running autonomous workflows, compatible with VS Code, Claude Desktop, and other MCP clients.

metadata.name: happy-llm
metadata.description: 📚 从零开始构建大模型

summary.zh: 开源免费的LLM系统学习教程，从NLP基础、Transformer架构到动手实现LLaMA2，覆盖预训练、SFT、LoRA微调、RAG与Agent等全流程，理论与实践结合，助你从零构建大模型。
summary.en: A free, open-source systematic tutorial for building LLMs from scratch. Covering NLP basics, Transformer architecture, implementing LLaMA2, and full pipeline from pretraining to fine-tuning, RAG and Agents. Theory with hands-on practice.

metadata.name: claude-code-router
metadata.description: One local control plane for every AI agent: route across models, fuse new capabilities, orchestrate tools, and stay fully in control.

summary.zh: Claude Code Router 是一个本地控制平面，为 Claude Code、Codex 等 AI 编码代理提供统一网关。它支持跨模型路由、故障转移、工具编排与请求观测，集中管理提供商、模型和路由规则，避免为每个客户端单独配置，提升开发流程灵活性与可观测性。
summary.en: Claude Code Router is a local control plane for AI coding agents, offering a unified gateway for Claude Code, Codex, and more. It enables cross-model routing, failover, tool orchestration, and request observability, centralizing provider, model, and routing rule management without per-client configuration.

metadata.name: agents
metadata.description: Multi-harness agentic plugin marketplace for Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, OpenCode, GitHub Copilot, and Google Antigravity

summary.zh: 该项目是一个面向 Claude Code、Codex CLI、Cursor 等主流 AI 编程助手的代理插件市场，提供 94 个插件、203 个代理、175 个技能和 109 个命令。通过单一 Markdown 源自动生成各平台原生产物，支持按需加载、多代理编排及分层模型策略，显著提升开发自动化水平。
summary.en: This project is a multi-harness agentic plugin marketplace for major AI coding assistants such as Claude Code, Codex CLI, and Cursor. It offers 94 plugins, 203 agents, 175 skills, and 109 commands. From a single Markdown source, it generates idiomatic native artifacts for each platform, supporting on-demand loading, multi-agent orchestration, and a tiered model strategy to boost development automation.

metadata.name: siyuan-patch
metadata.description: 思源笔记本地VIP (功能特性)(第三方 S3 数据同步)

summary.zh: 该项目为思源笔记提供本地VIP补丁，解锁第三方S3/WebDAV同步、搜索资源文件内容、导出水印等付费功能，同时禁用自动更新与遥测，保护隐私。支持多平台客户端及Docker构建，适合需要高级功能的用户。
summary.en: This project provides a local VIP patch for SiYuan Note, unlocking paid features like third-party S3/WebDAV sync, content search in resources, and PDF/image watermarks. It also disables auto-update and telemetry for privacy, supporting multiple platforms and Docker builds.

metadata.name: ima-download
metadata.description: ima 知识库下载

summary.zh: ima-download 是一个用于下载 ima 知识库内容的轻量工具，用户只需在 Main 函数中修改 SHARE_ID 并运行即可获取所需资源，适合快速备份或迁移知识库数据，操作简单直接。
summary.en: ima-download is a lightweight tool for downloading content from ima knowledge base. Users simply modify SHARE_ID in the Main function and run it to fetch resources, making it easy to back up or migrate knowledge base data.

metadata.name: siyuan-unlock
metadata.description: 思源笔记免登录版本；可以不登录使用同步功能

summary.zh: 思源笔记免登录版本，无需登录账号即可使用云同步功能。提供Docker镜像，支持自定义PUID/PGID权限和访问授权码，便于自托管部署，适用于个人知识管理与多端同步场景。
summary.en: A no-login version of SiYuan Note enabling sync without an account. Offers Docker image deployment with custom PUID/PGID permissions and access auth code, ideal for self-hosted knowledge management and cross-device sync.

metadata.name: BestBlogs
metadata.description: bestblogs.dev - 汇集顶级编程、人工智能、产品、科技文章，大语言模型摘要评分辅助阅读，探索编程和技术未来

summary.zh: BestBlogs是AI驱动的私人阅读助手，聚合RSS、Newsletter、推特等源，利用大语言模型进行六维评分与摘要，辅助用户筛选高质量文章。支持中英双语沉浸式翻译和个性化早报，帮助用户高效阅读技术、AI、产品等领域内容。
summary.en: BestBlogs is an AI-powered personal reading assistant that aggregates RSS, newsletters, Twitter, and more. It uses LLMs to score and summarize articles across six dimensions, helping users discover high-quality content. It offers immersive bilingual translation and personalized daily briefs for efficient reading in tech, AI, and product domains.

metadata.name: quick-prompt
metadata.description: Quick Prompt ✨ 提示词管理与快捷输入浏览器插件 | Browser extension for prompt management and quick input ✨

summary.zh: Quick Prompt 是一款浏览器插件，专注于提示词管理与快速输入。用户可创建、分类、编辑提示词库，并支持变量、标签及附件。通过快捷键或斜杠命令，在任何网页输入框中快速插入预设提示词，提升AI工具使用效率。支持WebDAV、Notion、Gist等多端同步，以及数据导出导入和自动明暗主题。
summary.en: Quick Prompt is a browser extension for prompt management and quick input. It lets users create, organize, and edit prompt libraries with support for variables, tags, and attachments. Users can trigger the prompt picker via slash commands or shortcuts in any input field, boosting AI workflow efficiency. Features include WebDAV/Notion/Gist sync, data export/import, and auto light/dark theme.

metadata.name: yuque-dl
metadata.description: yuque 语雀知识库下载

summary.zh: 基于Node.js的命令行工具，可将语雀知识库批量下载为本地Markdown文件，支持单个文档、多个知识库及当前账号全部内容，兼容私有库、企业服务、密码访问等场景，提供增量下载、附件过滤和内置Web预览功能。
summary.en: A Node.js CLI tool that downloads Yuque knowledge bases to local Markdown files. It supports single docs, batch repos, and all user's repos, handles private/enterprise/password-protected content, and offers incremental updates, attachment filters, and a built-in preview server.

metadata.name: cursor-auto-account
metadata.description: 这是一个用于管理 Cursor 账号的 Web 服务，支持自动注册、存储账号信息、查看和修改账号状态。

summary.zh: 这是一个用于自动注册和管理 Cursor 账号的 Web 服务，支持账号批量注册、信息存储、状态查看与修改，提供 RESTful API 和图形化管理页面，并可通过 Docker 快速部署，有效提升账号获取与管理效率。
summary.en: A web service for auto-registering and managing Cursor accounts, featuring batch registration, account storage, status viewing and modification, RESTful APIs, a management UI, and Docker deployment for efficient account handling.

metadata.name: llm-universe
metadata.description: 本项目是一个面向小白开发者的大模型应用开发教程，在线阅读地址：https://datawhalechina.github.io/llm-universe/

summary.zh: 面向小白开发者的大模型应用开发教程，基于个人知识库助手项目，系统讲解大模型API调用、LangChain、知识库搭建、RAG应用构建与验证迭代。统一封装主流大模型API，提供免费服务器环境，通过项目实战帮助零基础开发者快速入门LLM应用开发。
summary.en: A beginner-friendly tutorial for LLM application development, based on a personal knowledge base assistant project. It covers LLM API usage, LangChain, knowledge base construction, RAG application development, and iterative validation. Unified wrappers for mainstream LLM APIs and free cloud server resources enable hands-on learning, helping developers with no AI background quickly master core skills.

metadata.name: awesome-chatgpt-zh
metadata.description: ChatGPT 中文指南🔥，ChatGPT 中文调教指南，指令指南，应用开发指南，精选资源清单，更好的使用 chatGPT 让你的生产力 up up up! 🚀

summary.zh: 面向中文用户的 ChatGPT 与 AI 大模型资源大全，系统整理提示工程、GPTs、Claude Skills、MCP 协议、RAG、编程智能体及 AI 生产力工具等前沿主题，收录海量精选案例与开发指南，助力提升个人与团队生产力。
summary.en: A comprehensive Chinese guide to ChatGPT and large language models, featuring curated resources on prompt engineering, GPTs, Claude Skills, MCP, RAG, coding agents, and AI productivity tools, enabling users to harness AI effectively.

metadata.name: LangGPT
metadata.description: LangGPT: Empowering everyone to become a prompt expert! 🚀  📌 结构化提示词（Structured Prompt）提出者 📌 元提示词（Meta-Prompt）发起者   📌 最流行的提示词落地范式 | Language of GPT  The pioneering framework for structured & meta-prompt design 10,000+ ⭐ | Battle-tested by thousands of users worldwide  Created by 云中江树

summary.zh: LangGPT 是首个面向大语言模型的结构化提示词设计框架，由云中江树于2023年提出，并已发表学术论文（arXiv:2402.16929）。它采用类似编程的模板化、模块化方法，将提示词工程从零散技巧升级为系统方法论，支持变量、条件逻辑与高度复用。该项目在 GitHub 拥有超万星标，提供完整生态（GPTs、Kimi+ 等），可帮助任何用户快速生成高质量、可迭代的结构化提示词，已被主流模型深度吸收。
summary.en: LangGPT is a pioneering structured prompt design framework for large language models, proposed by Yunzhong Jiangshu in 2023 and backed by academic research (arXiv:2402.16929). It applies programming-inspired templates, modularity, and reusability to prompt engineering, replacing ad-hoc tips with a systematic methodology. With 10,000+ GitHub stars and an ecosystem of automated tools (GPTs, Kimi+), it enables anyone to create high-quality, reusable structured prompts in minutes, and has been deeply internalized by mainstream models.

metadata.name: gemini-balance
metadata.description: Gemini polling proxy service （gemini轮询代理服务）

summary.zh: Gemini Balance 是一个基于 Python FastAPI 的 Gemini API 代理与负载均衡服务，支持多 API Key 轮询、可视化配置、双协议（Gemini/OpenAI）兼容，并具备图像生成、Web 搜索及实时监控功能，适合个人或团队安全高效地管理 Gemini API 调用。
summary.en: Gemini Balance is a FastAPI-based proxy and load balancer for Google Gemini API. It supports multi-key rotation, dynamic configuration, dual-protocol compatibility (Gemini and OpenAI formats), along with image generation, web search, and real-time key status monitoring, enabling efficient and secure API management.

metadata.name: WeChatReaderEnhancer
metadata.description: 公众号阅读增强插件是一款 Chrome 浏览器扩展，旨在提升用户阅读微信公众号文章的体验。通过自动生成文章的结构化目录，让您轻松了解文章结构、快速导航到感兴趣的部分，并在阅读长文时保持位置感知。

summary.zh: 公众号阅读增强插件是Chrome浏览器扩展，自动生成文章目录，支持图片放大、URL链接识别与转换，并实时高亮阅读位置。适合电脑端阅读微信长文，提升导航效率与阅读体验。
summary.en: Chrome extension: auto TOC, image zoom, link conversion, reading position tracking for WeChat articles.

metadata.name: jeepay
metadata.description: Jeepay是一套适合互联网企业使用的开源支付系统，支持多渠道服务商和普通商户模式。已对接微信支付，支付宝，云闪付官方接口，支持聚合码支付。

summary.zh: Jeepay是一套面向互联网企业的开源支付系统，支持普通商户与服务商模式，已对接微信、支付宝、云闪付等主流渠道。基于Spring Boot 3.3.7与Ant Design Vue开发，支持聚合码支付、多商户多应用接入，提供Docker及Shell一键部署，适合自建聚合支付或支付中台。
summary.en: Jeepay is an open-source payment system for internet enterprises, supporting merchant and service provider modes. It integrates WeChat Pay, Alipay, and UnionPay Quick Pass. Built with Spring Boot 3.3.7 and Ant Design Vue, it enables aggregated payment and multi-merchant access with easy Docker/Shell deployment. Ideal for building self-hosted payment platforms.

metadata.name: jetlinks-community
metadata.description: JetLinks  基于Java,Spring Boot ,WebFlux,Netty,Vert.x,Reactor等开发, 是一个全响应式的企业级物联网平台。支持统一物模型管理,多种设备,多种厂家,统一管理。统一设备连接管理,多协议适配(TCP,MQTT,UDP,CoAP,HTTP等),屏蔽网络编程复杂性,灵活接入不同厂家不同协议等设备。实时数据处理,设备告警,消息通知,数据转发。地理位置,数据可视化等。能帮助你快速建立物联网相关业务系统。

summary.zh: JetLinks是一个基于Java和Spring Boot的全响应式企业级物联网平台，采用WebFlux、Netty、Vert.x、Reactor等构建。支持统一物模型管理，多协议设备接入（TCP、MQTT、UDP、CoAP、HTTP等），提供实时数据处理、告警、消息通知和数据转发等功能。平台开箱即用，可二次开发，帮助快速搭建物联网业务系统。
summary.en: JetLinks is a fully reactive enterprise IoT platform based on Java and Spring Boot, built with WebFlux, Netty, Vert.x, and Reactor. It supports unified device model management and multi-protocol device access (TCP, MQTT, UDP, CoAP, HTTP), offering real-time data processing, alerts, notifications, and data forwarding. Out-of-the-box and extensible, it accelerates IoT business system development.

metadata.name: turms
metadata.description: 🕊️ The world's most advanced open source instant messaging engine for 100K~10M concurrent users https://turms-im.github.io/docs

summary.zh: Turms 是一款面向 10万至1000万级并发用户的开源即时通讯引擎，以极致性能为首要目标。其架构采用现代分布式设计，基于扇出读模型构建收件箱，支持推、拉及推拉结合的业务数据变更感知，并提供完整可观测性，适合构建中大型即时通讯应用。
summary.en: Turms is an open-source instant messaging engine designed for 100K to 10M concurrent users. Prioritizing extreme performance, it leverages modern distributed architecture with fanout read for inboxes, supports push/pull models for data change awareness, and offers comprehensive observability, making it ideal for medium to large-scale IM applications.

metadata.name: FastBee
metadata.description: FastBee开源物联网平台，简单易用，可用于搭建物联网平台以及二次开发和学习。适用于智能家居、智慧办公、智慧社区、农业监测、水利监测、工业控制等。

summary.zh: FastBee是轻量易用的全栈开源物联网平台，内置MQTT服务端，无需额外部署，支持设备管理、物模型、规则脚本、视频监控等；提供Web、小程序、App及H5多端应用，兼容常见硬件，一键Docker部署，适用于智能家居、办公、工业控制等。
summary.en: FastBee is a lightweight, easy-to-use, full-stack open-source IoT platform. It has a built-in MQTT broker, eliminating the need for extra message middleware. It supports device management, thing models, rule scripts, video surveillance, and multi-client apps (Web, mini-program, Android/iOS, H5). Compatible with common hardware like ESP32, one-click Docker deployment, suitable for smart home, office, agriculture, and industrial control.

metadata.name: open-im-server
metadata.description: IM Chat OpenClaw

summary.zh: OpenIM是一个面向开发者的开源即时通讯服务器，采用Go语言和微服务架构，提供高性能、可扩展的聊天能力，支持文本、图片、音视频等多种消息类型，可快速集成到自有应用，支持私有化部署。
summary.en: OpenIM is an open-source instant messaging server designed for developers. Built with Go and microservices, it delivers high-performance, scalable chat capabilities with rich message types, enabling rapid integration into your own applications with self-hosting support.

metadata.name: indie-dev-with-ai
metadata.description: 独立开发者的最佳技术栈

summary.zh: 面向独立开发者的实用技术栈指南，强调快速交付与ROI。推荐以Astro、React、Tailwind、MDX为核心的八大技术栈，兼顾静态站点与全栈开发，并善用AI工具如v0.dev提升效率。适用于建站、博客、文档、SaaS及海外支付等场景，注重简单、快速、易集成。
summary.en: A pragmatic tech stack guide for indie developers, prioritizing speed and ROI. Recommends eight key technologies centered on Astro, React, Tailwind, and MDX, covering static sites and full-stack development while leveraging AI tools like v0.dev for efficiency. Suitable for building websites, blogs, docs, SaaS, and global payments, with an emphasis on simplicity, speed, and easy integration.

metadata.name: up
metadata.description: An advanced guide which might benefit you a lot 🎉 . 韩先凯的人生进阶指南 离谱的人生/人生进阶 离谱的英语学习指南/英语学习教程/英语学习/学英语

summary.zh: 一份从英语学习出发的人生进阶指南，涵盖认知、单词、听力、阅读、口语、写作的完整训练系统，并融入AI辅助学习方法，提供个人成长、创业复盘等长期主义资源，适合想系统提升英语和重新掌控人生的人。
summary.en: An advanced guide starting from English learning, covering a complete training system for cognition, vocabulary, listening, reading, speaking, and writing, integrated with AI-assisted learning methods, and offering long-term resources for personal growth and entrepreneurship review.

metadata.name: elog
metadata.description: Markdown 批量导出工具、开放式跨平台博客解决方案，随意组合写作平台(语雀/Notion/FlowUs/飞书/我来Wolai)和博客平台(Hexo/Vitepress/Halo/Confluence/WordPress等)

summary.zh: Elog是一个开放式跨平台博客解决方案，通过命令行工具将语雀、Notion、FlowUs、飞书、我来等写作平台的内容批量导出为Markdown，并灵活部署到Hexo、Vitepress、Halo、WordPress等博客平台。内置图床功能自动上传图片，解决防盗链问题，支持自定义插件，实现写作与发布的解耦，提升内容管理效率。
summary.en: Elog is an open cross-platform blog solution that uses a CLI tool to batch export Markdown content from writing platforms like Yuque, Notion, FlowUs, Feishu, and Wolai, and deploy to blog platforms such as Hexo, Vitepress, Halo, and WordPress. It includes an image hosting feature to prevent hotlink issues, and supports custom plugins, decoupling writing from publishing for efficient content management.

metadata.name: read
metadata.description: Go 学习之路：Go 开发者博客、Go 微信公众号、Go 学习资料（文档、书籍、视频）

summary.zh: Go 学习之路是面向 Go 语言开发者的高质量学习资源聚合库，收录开发者博客、微信公众号、官方文档、书籍及视频教程。内容覆盖入门到进阶，持续更新维护，是 Go 学习者系统化成长的核心导航与知识仓库。
summary.en: Go Learning Road is a curated collection of high-quality Go learning resources, including developer blogs, WeChat accounts, official docs, books, and videos. It covers beginner to advanced topics and is continuously updated, serving as a key navigation hub for Go learners.

metadata.name: congomall
metadata.description: 🔥🔥🔥 CongoMall（刚果商城）不一样的TOC商城系统，SpringCloud-Alibaba微服务架构设计，基于DDD领域驱动模型开发，代码设计优雅，涵盖商城核心业务。系统集成分布式锁、分布式事务、分库分表、消息队列、数据搜索、服务监控等功能，区别于八股文问答，真正企业级实战系统。

summary.zh: 刚果商城是基于Spring Cloud Alibaba微服务架构和领域驱动设计（DDD）的C端商城系统，涵盖用户、商品、订单、支付等核心业务，集成了分布式锁、分布式事务、分库分表、消息队列、数据搜索及服务监控等企业级能力，代码设计优雅，适合作为实战项目学习。
summary.en: CongoMall is a C-end mall system built with Spring Cloud Alibaba microservices and Domain-Driven Design (DDD), covering core businesses like users, products, orders, and payments. It integrates distributed locks, distributed transactions, sharding, message queues, search, and monitoring, providing an elegant, enterprise-grade codebase ideal for real-world practice.

metadata.name: MyPerf4J
metadata.description: High performance Java APM. Powered by ASM. Try it. Test it. If you feel its better, use it.

summary.zh: MyPerf4J是一款基于ASM字节码增强的高性能Java APM工具，通过JavaAgent实现无侵入接入。具备每秒1600万次响应时间记录能力（63纳秒/次），采用内存复用降低GC影响，支持秒级全量统计。提供方法级与JVM级监控指标，助力快速定位性能瓶颈和故障原因，适合高并发低延迟应用。
summary.en: MyPerf4J is a high-performance Java APM tool powered by ASM bytecode instrumentation. It uses JavaAgent for non-invasive integration, achieving 16 million response-time records per second with 63ns per record. Memory reuse minimizes GC impact, supporting second-level full statistics. It provides method and JVM metrics to quickly identify bottlenecks and failures, ideal for high-concurrency low-latency applications.

metadata.name: system-design-primer
metadata.description: Learn how to design large-scale systems. Prep for the system design interview.  Includes Anki flashcards.

summary.zh: 系统设计入门指南，提供大规模系统设计的系统化学习资源，涵盖核心概念、架构模式、常见面试题及解决方案，并配套Anki记忆卡片，帮助工程师高效准备系统设计面试并提升架构设计能力。
summary.en: A comprehensive primer for learning large-scale system design, featuring key concepts, architecture patterns, interview questions with solutions, and Anki flashcards to help engineers prepare for system design interviews and improve architectural skills.

metadata.name: A-Programmers-Guide-to-English
metadata.description: 专为程序员编写的英语学习指南 v1.2。在线版本请点 ->

summary.zh: 专为程序员编写的英语学习指南，从语言学习本质出发，用编程思维剖析英语学习过程，提供训练方法、常见问题及资源推荐。作者分享从四级442分到PTE 63分的逆袭经验，强调语言学习无捷径，需长期投入，适合英语基础薄弱的程序员系统提升。
summary.en: A comprehensive English learning guide for programmers, analyzing the essence of language acquisition with programming thinking. It covers training methods, Q&A, and resources. The author shares his journey from CET-4 442 to PTE 63, emphasizing that language learning requires long-term effort, perfect for programmers with weak English foundations.

metadata.name: langtorch
metadata.description: 🔥 Building composable LLM applications & workflow with Java.

summary.zh: Langtorch是一个基于Java的组合式LLM应用与工作流构建库，受LangChain和Semantic Kernel启发，提供模块化组件、提示工程与链式调用等功能，支持OpenAI等模型集成，旨在简化Java生态中的LLM应用开发。当前处于活跃开发阶段，不适合生产环境。
summary.en: Langtorch is a Java library for building composable LLM applications and workflows, inspired by LangChain and Semantic Kernel. It provides modular components, prompt engineering, and chaining, with OpenAI integration, aiming to simplify LLM app development in Java. Currently under active development, not production-ready.

metadata.name: spring-parent
metadata.description: 数据库动态切换多数据源SDK、Redis多数据源SDK、全链路日志追踪SDK、RabbitMQ多虚拟主机多集群支持SDK、日志组件SDK、埋点扩展点、实体类字段脱敏SDK、I18n多语言SDK、图形验证码SDK、开发基础框架支持、异常统一处理、返回值、跨域、API路由、监控、路由重定向组件等；

summary.zh: 基于Spring Boot的系列基础框架SDK，提供数据库/Redis多数据源切换、全链路日志追踪、RabbitMQ多集群支持、字段脱敏、国际化、图形验证码等组件，简化企业级应用开发。
summary.en: A suite of foundational SDKs based on Spring Boot, offering dynamic multi-datasource switching, full-link log tracing, RabbitMQ multi-cluster support, field desensitization, i18n, and captcha components to streamline enterprise development.

metadata.name: nest
metadata.description: 鸟窝

summary.zh: Nest是一个基于Java的领域驱动设计（DDD）框架，提供聚合根、实体、值对象、仓储等核心组件，帮助开发者将业务模型快速落地为代码。支持事件驱动、CQRS、缓存与锁管理，适用于复杂业务与微服务场景，提升代码可维护性与可扩展性。
summary.en: Nest is a Java-based Domain-Driven Design (DDD) framework that provides core components such as aggregate roots, entities, value objects, and repositories, enabling developers to rapidly translate business models into code. It supports event-driven architecture, CQRS, caching, and lock management, making it suitable for complex business domains and microservices, enhancing maintainability and scalability.

metadata.name: spring-reading
metadata.description: 涵盖了 Spring 框架的核心概念和关键功能，包括控制反转（IOC）容器的使用，面向切面编程（AOP）的原理与实践，事务管理的方式与实现，Spring MVC 的流程与控制器工作机制，以及 Spring 中数据访问、安全、Boot 自动配置等方面的深入研究。此外，它还包含了 Spring 事件机制的应用、高级主题如缓存抽象和响应式编程，以及对 Spring 源码的编程风格与设计模式的深入探讨。

summary.zh: 深入剖析Spring框架核心源码，涵盖IoC容器、AOP、事务管理、MVC、数据访问、安全、Boot自动配置、事件机制与响应式编程，并探讨其设计模式。通过源码分析帮助开发者理解Spring内部原理，从Bean加载到请求处理，适合各层次Java开发人员。
summary.en: This repository offers a thorough source-code analysis of the Spring framework. It covers Inversion of Control (IoC), Aspect-Oriented Programming (AOP), transaction management, Spring MVC, data access, security, Boot auto-configuration, event mechanisms, caching, and reactive programming. Additionally, it explores programming styles and design patterns within Spring. With clear explanations and practical examples, this series is an excellent resource for Java developers to gain a deep understanding of Spring's internal workings, from bean lifecycle to request processing. It is well-organized and continuously updated, making it suitable for both beginners and experienced engineers.

metadata.name: Remembering-Haoel
metadata.description: 记录您对左耳朵耗子（陈皓）的点滴回忆

summary.zh: 这个仓库通过PR收集社区对已故技术领袖陈皓（左耳朵耗子）的回忆文章，以众包方式汇编成纪念手册，传递对其人格与技术贡献的敬意。
summary.en: This repository collects community memories of the late tech leader Hao Chen (Left-Ear Hao) via PRs, crowdsourcing a memorial booklet to honor his character and technical legacy.

metadata.name: fizz-gateway-node
metadata.description: API聚合网关 An Aggregation API Gateway 大模型网关、API集成、API脱敏、API安全、API溯源、

summary.zh: FizzGate是一款基于Java的高性能API聚合网关，提供API管理、服务编排、数据脱敏、安全防护与溯源等企业级功能。支持热部署、多注册中心、自定义插件及可视化配置，适用于微服务治理、大模型网关和信创环境，有效降低编码成本并提升API稳定性与安全性。
summary.en: FizzGate is a high-performance aggregation API gateway built in Java, offering API management, service orchestration, data masking, security protection, and traceability. It supports hot deployment, multiple registries, custom plugins, and visual configuration, making it ideal for microservices governance, LLM gateways, and domestic innovation environments to reduce coding costs and enhance API stability and security.

metadata.name: JEnv-for-Windows
metadata.description: Change your current Java version with one line

summary.zh: JEnv-for-Windows是一款实用的JDK版本切换工具，专为Windows 10+设计。它允许用户通过简单的命令行操作，快速切换当前会话或全局的Java版本，并支持目录级版本锁定。该工具基于CMD和PowerShell编写，无需修改系统环境变量即可实现JDK灵活管理，特别适合多版本Java项目开发与测试场景。
summary.en: JEnv for Windows is a practical JDK version switcher for Windows 10+. It enables quick switching of current session or global Java versions via simple commands, and supports folder-level version locking. Written in CMD and PowerShell, it manages JDKs without manually changing system environment variables, ideal for development and testing across multiple Java versions.

metadata.name: yes
metadata.description: 追求有深度的后端技术文章，知其然知其所以然

summary.zh: 该仓库是作者原创后端技术文章的精选合集，涵盖Java、消息队列、缓存、Netty、分布式、网络、操作系统等核心领域。文章强调知其然知其所以然，深入剖析原理，并附面试总结，适合后端开发者系统学习与进阶。
summary.en: This repository is a curated collection of original backend technical articles, covering core areas like Java, message queues, caching, Netty, distributed systems, networking, and OS. It emphasizes deep understanding of principles and includes interview insights, ideal for backend developers seeking systematic learning and growth.

metadata.name: source-code-hunter
metadata.description: 😱 从源码层面，剖析挖掘互联网行业主流技术的底层实现原理，为广大开发者 “提升技术深度” 提供便利。目前开放 Spring 全家桶，Mybatis、Netty、Dubbo 框架，及 Redis、Tomcat 中间件等

summary.zh: 从源码层面剖析互联网主流框架与中间件，涵盖Spring全家桶、Mybatis、Netty、Dubbo、Redis、Tomcat等，帮助开发者深入理解底层实现，提升技术深度。
summary.en: This project analyzes the source code of popular internet frameworks and middleware, covering Spring ecosystem, Mybatis, Netty, Dubbo, Redis, Tomcat, helping developers understand underlying implementations and deepen technical expertise.

metadata.name: cursor_machine_id
metadata.description: 一键修改cursor 设备ID，解除设备锁定状态，为什么会有这个工具。。。因为我的设备被锁了。。。。

summary.zh: 一键修改 Cursor 设备 ID 的跨平台工具，支持 Win/Mac/Linux，改配置解除锁定，自动备份并生成随机 ID，提供 Python/Shell 脚本。
summary.en: Change Cursor device ID cross-platform. Modify config machine IDs, auto backup, random ID, unlock.

metadata.name: advanced-java
metadata.description: 😮 Core Interview Questions & Answers For Experienced Java(Backend) Developers | 互联网 Java 工程师进阶知识完全扫盲：涵盖高并发、分布式、高可用、微服务、海量数据处理等领域知识

summary.zh: 互联网 Java 工程师进阶知识完全扫盲，系统整理高并发、分布式、高可用、微服务、海量数据处理等核心面试题与解析，内容源自资深专家，适合备战大厂面试与提升架构设计能力。
summary.en: A comprehensive knowledge base for experienced Java backend developers, covering high concurrency, distributed systems, high availability, microservices, and massive data processing, with organized interview questions and answers for interview prep and architecture improvement.

metadata.name: BRFS
metadata.description: 海量小文件分布式存储系统

summary.zh: BRFS是面向海量小文件（快照、图片、语音等）设计的高可用分布式文件系统。采用写时合并机制解决IO瓶颈，支持多副本自动平衡恢复、硬件资源负载管理、应用分区隔离、集群状态可视化监控及横向扩容。部署仅依赖Zookeeper，核心服务仅两个Jar文件，已在博睿产品线运行，后续将支持大文件及基于磁盘的KV存储。
summary.en: BRFS is a high-availability distributed file system designed for massive small files like snapshots, images, and audio. It uses a write-merge mechanism to improve IO performance, and features automatic replica balancing, resource load management, application isolation, cluster visualization, and horizontal scaling. Deployment requires only Zookeeper and two JAR files. It has been running in production. Future versions will support large files and a disk-based KV store.

metadata.name: thinglinks
metadata.description: Enterprise-grade IoT platform powered by ThingLinks Engine.  Supports MQTT / HTTP / CoAP / TCP / Modbus, rule engine,  Visual display screen & multi-tenancy. Millions of connections per node.

summary.zh: 国内开源的企业级物联网平台，基于Spring Cloud微服务架构，支持MQTT/HTTP/CoAP/TCP/Modbus等多协议接入，具备多租户管理、规则引擎和可视化，单节点支持百万级连接，适合大规模物联网场景。
summary.en: ThingLinks is an enterprise-grade IoT platform built on Spring Cloud microservices. It delivers high-performance connectivity via MQTT, HTTP, CoAP, TCP, and Modbus protocols. Key features include multi-tenancy, a visual rule engine, and large-screen data visualization. Designed to handle millions of concurrent connections per node, it offers scalability and a plugin-based architecture for protocol extensions. It also provides device management, alarm center, SCADA dashboards, and TDengine integration for time-series data.

metadata.description: 停车场系统源码，新能源充电桩系统，停车场小程序，智能停车，Parking system，【功能介绍】：①兼容市面上主流的多家相机，理论上兼容所有硬件，可灵活扩展，②相机识别后数据自动上传到云端并记录，校验相机唯一id和硬件序列号，防止非法数据录入，③用户手机查询停车记录详情可自主缴费(支持微信，支付宝，银行接口支付，支持每个停车场指定不同的商户进行收款)，支付后出场在免费时间内会自动抬杆。④支持app上查询附近停车场(导航，可用车位数，停车场费用，优惠券，评分，评论等)，可预约车位。⑤断电断网支持岗亭人员使用app可接管硬件进行停车记录的录入。 【技术架构】：后端开发语言java，框架oauth2+springboot2+dubble，数据库mysql/mongodb/redis，即时通讯底层框架netty4，安卓和ios均为原生开发，后台管理模板vue专业定制

summary.zh: 开源智能停车场管理系统，兼容主流相机硬件，支持新能源充电桩、自助缴费（微信/支付宝/银联）、车位预约、附近停车场查询等功能。后端采用Java微服务架构（Spring Boot+Dubbo+OAuth2），支持高并发与大数据存储，适合快速二次开发，广泛应用于智慧停车与物业管理场景。
summary.en: Open-source smart parking management system compatible with mainstream camera hardware, supporting EV charging piles, self-service payment (WeChat/Alipay/UnionPay), parking reservation, and nearby parking search. Built on Java microservices (Spring Boot+Dubbo+OAuth2) with high concurrency and big data storage, ideal for rapid customization in smart parking and property management.

metadata.name: IoT-Technical-Guide
metadata.description: :honeybee: IoT Technical Guide --- 从零搭建高性能物联网平台及物联网解决方案和Thingsboard源码分析 :sparkles: :sparkles: :sparkles: (IoT Platform, SaaS, MQTT, CoAP, HTTP, Modbus, OPC, WebSocket, 物模型，Protobuf, PostgreSQL, MongoDB, Spring Security, OAuth2, RuleEngine, Kafka, Docker)

summary.zh: 该指南系统性讲解物联网核心技术，涵盖MQTT/CoAP等协议、消息队列、数据存储与安全认证，并深入剖析Thingsboard源码，助力开发者从零搭建高性能物联网平台，适用于物联网架构设计、平台开发与二次集成场景。
summary.en: This guide systematically covers IoT core technologies including MQTT/CoAP protocols, message queues, data storage, and security authentication, with in-depth analysis of Thingsboard source code. It helps developers build high-performance IoT platforms from scratch, suitable for IoT architecture design, platform development, and secondary integration.

metadata.name: Freedom
metadata.description: 自己DIY一个具有ACID的数据库

summary.zh: Freedom 是一个自研的具有 ACID 特性的数据库，实现了从 MySQL 协议、SQL 解析到 B+ 树存储、WAL 日志的完整链路。项目用于验证数据库底层原理，支持索引组织表与多索引，并通过 Druid SQL 解析进行查询优化，适合深度学习者参考。
summary.en: Freedom is a self-built database with ACID properties, covering the full stack from MySQL protocol and SQL parsing to B+ tree storage and WAL logging. It demonstrates core database internals, featuring index-organized tables and multi-index support, and serves as a valuable learning resource for enthusiasts.

metadata.name: syhthems-platform
metadata.description: syhthems platform 是一个开源的IoT(物联网)平台。可以实现物联网产品的创建和管理、数据流的管理、终端设备的管理以及设备数据的图表形态查看。

summary.zh: syhthems是一个开源物联网平台，基于Spring Boot和Vue构建，实现产品、数据流、设备管理及设备数据图表可视化，支持多用户权限控制和OAuth2单点登录，适用于物联网设备接入与数据展示场景。
summary.en: syhthems is an open-source IoT platform built with Spring Boot and Vue, offering product, data stream, and device management, along with visualized device data charts. It supports multi-user permissions and OAuth2 SSO for device connectivity and data display.

metadata.name: Groza
metadata.description: 开源物联网平台 - 物联网解决方案的设备管理，数据收集，处理

summary.zh: Groza是一个开源物联网平台，专注于设备管理、数据收集与处理，提供完整的物联网解决方案。它支持设备接入、数据存储与分析，帮助开发者快速构建和部署物联网应用，适用于智能家居、工业监控等场景。
summary.en: Groza is an open-source IoT platform focusing on device management, data collection, and processing. It provides a complete IoT solution, supporting device connectivity, data storage, and analysis, helping developers quickly build and deploy IoT applications for smart homes and industrial monitoring.

metadata.name: NettyChat
metadata.description: 基于Netty+TCP+Protobuf实现的Android IM库，包含Protobuf序列化、TCP拆包与粘包、长连接握手认证、心跳机制、断线重连机制、消息重发机制、读写超时机制、离线消息、线程池等功能。

summary.zh: NettyChat是一个基于Netty、TCP与Protobuf实现的Android IM库，提供完整的即时通讯解决方案。它高效解决TCP拆包粘包问题，实现了长连接握手认证、心跳机制、断线重连、消息重发、读写超时、离线消息等核心功能，并内置线程池优化性能。适用于需要稳定长连接的Android IM应用，可直接集成或二次开发。
summary.en: NettyChat is an Android IM library built on Netty, TCP, and Protobuf, offering a complete instant messaging solution. It efficiently handles TCP packet fragmentation and sticking, and implements long-connection handshake authentication, heartbeat mechanism, reconnection, message resend, read/write timeout, offline messages, and a built-in thread pool. Ideal for Android IM apps requiring stable long connections, it can be directly integrated or customized.

metadata.name: hasting
metadata.description: 使用java nio，oio，aio等原生态io和线程池，实现的分布式跨语言服务化框架

summary.zh: hasting是一个基于Java原生IO（NIO/OIO/AIO）与线程池的轻量级分布式RPC服务化框架。提供服务注册发现、负载均衡、高可用容错、泛化调用、限流降级、RPC上下文等功能，支持ZooKeeper、etcd、Redis等多种注册中心，并集成可视化控制台与Spring，适用于中小型微服务场景。
summary.en: Hasting is a lightweight distributed RPC framework built on Java native I/O (NIO/OIO/AIO) and thread pools.
