It provides service registration/discovery, load balancing, high availability, generic invocation, rate limiting, RPC context, multiple registries (ZooKeeper, etcd, Redis), and a web console. Suitable for microservices architectures.

metadata.name: minio
metadata.description: MinIO is a high-performance, S3 compatible object store, open sourced under GNU AGPLv3 license.

summary.zh: MinIO 是一款高性能、S3 兼容的开源对象存储系统，采用 Go 语言开发，专为 AI/ML 与大数据分析场景提供低延迟存储。该仓库现已停止维护，社区版仅保留源码分发，官方推荐迁移至 AIStor 以获得持续更新与企业级支持。
summary.en: MinIO is a high-performance, S3-compatible open-source object storage server written in Go, purpose-built for AI/ML pipelines, big data analytics, and data-intensive applications. It offers industry-leading throughput, distributed deployment, erasure coding, and seamless integration with the existing S3 ecosystem. However, this repository is no longer maintained; the community edition is now distributed as source code only. Users seeking pre-built binaries, continued updates, and enterprise-grade support are recommended to migrate to AIStor, which offers free and commercial editions. It remains a foundational technology for private cloud storage, data lakes, and backup/archiving.

metadata.name: LightWebServer
metadata.description: Java web server using NIO, compatible with http1.1 and support simple MVC function.

summary.zh: LightWebServer是一个基于Java NIO的轻量级嵌入式Web服务器，兼容HTTP/1.1，内置简易MVC框架。通过@Controller、@WebPath等注解实现请求映射和参数注入，支持GET/POST、表单与文件上传，适合快速构建嵌入式或轻量级Web应用。
summary.en: LightWebServer is a lightweight embedded web server built on Java NIO, compatible with HTTP/1.1, and includes a simple MVC framework. It uses annotations like @Controller and @WebPath for request mapping and parameter injection, supporting GET/POST, form data and file upload, suitable for building embedded or lightweight web applications quickly.

metadata.name: awesome-architecture
metadata.description: 架构师技术图谱，助你早日成为架构师

summary.zh: 精选自《码农周刊》的架构师学习资源，覆盖分布式、前端、大数据、存储、微服务、推荐系统、消息队列、设计模式等12大主题，汇聚大量实战文章与经典案例，旨在帮助开发者构建系统性知识体系，快速进阶架构师。
summary.en: A curated collection of architecture learning resources from the Manong Weekly team, covering 12 major topics including distributed systems, frontend, big data, storage, microservices, recommendation systems, message queues, and design patterns. It aggregates practical articles and classic cases, providing a systematic knowledge path for developers to advance towards software architect. Widely recognized in the Chinese developer community, this repository serves as an essential roadmap for aspiring architects, with content spanning from fundamentals to advanced practices in system design, scalability, and reliability.

metadata.name: redisson
metadata.description: Redisson: Valkey & Redis Java Client and Real-Time Data Platform. Sync/Async/RxJava/Reactive API. Over 50 Valkey and Redis based Java objects and services: Set, Multimap, SortedSet, Map, List, Queue, Deque, Semaphore, Lock, AtomicLong, Map Reduce, Bloom filter, Spring, Tomcat, Scheduler, JCache API, Hibernate, RPC, local cache..

summary.zh: Redisson是Valkey与Redis的Java客户端及实时数据平台，提供超过50种分布式数据结构和Java服务，如分布式集合、锁、队列、原子对象、布隆过滤器等。支持同步、异步、RxJava及Reactive API，并集成Spring Cache、JCache、Hibernate等框架，极大扩展Redis能力，适用于高并发分布式系统。
summary.en: Redisson is a Java client and real-time data platform for Valkey and Redis, offering over 50 distributed data structures and Java services such as distributed collections, locks, queues, atomic objects, and Bloom filters. It supports sync, async, RxJava, and Reactive APIs, and integrates with Spring Cache, JCache, Hibernate, etc., greatly extending Redis capabilities for high-concurrency distributed systems.

metadata.name: cache
metadata.description: The basic cache tool for java.(java 手写实现渐进式 redis 缓存工具，高性能+可拓展性强)

summary.zh: 基于Java手写实现的高性能可扩展本地缓存工具，渐进式模仿Redis功能。支持流式API、固定容量、多种驱逐策略（FIFO/LRU等）、过期机制、持久化（RDB/AOF）及监听器，适用于需要轻量级本地缓存的场景。
summary.en: A high-performance extensible local cache tool handcrafted in Java, progressively mimicking Redis features. It supports fluent API, fixed size, multiple eviction strategies (FIFO/LRU), expiration, persistence (RDB/AOF), and listeners, ideal for lightweight local caching scenarios.

summary.zh: my-cache是一款纯Java实现的轻量级分布式缓存，支持独立部署、主从模式、键过期、分布式锁和持久化。其客户端封装简洁，既可独立服务供分布式系统全局使用，也可作为本地jar依赖直接集成，适合中小型项目低成本提升数据访问性能。
summary.en: my-cache is a lightweight distributed cache implemented in pure Java. It supports standalone deployment, master-slave replication, key expiration, distributed locks, and persistence. With its well-designed client encapsulation, it can either run as an independent service for global use in distributed systems or be embedded as a local JAR dependency, making it ideal for small-to-medium projects to boost data access performance at low cost.

metadata.name: framework-nio
metadata.description: 基于JAVA NIO 的轻量级消息传输框架。主要功能包括：文本消息传输、二进制文件传输、文本及二进制混合传输、消息的自定义实现加密传输算法、同步或异步传输、客户端、服务端框架内置心跳监听、服务端认证、支持网络断线客户端自动重连。

summary.zh: 基于Java NIO的轻量级消息传输框架，支持文本、二进制及混合消息传输，提供自定义加密算法、同步/异步模式、内置心跳监听、服务端认证和断线自动重连，配置灵活，适用于网络通信场景。
summary.en: A lightweight message transfer framework based on Java NIO, supporting text, binary, and mixed message transmission. It offers custom encryption algorithms, synchronous/asynchronous modes, built-in heartbeat monitoring, server authentication, and automatic reconnection after disconnection. Flexibly configurable for network communication scenarios.

metadata.name: Mycat-NIO
metadata.description: 非常高性能又简单的Mycat NIO框架，被很多人用于RPC开发以及基础平台中

summary.zh: Mycat-NIO是一个高性能且简洁的Java NIO框架，源自Mycat项目，被广泛用于RPC开发与基础平台建设。其核心亮点是SharedBufferPool通过volatile变量优化ByteBuffer分配计数，在保证线程可见性的同时避免了AtomicInteger的CAS开销，从而提升整体性能。适用于高并发网络通信场景。
summary.en: Mycat-NIO is a high-performance and simple Java NIO framework derived from the Mycat project, widely used for RPC development and foundational platforms. Its key highlight is SharedBufferPool, which uses a volatile variable for ByteBuffer allocation counting to avoid CAS overhead while ensuring visibility, boosting overall performance in high-concurrency networking.

metadata.name: Voovan
metadata.description: Voovan是高性能异步通信、HTTP服务器和客户端通信、动态编译支持、数据库操作帮助类等工具的框架, 如果项目觉得不错, 请点一下 star, 谢谢

summary.zh: Voovan是高性能异步通信与WEB服务器框架，提供HTTP客户端、动态编译、数据库操作、热部署和集群支持，以极简优雅编码为宗旨，适合构建高并发后端服务。
summary.en: Voovan is a high-performance asynchronous networking and web server framework, featuring HTTP client, dynamic compilation, database access, hot deployment, and cluster support, aiming for elegant coding and high concurrency.

metadata.name: cachecloud
metadata.description: 搜狐视频(sohu tv)Redis私有云平台 ：支持Redis多种架构(Standalone、Sentinel、Cluster)高效管理、有效降低大规模redis运维成本，提升资源管控能力和利用率。平台提供快速搭建/迁移，运维管理，弹性伸缩，统计监控，客户端整合接入等功能。(CacheCloud is a Redis cloud management platform. It supports Standalone, Sentinel, and Cluster architectures for Redis, effectively reducing large-scale Redis operation and maintenance costs, and improving resource management and utilization. The platform provides rapid construction/migration, operation and maintenance management, elastic scaling, statistical monitoring, client integration and access and other functions)

summary.zh: 搜狐视频开源的Redis云管理平台，支持Standalone、Sentinel、Cluster多种架构，提供快速搭建、迁移、运维管理、弹性伸缩、统计监控及客户端接入等功能，有效降低大规模Redis运维成本，提升资源管控能力和利用率，适用于企业级Redis基础设施统一管理。
summary.en: CacheCloud is an open-source Redis cloud management platform originated from Sohu TV. It supports Standalone, Sentinel, and Cluster architectures, enabling efficient management of diverse Redis deployments. The platform offers rapid setup, migration, comprehensive O&M, elastic scaling, statistical monitoring, and client SDK integration. It significantly reduces operational costs and improves resource utilization for large-scale Redis environments. This makes it an ideal solution for enterprises seeking unified management and automated operation of their Redis infrastructure, ensuring overall high availability and performance.

metadata.name: bus
metadata.description: Bus 是一个基础框架、服务套件，它基于Java8编写，参考、借鉴了大量已有框架、组件的设计，可以作为后端服务的开发基础中间件。代码简洁，架构清晰，非常适合学习使用。

summary.zh: Bus 是一个基于 Java 的后端基础框架与服务套件，参考借鉴了大量开源组件的设计，提供简洁代码与清晰架构，适用于构建后端服务，可作为开发中间件，并非常适合学习研究。项目现已停止维护，迁移至新仓库。
summary.en: Bus is a Java-based backend foundation framework and service suite, inspired by many open-source designs. It offers clean code and clear architecture, suitable for building backend services and serving as middleware. Ideal for learning. The project is deprecated and moved to a new repository.

metadata.name: EasySocket
metadata.description: 一个轻量级的Android端Socket框架，可快速实现客户端和服务端之间的TCP长连接通讯，兼容于各种消息协议，框架的特色之一是可以实现Socket的消息回调功能

summary.zh: EasySocket是一个轻量级Android端Socket框架，支持TCP长连接通讯，兼容多种消息协议，采用链式调用简化配置，并实现了请求与响应的一一对应回调功能。内置心跳保活、自动重连及断包粘包处理，适用于高效稳定Socket通信的移动应用开发。
summary.en: EasySocket is a lightweight Android Socket framework enabling fast TCP long-connection communication between clients and servers. It supports various message protocols, chain-style API configuration, and unique request-response callback mapping. Built-in heartbeat, auto-reconnect, and packet fragmentation handling make it ideal for robust mobile network interactions.

metadata.name: bizsocket
metadata.description: 异步socket，对一些业务场景做了支持

summary.zh: bizsocket 是一个面向业务场景的异步 Socket 客户端库，提供断线重连、请求响应、通知粘性、串行合并、分包、缓存与拦截器，并集成 RxJava/RxJava2，让 Socket 通信像 Retrofit 一样简洁可靠，适合 Android/Java 客户端使用。
summary.en: bizsocket is an asynchronous Socket client library designed for real-world business scenarios. It supports auto-reconnection, request/response, notification, sticky notification, serial request merging, packet fragmentation, caching, interceptors, and ships with RxJava and RxJava2 integrations, providing a Retrofit-like experience for Socket communication in Android/Java apps.

metadata.name: XAndroidSocket
metadata.description: Socket封装，支持TCP/UDP客户端和服务端，支持自定义粘包处理、验证处理、解析处理。

summary.zh: XAndroidSocket 是一个轻量级 Android Socket 封装库，支持 TCP/UDP 客户端与服务端，内置多种粘包处理策略（不处理、首尾字符、固定/动态长度），并允许自定义粘包、验证（如 MD5）和解析逻辑。通过简单接口即可接入复杂协议，方便快速构建高可靠的网络通信模块。
summary.en: XAndroidSocket is a lightweight Android Socket wrapper supporting TCP/UDP clients and servers. It provides built-in packet-sticking strategies (none, delimiter, fixed/variable length) and allows custom handling for packet assembly, validation (e.g., MD5), and decoding. With simple interfaces, it enables rapid integration of complex protocols for reliable network communication.

metadata.name: jmockdata
metadata.description: The plugin to mock the java data by random.

summary.zh: Jmockdata是一款基于随机算法的Java数据模拟工具，支持基本类型、集合、数组、日期及复杂对象等多种类型，可自动生成随机数据。它支持泛型、继承、循环依赖、自定义Mocker等特性，非常适合单元测试、接口调试与原型开发，大幅提升测试数据准备的效率。
summary.en: Jmockdata is a powerful Java data mocking tool that uses random algorithms to simulate test data. It supports a wide variety of types, from primitives to complex objects, including collections, arrays, enums, and dates, and can generate data based on regular expressions. With advanced features like generics, inheritance, circular dependency handling, custom Mockers, and configurable strategies, Jmockdata is ideal for unit testing, API integration testing, and rapid prototyping, greatly improving the efficiency of test data creation and enhancing development workflows.

metadata.name: interview_internal_reference
metadata.description: 2025年最新总结，阿里，腾讯，百度，美团，头条等技术面试题目，以及答案，专家出题人分析汇总。

summary.zh: 2025年最新大厂技术面试题库，汇总阿里、腾讯、百度、美团、头条等一线互联网公司的面试题目与答案，涵盖算法、MySQL、Redis、Nginx、并发、网络通信等核心方向，附专家出题人分析，助你高效备战技术面试。
summary.en: The latest 2025 technical interview question bank from top Chinese tech companies including Alibaba, Tencent, Baidu, Meituan, and Toutiao. Covering algorithms, MySQL, Redis, Nginx, concurrency, networking and more, with expert analysis and answers for effective interview preparation.

metadata.name: Java-concurrency
metadata.description: concurrency

summary.zh: Java并发专题知识库，系统梳理并发编程基础、JMM、synchronized/volatile、AQS、并发容器、线程池、原子类等核心知识点，结合源码深入解析原理，并提供秋招面试题解析，适合开发者系统学习与面试准备。
summary.en: A comprehensive Java concurrency knowledge base covering fundamentals, JMM, synchronized/volatile, AQS, concurrent containers, thread pools, and atomic classes. It provides in-depth source code analysis and interview questions, ideal for systematic learning and interview preparation.

metadata.name: six-finger
metadata.description: 📓从Java基础、JavaWeb基础到常用的框架再到面试题、微服务、分布式、大数据都有完整的教程，几乎涵盖了Java必备的知识点

summary.zh: 六指仓库是面向Java学习者的全面教程合集，从Java基础、JavaWeb到常用框架，涵盖面试题、微服务、分布式和大数据等核心知识点。内容系统丰富，通过文章和源码解读帮助读者构建完整知识体系，适合初学者及面试备战者。
summary.en: Six-Finger is a comprehensive Java tutorial repository covering core topics from Java basics and JavaWeb to popular frameworks, interview questions, microservices, distributed systems, and big data. It helps learners build a complete knowledge system with well-organized articles and source code analysis, ideal for beginners and interview preparation.

metadata.name: COLA
metadata.description: 🥤 COLA: Clean Object-oriented & Layered Architecture

summary.zh: COLA是阿里巴巴开源的整洁面向对象分层架构框架，提供应用架构最佳实践和可复用组件，帮助开发者治理业务复杂度，分离技术复杂度。包含archetype快速创建应用，以及状态机、扩展点、异常处理等通用组件。
summary.en: COLA is Alibaba's clean object-oriented layered architecture framework, providing best practices and reusable components to manage business complexity and separate technical complexity. It offers Maven archetypes for scaffolding and components such as state machine, extension points, and exception handling.

metadata.name: hxy-socket
metadata.description: netty-springboot无缝衔接，高性能socket

summary.zh: hxy-socket是一个基于Spring Boot与Netty的高性能Socket通信框架，实现无缝衔接。它支持WebSocket与TCP连接，内置JSON和Protocol Buffers编解码，并支持自定义协议扩展。通过注解即可快速集成，方便使用Spring生态插件，适用于即时通讯、实时数据推送等场景。
summary.en: hxy-socket is a high-performance socket communication framework based on Spring Boot and Netty, designed to achieve seamless integration between the two. It supports both WebSocket and TCP socket connections, provides built-in codecs for JSON and Protocol Buffers, and allows developers to extend custom protocols. The framework is annotation-driven, enabling quick and easy integration with Spring Boot applications. Additionally, it fully leverages the Spring ecosystem, making it convenient to use various Spring plugins and components. This makes hxy-socket ideal for scenarios such as instant messaging, real-time data push, IoT communication, and other high-concurrency networking applications.

metadata.name: How-to-be-a-good-programmer
metadata.description: I'm here to tell you some amazing stuff which teacher would never tell you.

summary.zh: 该仓库收集并分享了大量计算机经典教材的电子书下载链接，涵盖数学基础和计算机基础等核心领域。资源多为高清扫描版，经过OCR识别并添加书签，方便学习。通过天翼云盘永久链接下载，为程序员自学提供了便捷的参考资料。
summary.en: This repository curates and shares download links for classic computer science textbooks, covering core areas such as math foundations and computer basics. Most resources are high-definition scanned versions with OCR and bookmarks for easy study. Available via permanent Tianyi Cloud links, it offers convenient reference materials for programmers' self-learning.

metadata.name: firenio
metadata.description: 🐳🐳An easy of use io framework project based on java nio&epoll

summary.zh: FireNio是一款基于Java NIO与Linux epoll的高性能异步IO框架，致力于简化网络通讯服务的开发。它提供简洁的API，支持快速构建TCP、HTTP、WebSocket等服务。内置断线重连、心跳机制、SSL加密（支持JdkSSL与OpenSSL），并允许自定义协议扩展，如LengthValue、Protobase等。在TFB基准测试中表现出色，适用于高并发、低延迟的服务端应用。
summary.en: FireNio is an easy-to-use asynchronous I/O framework based on Java NIO and Linux epoll, designed to simplify the rapid development of network communication services. It offers a clean and concise API that enables developers to quickly build TCP, HTTP, and WebSocket servers with minimal effort. The framework comes with built-in automatic reconnection, heartbeat mechanisms, and SSL encryption (supporting both JdkSSL and OpenSSL). Additionally, it supports custom protocol extensions, including LengthValue and Protobase, for flexible data transmission. FireNio has demonstrated outstanding performance in TechEmpower Framework Benchmarks (TFB), making it an ideal choice for high-concurrency, low-latency server-side applications.

metadata.name: spring-docs
metadata.description: Spring chinese document. Spring 5.1.3 中文文档

summary.zh: 该项目是Spring Framework 5.1.3官方文档的中文翻译，覆盖依赖注入、事务管理、Web应用、数据访问等核心模块。提供GitHub和Gitbook等多种阅读方式，旨在降低中文开发者的学习门槛，是高质量的官方技术参考资料。
summary.en: This project is a Chinese translation of the official Spring Framework 5.1.3 documentation, covering core modules such as dependency injection, transaction management, web applications, and data access. It offers multiple reading formats including GitHub and Gitbook, lowering the learning barrier for Chinese developers.

metadata.name: wgcloud
metadata.description: Linux运维监控工具，支持系统硬件信息，内存，CPU，温度，磁盘空间及IO，硬盘smart，GPU，防火墙，网络流量速率等监控，服务接口监测，大屏展示，拓扑图，端口监控，进程监控，docker监控，日志监控，文件防篡改，数据库监控，指令批量下发执行，web ssh，Linux面板(探针)，告警，SNMP监测，K8S，Redis，Nginx，Kafka，资产管理，计划任务，密码管理，工作笔记

summary.zh: WGCLOUD是一款基于SpringBoot+OSHI的轻量级分布式运维监控系统，支持CPU、内存、磁盘、GPU、Docker、数据库等全方位监控，具备大屏展示、拓扑图、Web SSH、告警推送等功能，部署简单，兼容Linux/Windows等主流平台。
summary.en: WGCLOUD is a lightweight distributed monitoring system based on SpringBoot and OSHI, covering CPU, memory, disk, GPU, Docker, database and more. It features dashboards, network topology, Web SSH, alerting, and supports Linux/Windows/Unix/macOS. Easy deployment.

metadata.name: CS-Book
metadata.description: 计算机类常用电子书整理，并且附带下载链接，包括Java，Python，Linux，Go，C，C++，数据结构与算法，人工智能，计算机基础，面试，设计模式，数据库，前端等书籍

summary.zh: 该仓库整理了计算机领域常用电子书，涵盖Java、Python、Linux、Go、C/C++、数据结构与算法、人工智能、数据库、前端等方向。出于版权考虑，现主要提供优质开源电子书，通过关注公众号获取下载链接。同时推广了一个专注面经学习的网站，为开发者提供面试经验和学习资源。
summary.en: This repository curates common computer science e-books covering Java, Python, Linux, Go, C/C++, data structures, algorithms, AI, databases, frontend, and more. Due to copyright concerns, it now focuses on open-source e-books accessible via a WeChat official account. It also promotes an interview-focused learning site for developers.

metadata.name: coding-interview-university
metadata.description: A complete computer science study plan to become a software engineer.

summary.zh: 面向软件工程师面试的计算机科学系统学习计划，覆盖算法、数据结构、操作系统、网络等核心知识，提供从基础到进阶的完整路线图。含大量精选资源与实战建议，助力开发者高效备考顶级科技公司面试，在GitHub广受认可。
summary.en: A complete computer science study plan for software engineer interviews, covering algorithms, data structures, operating systems, networking, and more. It provides a structured, multi-month curriculum with curated resources and practical tips. Created by John Washam, who landed a job at Amazon after completing it, this GitHub repository is widely used by developers to prepare for technical interviews at top companies like Google, Facebook, and Microsoft.

metadata.name: mini-spring
metadata.description: mini-spring is a simplified version of the Spring framework that helps you quickly familiarize yourself with Spring source code and master Spring's core principles. It extracts Spring's core logic with extremely simplified code while preserving Spring's core functionality.

summary.zh: mini-spring是简化版Spring框架，用极简代码保留IoC、AOP等核心功能，帮助开发者快速熟悉Spring源码并掌握容器、Bean生命周期等基本原理，是学习Spring内部机制和设计思想的高效工具。
summary.en: mini-spring is a simplified Spring framework that preserves core features like IoC and AOP with minimal code. It helps developers quickly get familiar with Spring source code and master fundamental principles such as bean lifecycle and container extensions, making it an efficient tool for learning Spring internals.

metadata.name: algo
metadata.description: 数据结构和算法必知必会的50个代码实现

summary.zh: 该仓库整理了数据结构和算法必知必会的50个代码实现，涵盖数组、链表、栈、队列、排序、二分查找、散列表、二叉树、堆、图、回溯、分治、动态规划等核心主题。每个实现简洁清晰，适合算法学习、巩固基础及面试准备。
summary.en: This repository provides 50 essential code implementations for data structures and algorithms, covering arrays, linked lists, stacks, queues, sorting, binary search, hash tables, binary trees, heaps, graphs, backtracking, divide and conquer, and dynamic programming. It is ideal for algorithm learning and coding interview preparation.

metadata.name: CodeGuide
metadata.description: :books: 本代码库是作者小傅哥多年从事一线互联网 Java 开发的学习历程技术汇总，旨在为大家提供一个清晰详细的学习教程，侧重点更倾向编写Java核心内容。如果本仓库能为您提供帮助，请给予支持(关注、点赞、分享)！

summary.zh: 小傅哥多年一线互联网Java开发经验总结的编程指南，涵盖核心教程、设计模式、中间件、框架源码等实战内容，并配套博客、视频与星球答疑，适合Java工程师系统学习与进阶。
summary.en: A comprehensive Java coding guide by veteran engineer Xiao FuGe, covering core tutorials, design patterns, middleware, and framework source code, with blogs, videos, and community support for hands-on learning.

metadata.name: feign-form
metadata.description: Open Feign form encoder

summary.zh: feign-form是为OpenFeign扩展的表单编码器，支持application/x-www-form-urlencoded和multipart/form-data格式。它可无缝集成到Feign.Builder中，支持POJO参数分组、文件与字节数组上传，并允许装饰现有编码器（如JacksonEncoder）。适用于构建声明式HTTP客户端，简化表单提交与文件传输场景。注：项目已合并至主feign仓库。
summary.en: feign-form is a form encoder extension for OpenFeign, adding support for application/x-www-form-urlencoded and multipart/form-data. It integrates seamlessly with Feign.Builder, supports POJO parameter grouping, file and byte array uploads, and lets you decorate existing encoders like JacksonEncoder. Ideal for declarative HTTP clients, simplifying form submission and file transfer. Note: the repository is inactive and merged into the main feign project.

metadata.name: JavaFamily
metadata.description: 【Java面试+Java学习指南】 一份涵盖大部分Java程序员所需要掌握的核心知识。

summary.zh: JavaFamily是一份面向Java程序员的中文面试与学习指南，系统梳理核心知识点，涵盖Java基础、集合、JVM、并发、框架及分布式等。配套脑图与学习路线，帮助开发者高效备战技术面试，提升综合能力。
summary.en: JavaFamily is a comprehensive Chinese interview and learning guide for Java developers, covering core topics such as Java basics, collections, JVM, concurrency, frameworks, and distributed systems. With mind maps and learning paths, it helps developers efficiently prepare for technical interviews.

metadata.name: fucking-algorithm
metadata.description: Crack LeetCode, not only how, but also why.

summary.zh: 基于 LeetCode 的算法刷题笔记，深入浅出地讲解算法思维与解题框架，覆盖常见题型与技巧，并配套可视化面板、Chrome/IDE 插件及在线网站，帮助学习者举一反三、高效备战算法面试。
summary.en: A comprehensive LeetCode problem-solving guide that emphasizes algorithmic thinking over rote memorization. It covers common problem types and techniques with clear frameworks, visualized panels, and browser/IDE plugins to help learners master algorithms efficiently for coding interviews.

metadata.name: feign-client-test
metadata.description: A REST client using Feign for MultiPart file upload. It uses Spring HttpMessageConverters.

summary.zh: 项目展示了如何用Feign实现支持Multipart文件上传的REST客户端。通过自定义Encoder并复用Spring的HttpMessageConverter机制模拟RestTemplate，解决了Feign原生不支持multipart请求的问题。支持上传单个或多个文件，并可附带JSON对象参数，为扩展Feign客户端上传能力提供了参考实现。
summary.en: This project demonstrates how to build a Feign-based REST client that supports multipart file uploads. By implementing a custom Encoder and reusing Spring's HttpMessageConverter chain to mimic RestTemplate, it overcomes Feign's native lack of multipart support. It handles single/multiple file uploads with optional JSON objects, offering a reference for extending Feign clients.

metadata.name: OnJava8
metadata.description: 《On Java 8》中文版

summary.zh: 该仓库是经典Java著作《On Java 8》的中文翻译项目，基于原书内容进行完整汉化，并增补Java 11、17新特性，覆盖大量实际开发场景中的细碎知识点，适合初学者系统学习及开发者查漏补缺。配套视频教程由行业专家录制，图灵已出版，是Java学习者的权威中文参考书。
summary.en: This repository hosts the Chinese translation of the classic Java book 'On Java 8'. It provides a complete Chinese version of the original text, supplemented with Java 11 and 17 features, covering detailed knowledge points for real-world development. Suitable for beginners and developers alike, it includes expert video tutorials and is now officially published by Turing.

metadata.name: druid
metadata.description: 阿里云计算平台DataWorks(https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/137663.html) 团队出品，为监控而生的数据库连接池

summary.zh: 阿里巴巴开源的Java数据库连接池，深度整合JDBC连接管理、SQL解析、防火墙与监控统计。支持30种SQL方言解析、可插拔Filter链及Spring Boot自动配置，提供Web监控页面，广泛应用于高并发业务场景下的数据库访问优化与安全防护。
summary.en: Alibaba's open-source Java database connection pool, deeply integrating JDBC connection management, SQL parsing, firewall, and monitoring statistics. Supports 30 SQL dialect parsers, pluggable filter chain, and Spring Boot auto-configuration, with a web monitoring console for high-concurrency database access optimization and security.

metadata.name: concurrent
metadata.description: 这是RedSpider社区成员原创与维护的Java多线程系列文章。

summary.zh: RedSpider社区原创的Java多线程系列文章，深入浅出讲解并发编程原理，内容涵盖线程基础、锁、并发工具等。文章结合图解与Demo，提供清晰的解释，适合Java开发者系统学习多线程技术。
summary.en: A series of Java multithreading articles created by the RedSpider community, explaining concurrency principles in a clear and accessible way. Covering threads, locks, and concurrency utilities, with diagrams and demos for effective learning.

metadata.name: microservices-platform
metadata.description: 基于SpringBoot2.x、SpringCloud和SpringCloudAlibaba并采用前后端分离的企业级微服务多租户系统架构。并引入组件化的思想实现高内聚低耦合，项目代码简洁注释丰富上手容易，适合学习和企业中使用。真正实现了基于RBAC、jwt和oauth2的无状态统一权限认证的解决方案，面向互联网设计同时适合B端和C端用户，支持CI/CD多环境部署，并提供应用管理方便第三方系统接入；同时还集合各种微服务治理功能和监控功能。模块包括:企业级的认证系统、开发平台、应用监控、慢sql监控、统一日志、单点登录、Redis分布式高速缓存、配置中心、分布式任务调度、接口文档、代码生成等等。

summary.zh: 基于SpringCloudAlibaba的企业级微服务多租户系统架构，采用前后端分离与组件化思想，实现高内聚低耦合。深度定制Spring Security，基于RBAC、JWT和OAuth2提供无状态统一权限认证，支持多租户隔离、配置中心、分布式任务调度、日志监控、慢SQL监控等功能，适合学习和企业生产使用。
summary.en: An enterprise-grade microservices multi-tenant architecture based on Spring Cloud Alibaba, featuring front-end/back-end separation and componentization for high cohesion and low coupling. It deeply customizes Spring Security to deliver stateless unified authentication via RBAC, JWT, and OAuth2, supports multi-tenant isolation, config center, distributed scheduling, log and slow-SQL monitoring, and is suitable for both learning and production.

metadata.name: lamp-cloud
metadata.description: [灯灯]微服务中后台快速开发平台，支持jdk21、jdk17、jdk8，专注于多租户、开放平台解决方案，亦可作为普通项目（非SaaS架构）的基础开发框架使用，目前已实现插拔式数据库隔离、SCHEMA隔离、字段隔离 等租户隔离方案。

summary.zh: 灯灯(lamp-cloud)是一个基于SpringCloud的微服务中后台快速开发平台，支持JDK8/17/21，专注多租户与开放平台场景，已实现数据库、SCHEMA、字段等多种租户隔离方案，亦可作为普通项目基础框架，帮助开发者快速构建企业级中后台系统。
summary.en: lamp-cloud is a SpringCloud-based microservices rapid development platform for mid-backend systems, supporting JDK8/17/21. It focuses on multi-tenancy and open platform solutions, offering database, schema, and field isolation modes. It can also serve as a base framework for non-SaaS projects, accelerating enterprise-level backend development.

metadata.name: SpringCloud
metadata.description: Opensabre是基于SpringCloud2023的微服务开发平台，整合了Spring Security、Springcloud Alibaba等组件。  包含了基础的RBAC权限管理、授权认证、网关管理、服务治理、审计日志等系统管理基础应用。  定义了相关开发规范、风格并落地在服务框架层，开箱即用，支持Docker、Kubenetes的部署。  让项目开发人员快速进入业务开发，而不需过多时间花费在基础架构搭建和编码风格规范上。  目标是建立一套金融级、高安全性的微服务解决方案。

summary.zh: Opensabre是基于SpringCloud 2023的微服务开发平台，整合Spring Security与Spring Cloud Alibaba，提供RBAC权限管理、认证授权、网关管理、服务治理、审计日志等基础应用。开箱即用，支持Docker/Kubernetes部署，让开发人员专注业务，目标是金融级高安全微服务解决方案。
summary.en: Opensabre is a microservice development platform built on Spring Cloud 2023, integrating Spring Security and Spring Cloud Alibaba. It includes essential system management modules such as RBAC permission management, authentication, gateway, service governance, and audit logs. Out-of-the-box and supporting Docker/Kubernetes deployment, it enables fast business development, targeting financial-grade high-security microservice solutions.

metadata.name: Discovery
metadata.description: ☀️ Nepxion Discovery is a solution for Spring Cloud with blue green, gray, route, limitation, circuit breaker, degrade, isolation, tracing, dye, failover, active 蓝绿灰度发布、路由、限流、熔断、降级、隔离、追踪、流量染色、故障转移、多活

summary.zh: Nepxion Discovery 是一款基于 Spring Cloud 的云原生微服务解决方案，提供蓝绿灰度发布、路由、限流、熔断、降级、隔离、追踪、流量染色、故障转移与多活等能力，帮助企业构建高可用、可观测的微服务架构，支持服务治理与流量管理。
summary.en: Nepxion Discovery is a Spring Cloud-based cloud-native microservices solution offering blue-green and gray release, routing, rate limiting, circuit breaking, degradation, isolation, tracing, traffic dyeing, failover, and active-active capabilities, enabling robust service governance and traffic management.

metadata.name: ailearning
metadata.description: AiLearning：数据分析+机器学习实战+线性代数+PyTorch+NLTK+TF2

summary.zh: ApacheCN AiLearning是开源的中文AI学习资源库，涵盖机器学习、深度学习、数据分析、线性代数、PyTorch、NLTK和TensorFlow等核心内容。提供经典算法（如KNN、SVM）的详细笔记与实战代码，配有视频和社区支持，适合初学者从基础到进阶系统学习。
summary.en: ApacheCN AiLearning is an open-source Chinese AI learning repository covering machine learning, deep learning, data analysis, linear algebra, PyTorch, NLTK, and TensorFlow. It offers detailed notes and hands-on code for classic algorithms like KNN and SVM, along with videos and community support, suitable for beginners to learn systematically from basics to advanced levels.

metadata.name: CS-Notes
metadata.description: :books: 技术面试必备基础知识、Leetcode、计算机操作系统、计算机网络、系统设计

summary.zh: 技术面试必备基础知识笔记，覆盖算法、操作系统、计算机网络、数据库、Java、系统设计等核心领域，内含Leetcode与剑指Offer题解，适合程序员系统复习与面试备战。
summary.en: Essential notes for technical interviews, covering algorithms, operating systems, computer networks, databases, Java, and system design, with Leetcode and Jianzhi Offer solutions, ideal for systematic review and interview preparation.

metadata.name: atguigu_spirngcloud2020
metadata.description: 第2季当堂代码2020.3

summary.zh: 尚硅谷Spring Cloud第2季课堂代码（2020.3），涵盖微服务核心组件与实战示例，适合学习分布式架构、服务治理与配置管理，是入门Spring Cloud的完整教学资源。
summary.en: Classroom code for Spring Cloud Season 2 (2020.3) from Atguigu, covering core microservice components and practical examples, ideal for learning distributed architecture, service governance, and configuration management.

metadata.name: ML-NLP
metadata.description: 此项目是机器学习(Machine Learning)、深度学习(Deep Learning)、NLP面试中常考到的知识点和代码实现，也是作为一个算法工程师必会的理论基础知识。

summary.zh: 该项目为机器学习、深度学习与NLP面试常考知识点及代码实现合集，系统覆盖线性回归、SVM、决策树、CNN、RNN等核心算法，并附有实战案例与知识框架，帮助算法工程师高效复习、构建扎实理论基础。
summary.en: This repository is a comprehensive collection of frequently tested knowledge points and code implementations for machine learning, deep learning, and natural language processing (NLP) interviews. It systematically covers core algorithms such as linear regression, logistic regression, decision trees, SVM, Bayesian networks, neural networks, CNN, RNN, and more, accompanied by practical code examples and clear knowledge frameworks. The content is organized into modules, making it easy for algorithm engineers to review and master the essential theoretical foundations needed for technical interviews.

metadata.name: java-tutorial
metadata.description: :coffee: 老司机在 Java 技术领域的十年积累。

summary.zh: JavaTutorial 是作者十年 Java 技术积累的精华教程，涵盖 JavaSE 核心特性、JavaEE、构建工具 Maven/Gradle、IDE 使用及监控诊断等。适用于从入门到进阶的 Java 开发者，内容系统全面，既有深度又有广度，是理想的参考与学习资源。
summary.en: JavaTutorial is a comprehensive Java tutorial accumulated from ten years of experience, covering JavaSE core features, JavaEE, build tools like Maven/Gradle, IDE usage, and monitoring/diagnosis. It suits developers from beginners to advanced, offering systematic and in-depth content for effective learning.

metadata.name: build-your-own-x
metadata.description: Master programming by recreating your favorite technologies from scratch.

summary.zh: 汇集从零构建各类技术的海量教程，涵盖数据库、操作系统、编译器、网络服务器、游戏等30多个领域。通过亲手实现经典技术，深入理解底层原理，是开发者学习编程的优质资源库。
summary.en: Recreating technologies from scratch: curated tutorials for databases, OS, compilers, browsers.

metadata.name: SpringBoot-Labs
metadata.description: 一个涵盖六个专栏：Spring Boot 2.X、Spring Cloud、Spring Cloud Alibaba、Dubbo、分布式消息队列、分布式事务的仓库。希望胖友小手一抖，右上角来个 Star，感恩 1024

summary.zh: SpringBoot-Labs 是一个深度且全面的 Spring Boot 2.X 实战教程仓库，涵盖 Spring Boot、Spring Cloud Alibaba、Spring Cloud、Dubbo、分布式消息队列与分布式事务六大技术栈，提供超 5 万行示例代码，帮助开发者从入门到进阶掌握微服务与分布式系统开发。
summary.en: SpringBoot-Labs is a comprehensive Spring Boot 2.X tutorial repository covering Spring Boot, Spring Cloud Alibaba, Spring Cloud, Dubbo, distributed message queues, and distributed transactions, with over 50,000 lines of example code for developers to master microservices and distributed systems.

metadata.name: fullstack-tutorial
metadata.description: 🚀 fullstack tutorial 2022，后台技术栈/架构师之路/全栈开发社区，春招/秋招/校招/面试

summary.zh: 面向全栈开发者的系统化技术教程，涵盖算法、Java后端、前端、数据库、分布式及机器学习等核心知识。内容精炼，直击面试要点，适合春招/秋招/校招及架构师成长路径。配套技术社群与在线工具导航，助力高效学习与交流。
summary.en: A comprehensive full-stack tutorial covering algorithms, Java backend, frontend, databases, distributed systems, and machine learning. Tailored for interview preparation and architect career paths, with a thriving developer community and curated online tools.

metadata.name: linux-tutorial
metadata.description: :penguin: Linux教程，主要内容：Linux 命令、Linux 系统运维、软件运维、精选常用Shell脚本

summary.zh: 系统化Linux教程，涵盖常用命令、系统与软件运维、Shell脚本及Docker实践。面向运维工程师与开发者，提供清晰分类和配套脚本，助力高效学习与日常运维。
summary.en: A comprehensive Linux tutorial covering essential commands, system/software operations, Shell scripts, and Docker practices. Designed for DevOps engineers and developers, it offers well-organized content and supporting scripts for efficient learning and daily operations.

metadata.name: Python-100-Days
metadata.description: Python - 100天从新手到大师

summary.zh: Python-100天从新手到大师是骆昊撰写的系统性Python学习教程，涵盖基础语法、数据结构、函数、面向对象、Web开发、数据分析、机器学习等模块，以100天打卡方式帮助初学者循序渐进掌握Python，并指导职业发展路径，适合零基础入门和进阶提升。
summary.en: Python-100 Days from Novice to Master is a systematic Python tutorial by Jackfrued, covering basics, data structures, functions, OOP, web development, data analysis, and machine learning. With a 100-day plan, it helps beginners master Python step by step and offers career guidance. Ideal for self-learners.

metadata.name: SpringBlade
metadata.description: SpringBlade 是一个由商业级项目升级优化而来的微服务架构，采用Spring Boot 4 、Spring Cloud 2025、Java 21  等核心技术构建，完全遵循阿里巴巴编码规范。提供基于React和Vue的两个前端框架用于快速搭建企业级的SaaS多租户微服务平台。

summary.zh: SpringBlade是一个由商业级项目优化而来的微服务开发平台，其核心基于Spring Boot与Spring Cloud框架构建，并采用Java 21作为运行环境。平台集成了服务注册与发现、配置中心、熔断限流等微服务治理组件，同时提供了基于Vue和React的两套前端解决方案。在多租户方面，SpringBlade简化了底层实现，让SaaS应用的开发更加高效。该项目已经稳定运行九年，代码严格遵循阿里巴巴编码规范，适合企业快速搭建云原生微服务系统。
summary.en: SpringBlade is a microservices development platform evolved from a commercial-grade project. It is built with Spring Boot 4 and Spring Cloud 2025, running on Java 21, and integrates Nacos, Sentinel, and other components. It provides two frontend frameworks based on Vue and React, simplifies multi-tenant support, and has been production-proven for nine years. Following Alibaba coding standards, it adopts a modular architecture that enables rapid development of enterprise-grade SaaS microservices applications. The platform is designed for high concurrency and cloud-native deployment.

metadata.name: 100-Days-Of-ML-Code
metadata.description: 100-Days-Of-ML-Code中文版

summary.zh: 该仓库是“机器学习100天”计划的中文版，提供从数据预处理到监督学习（线性回归、逻辑回归、SVM、决策树等）与无监督学习（K均值、层次聚类）的逐步教程与代码实现，配有信息图，适合初学者系统入门机器学习。
summary.en: This repository is the Chinese version of the '100 Days of ML Code' challenge, offering step-by-step tutorials and code implementations covering data preprocessing, supervised learning (linear regression, logistic regression, SVM, decision trees, etc.) and unsupervised learning (K-means, hierarchical clustering), with infographics, ideal for beginners to systematically learn machine learning.

metadata.name: proxyee-down
metadata.description: http下载工具，基于http代理，支持多连接分块下载

summary.zh: Proxyee Down是一款开源的免费HTTP高速下载器，基于Netty开发，通过HTTP代理实现多连接分块下载，支持自定义请求和扩展功能，适用于大文件高速下载场景。项目已停止维护，作者计划用Go和Flutter重写为跨平台下载器Gopeed。
summary.en: Proxyee Down is an open-source free HTTP downloader built with Netty, utilizing HTTP proxy for multi-connection segmented downloads. It supports custom requests and extensions, ideal for high-speed large file downloading. The project is deprecated, with a Go/Flutter rewrite planned as Gopeed.

metadata.name: SpringAll
metadata.description: 循序渐进，学习Spring Boot、Spring Boot & Shiro、Spring Batch、Spring Cloud、Spring Cloud Alibaba、Spring Security & Spring Security OAuth2，博客Spring系列源码：https://mrbird.cc

summary.zh: 该仓库是个人博客的Spring系列教程源码，涵盖Spring Boot基础配置、MyBatis、Redis、WebFlux、Kafka等，以及Shiro、Spring Security、Spring Cloud Alibaba等安全与微服务组件。每个模块均有对应博客详解，适合Java开发者循序渐进学习Spring生态。
summary.en: This repository hosts source code for a personal blog's Spring tutorials, covering Spring Boot basics, MyBatis, Redis, WebFlux, Kafka, as well as Shiro, Spring Security, and Spring Cloud Alibaba. Each module includes detailed blog posts, making it ideal for Java developers to learn the Spring ecosystem step by step.

metadata.name: DesignPatterns
metadata.description: 经典设计模式讲解以及项目实战（Java版）

summary.zh: 该仓库是Java设计模式集中营，涵盖单例、工厂、策略等12种经典设计模式的概念讲解，并提供项目实战案例，展示门面、模板方法、责任链、策略等的综合运用，还涉及Spring AOP动态代理等实战，适合Java开发者系统学习设计模式及其应用场景。
summary.en: A Java-focused design patterns repository covering 12 classic patterns with explanations and hands-on projects. It demonstrates integrated use of Facade, Template Method, Chain of Responsibility, Strategy, and Factory patterns, plus Spring AOP dynamic proxies, ideal for developers to master design patterns in real-world scenarios.

metadata.name: spring-cloud-alibaba
metadata.description: Spring Cloud Alibaba provides a one-stop solution for application development for the distributed solutions of Alibaba middleware.

summary.zh: Spring Cloud Alibaba 是阿里开源的一站式分布式应用开发解决方案，整合了服务注册与发现、分布式配置、流量控制、分布式事务等核心中间件，并支持事件驱动和云原生扩展。开发者通过少量注解和配置即可快速构建高可用微服务系统，广泛应用于企业级微服务架构与云原生转型场景。
summary.en: Spring Cloud Alibaba is Alibaba's one-stop solution for distributed application development, integrating core components such as service discovery, distributed configuration, flow control, and distributed transactions. It enables developers to build highly available microservices systems with minimal annotations and configuration, widely adopted for enterprise microservices and cloud-native transformation.

metadata.name: Guns
metadata.description: Guns是一个现代化的Java应用开发框架，基于主流技术Spring Boot3 + Vue3 + JDK17，Guns的核心理念是提高开发人员开发效率，降低企业信息化系统的开发成本。

summary.zh: Guns是一个基于Spring Boot3、Vue3和JDK17的现代化Java应用开发框架。它采用插件化架构，集成了权限管理、多机构、安全策略、文件管理等开箱即用功能，旨在提高开发效率，降低企业信息化系统的开发成本，适合快速构建中后台管理系统。
summary.en: Guns is a modern Java application development framework based on Spring Boot3, Vue3, and JDK17. It adopts a plugin-oriented architecture with built-in RBAC, multi-organization, security policies, and file management, aiming to boost developer productivity and reduce costs for enterprise information systems, ideal for rapid admin dashboard development.

metadata.name: CS-Notes-PDF
metadata.description: https://github.com/CyC2018/CS-Notes PDF版本离线阅读

summary.zh: 该仓库将知名 CS-Notes 技术面试笔记（涵盖算法、操作系统、网络、Java 等）转为 PDF 版本，供开发者离线阅读，无需网络即可随时查阅。另附编程书籍、面试资料与工具推荐。虽已停止更新，但 PDF 内容仍具参考价值，适合技术面试备考与日常学习。
summary.en: This repository provides PDF versions of the well-known CS-Notes technical interview notes, which cover a wide range of topics such as algorithms, operating systems, computer networking, Java, and more. The PDFs enable developers to read offline without an internet connection, making it convenient to review anytime. Additionally, the repository offers recommendations for programming books, interview preparation resources, and useful tools. Although the project is no longer actively maintained, the PDF content still holds significant reference value for those preparing for technical interviews and for continuous learning.

metadata.name: kbase-doc
metadata.description: 文档在线预览编辑，文档水印 / Office files preview or edit online, doc/docx convert to html, watermark

summary.zh: 本系统是一个文档在线预览编辑平台，采用LibreOffice将Office文档转换为HTML，通过CKEditor提供在线编辑功能，支持保存为版本及放弃保存；同时内置水印处理，可为图片及Word/Excel/PPT/PDF添加文本或图片水印，并支持PDF转HTML。适用于企业知识库、OA系统等文档协作场景。
summary.en: This system is an online document preview and editing platform built with LibreOffice and CKEditor. It converts Office documents such as DOC/DOCX, XLS, PPT into HTML for in-browser editing, and supports versioning with save as new version or discard changes. A built-in watermark processor handles both text and image watermarks across images, Word, Excel, PPT, and PDF, enabling copyright protection. Additionally, PDF files can be converted to HTML for online editing. This solution is ideal for enterprise knowledge bases, OA systems, and any scenario requiring secure online document collaboration.

metadata.name: jcode
metadata.description: The most RAM efficient harness

summary.zh: jcode 是一款极致优化内存占用的 AI 编程 harness，支持 Linux/macOS/Windows。它以极低 RAM（27.8MB/会话）运行多会话工作流，相比 Claude Code、Copilot CLI 等主流工具内存占用降低 5-13 倍，特别适合资源受限环境和大规模并行编程。提供 SDK 和完整文档，可轻松集成。
summary.en: jcode is a highly memory-efficient AI coding harness that runs multi-session workflows with minimal RAM. It consumes as little as 27.8 MB per session, outperforming mainstream tools like Claude Code and Copilot CLI by 5-13x. Cross-platform with SDK and docs, it's ideal for resource-constrained environments and large-scale parallel coding tasks.

metadata.name: MoePeek
metadata.description: A lightweight macOS selection translator built with pure Swift 6, featuring on-device Apple Translate for privacy, only 5MB install size and stable ~50MB memory usage. 一款轻量级 macOS 划词翻译工具，纯 Swift 6 开发，设备端 Apple 翻译保护隐私，安装体积仅 5MB，后台运行内存稳定约 50MB

summary.zh: MoePeek是一款轻量级的macOS菜单栏划词翻译工具，基于纯Swift 6开发，安装包仅5MB，常驻内存约50MB。提供划词、OCR截图、剪贴板和手动输入四种翻译模式，无缝集成Apple设备端翻译，注重隐私保护。支持14种语言智能识别、语音朗读、非激活悬浮窗以及自定义快捷键，并通过Sparkle自动更新。开源且原生高效，适合追求轻量与隐私的用户。
summary.en: MoePeek is a lightweight macOS menu bar translator developed with pure Swift 6, delivering a compact 5MB install size and consistent ~50MB memory usage. It offers four translation modes: selecting text in any app, OCR screenshot recognition, clipboard translation, and manual input. Leveraging Apple's on-device Translation framework (macOS 15+), it ensures privacy while supporting 14 languages with smart detection and auto-direction flipping. Additional features include text-to-speech, non-activating floating panels, Accessibility/AppleScript/clipboard fallback text grabbing, customizable shortcuts, and Sparkle auto-updates. This open-source tool (AGPL-3.0) is ideal for users who value lightweight, native performance and data privacy.

metadata.name: DeepTutor
metadata.description: DeepTutor: Lifelong Personalized Tutoring. https://deeptutor.info/.

summary.zh: DeepTutor是香港大学数据科学实验室推出的终身个性化辅导系统，基于AI大模型技术，为学习者提供自适应、持续性的智能教学支持。项目提供完整文档与多语言社区支持，适用于在线教育、自主学习等场景，亮点在于结合大模型实现个性化学习路径规划与实时互动辅导。
summary.en: DeepTutor is a lifelong personalized tutoring system developed by HKUDS, leveraging large language models to deliver adaptive and continuous intelligent instruction. It features comprehensive docs and multilingual community support, ideal for online education and self-learning, with highlights in personalized learning path planning and real-time interactive tutoring.

metadata.name: diagram-design
metadata.description: 38 editorial diagram types for Claude Code, Codex, and Pi. Self-contained HTML + SVG. No shadows. No Mermaid slop.

summary.zh: 为Claude Code设计的图表生成技能，提供27种编辑级视觉类型，输出自包含的HTML+SVG，无阴影、无Mermaid式的粗糙图形。语义模式将行为与布局分离，可选动效用于有序讲解，并能重绘draw.io或Mermaid源，通过读取网站快速匹配品牌。适合开发者与写作者无需设计工具快速创建高质量技术图表。
summary.en: A Claude Code skill for generating editorial-grade diagrams, offering 27 visual types that produce self-contained HTML+SVG without shadows or generic Mermaid-style graphics. Semantic patterns separate behavior from layout, allowing queues, policy traces, or trust boundaries to reuse existing types. Optional motion is available for ordered explanations, while static output remains the default. The skill also redraws draw.io or Mermaid sources at a chosen format, size, and detail level. It matches your brand in seconds by reading your website, making it ideal for developers and writers needing polished technical diagrams without fighting design tools.

metadata.name: deepseek-harness
metadata.description: DeepSeek Harness: Everything is a Plugin.

summary.zh: DeepSeek Harness（dsh）是DeepSeek AI开发的开源智能体工具框架，采用“一切皆插件”的架构，基于Cordis实现时空可组合性。提供Web UI界面，支持通过npm快速部署，处于开发者预览阶段。主要用于构建和编排AI智能体，强调高扩展性与模块化。
summary.en: DeepSeek Harness (dsh) is an open-source agent harness by DeepSeek AI, featuring an everything-is-a-plugin architecture powered by Cordis for spatiotemporal composability. It offers a Web UI for rapid deployment via npm and is in developer preview. It focuses on building and orchestrating AI agents with high extensibility.

metadata.name: grok2api-egress-enhancements
metadata.description: Grok2API & CPA egress quality guard with proxy recovery, quarantine, migration, and operations UI

summary.zh: 本仓库为Grok2API及CPA提供出口质量守护增强补丁与纯CPA原生插件。核心功能包括固定代理故障快速恢复、基于TPS/标记探针的质量隔离与自动轮换、降智账号监控面板及可热加载策略的探针方案。适用于多账号多出口AI代理部署，通过启发式熔断减少出口故障影响，并提供完整运维UI。
summary.en: This repository provides egress quality guard enhancements for Grok2API and CPA, including fast proxy recovery, TPS/marker-based probe isolation and rotation, degraded account monitoring, and a native CPA plugin. It suits multi-account egress deployments with heuristic circuit breaking and an ops UI.

metadata.name: pi-from-scratch
metadata.description: 600 行 TypeScript 写成的超级迷你版 pi，让你轻松从 0 写出属于你的 pi-agent

summary.zh: 这是一个用600行TypeScript从零实现的迷你Coding Agent，参照pi的数据流拆解，支持读文件、改代码、执行命令。配套交互式网站和Trace逐行调试，帮助开发者彻底理解AI编程助手的核心原理。适合学习AI Agent实现细节，是一篇可运行的活教材。
summary.en: A super-mini coding agent in 600 lines of TypeScript, built from scratch by dissecting pi's data flow. It reads files, edits code, and runs commands. An interactive site with step-by-step Trace lets you follow execution and complete the code as you read. Perfect for deeply understanding AI agent internals through a hands-on tutorial.

metadata.name: manuals
metadata.description: Do design No code 💻📱🛒📚

summary.zh: 本仓库是《电商设计手册》，系统梳理电商全流程，涵盖用户、交易、营销、商品、支付、仓储物流等核心业务，提供架构设计与技术选型参考，采用“只设计不码码”理念，助力开发者高效理解电商系统整体架构与设计要点。
summary.en: This repository is the 'E-commerce Design Handbook', systematically outlining the complete e-commerce flow, covering core domains such as user, transaction, marketing, product, payment, warehouse, and logistics. It provides architecture design and tech stack selection references, adopting the 'Design only, no code' philosophy to help developers efficiently understand the overall architecture and design essentials of e-commerce systems.

metadata.name: airllm
metadata.description: AirLLM 70B inference with single 4GB GPU

summary.zh: AirLLM 通过分层推理与稀疏专家流式加载，大幅降低显存占用，使 70B 模型可在单张 4GB GPU 上运行，无需量化或剪枝，并支持 Llama、DeepSeek 等最新模型，为资源受限环境提供大模型推理方案。
summary.en: AirLLM dramatically cuts inference memory by layer-wise loading and sparse expert streaming, enabling 70B models on a single 4GB GPU without quantization, and supports Llama, DeepSeek, and more for low-resource LLM deployment.

metadata.name: time-to-first-token
metadata.description: A 10-week, 30-minutes-a-day roadmap for LLM inference serving and optimization. vLLM, SGLang, quantization, speculative decoding, benchmarking.

summary.zh: 面向工程师的LLM推理服务实战路线图，10周每天30分钟，通过构建一个可部署的OpenAI兼容推理服务，系统学习vLLM、SGLang、量化、投机解码与基准测试，最终产出可复现的性能报告。
summary.en: A 10-week, 30-minutes-a-day roadmap for engineers to master LLM inference serving by building and optimizing a deployable OpenAI-compatible service, covering vLLM, SGLang, quantization, speculative decoding, and benchmarking.

metadata.name: TypeWords
metadata.description: Practice English, one strike, one step forward; 练习英语，一次敲击，一点进步；

summary.zh: TypeWords是一款开源英语单词与文章练习工具，通过打字记忆单词，结合记忆曲线智能安排学习，支持跟读、听写、自测等模式，内置四六级、雅思托福等词库，界面简洁无广告。
summary.en: TypeWords is an open-source English word and article practice tool that combines typing with smart memory curves. It offers multiple practice modes, built-in vocabulary libraries (CET, IELTS, TOEFL), and a clean, ad-free interface.

metadata.name: Financial_freedom
metadata.description: Technical guide to making money and investing（最全赚钱投资指南）

summary.zh: 该项目是面向个人的投资理财指南，系统收录了从入门到进阶的16本经典书籍，涵盖财商启蒙、价值投资、资产配置等核心主题。通过整理优质书目和投资理念，帮助用户建立长期复利思维，实现财富认知升级，适合希望系统学习理财知识的读者。
summary.en: This project is a personal finance and investing guide that curates 16 classic books from beginner to advanced levels, covering financial literacy, value investing, and asset allocation. By organizing high-quality resources and investment principles, it helps users build long-term compounding mindsets and achieve wealth cognition upgrade, suitable for readers seeking systematic financial education.

metadata.name: deepseek-harness-desktop
metadata.description: 为 DeepSeek Harness (DSH) 插件生态打造的现代化桌面端解决方案。万物皆「插件」，桌面本身也是「插件」。

summary.zh: DSH Desktop 是面向 Windows 和 macOS 的开源桌面客户端，将 DeepSeek Harness 的本地 Web UI、Host 服务与插件系统封装为原生应用。内置 Electron 和固定版本依赖，免安装 Node.js 环境，开箱即用，并支持系统托盘和窗口管理。
summary.en: DSH Desktop is an open-source desktop client for Windows and macOS that packages DeepSeek Harness's local web UI, host services, and plugin system into a native app. Built with Electron and pinned dependencies, it requires no Node.js setup and offers system tray and window management.

metadata.name: pi-web
metadata.description: Web UI for the pi coding agent

summary.zh: 专为 pi 编码代理打造的本地 Web 界面，基于 Node.js，可浏览和恢复会话、分支对话、预览项目文件、管理 Git worktree 和模型配置，支持中英文，让开发者在浏览器中高效操控编程代理。
summary.en: A local browser UI for the pi coding agent, built with Node.js. It lets you browse and resume sessions, branch conversations, preview project files, manage Git worktrees, and configure models—all in your browser with English and Chinese support.

metadata.name: obscura
metadata.description: The headless browser for AI agents and web scraping

summary.zh: Obscura 是一款专为 AI 智能体和网页爬虫设计的无头浏览器，支持无界面运行，提供高效、稳定的网页自动化能力，适用于数据采集、自动化测试及 AI 驱动的 Web 交互场景。
summary.en: Obscura is a headless browser built for AI agents and web scraping, delivering efficient, stable browser automation without a GUI, ideal for data extraction, automated testing, and AI-driven web interactions.

metadata.name: typescript-tutorial
metadata.description: TypeScript 教程

summary.zh: TypeScript 开源教程，面向初学者，系统介绍基本概念与用法，涵盖核心语法与实用示例，帮助开发者快速上手并理解类型系统。
summary.en: An open-source TypeScript tutorial for beginners, covering core concepts and usage with practical examples to help developers quickly master the type system.

metadata.name: claude-code-tips
metadata.description: 45+ tips for getting the most out of Claude Code, from basics to advanced - includes a custom status line script and Claude Code running itself in a container. Also includes the dx plugin: skills for everyday dev workflows.

summary.zh: 汇集40+条Claude Code实用技巧，从基础命令到高级玩法，涵盖自定义状态行脚本、容器化运行、dx插件等，帮助开发者掌握AI编程助手，优化日常开发工作流，提升效率与自动化水平。
summary.en: A collection of 40+ tips for mastering Claude Code, from basics to advanced, including custom status line scripts, containerized usage, and the dx plugin to enhance everyday dev workflows, boost productivity, and automate routines.

metadata.name: Vibe-Research
metadata.description: Vibe-Research: Your Personal Trading Research Agent · A股/美股/港股 的个人投研 Agent：每日复盘、资讯雷达、个股数据、板块中心、我的持仓、研究记录、回测。Vibe-Research 把数据和功能配齐，由你自己的 Agent 驱动投资研究。基于开源的 Codex Harness 打造。

summary.zh: Vibe-Research 是一个开源的个人 AI 投研系统，支持 A 股、美股、港股。它整合每日复盘、资讯雷达、个股数据、多空辩论等功能，将行情、财报、估值、资金面等数据汇聚于统一看板，并允许用户接入自己的 AI 模型进行深度分析。该项目旨在提供数据与工具，由用户的 AI 自主做出投资决策，不提供买卖建议。
summary.en: Vibe-Research is an open-source personal AI investment research system for A-shares, US stocks, and Hong Kong stocks. It aggregates daily market reviews, news radar, stock data, and bull-bear debates into a unified dashboard, allowing users to plug in their own AI models for analysis. The project provides data and tools, leaving investment decisions entirely to the user's AI.

metadata.name: tidings-rss
metadata.description: Curated, live-verified OPML collections for AI, news, research, blogs, videos, podcasts, and engineering.

summary.zh: Tidings RSS 是一个精选的高质量 RSS 订阅源集合，以 OPML 文件形式提供。它包含 Top 200 推荐、完整 718 源目录及按主题（如 AI、安全、技术媒体、独立博客）分类的捆绑包，并经过定期验证。适用于快速导入阅读器，高效获取中文与英文优质内容。
summary.en: Tidings RSS is a curated collection of high-quality RSS feeds delivered as importable OPML files. It offers a Top 200 list, a full 718-source directory, and topic-specific bundles for AI, security, tech media, independent blogs, and more, with regular validation. Ideal for quickly populating feed readers with premium Chinese and English content.

summary.zh: 该仓库提供《Agentic Design Patterns》全书PDF及配套代码笔记本，系统讲解构建AI智能体的21章设计模式，涵盖提示链、路由、并行化、多智能体、记忆管理、RAG、安全防护等，从基础到生产落地，适合开发者实战学习，作者版税捐赠慈善机构。
summary.en: This repository offers the complete book PDF and Jupyter notebooks for 'Agentic Design Patterns', covering 21 chapters of AI agent design patterns such as prompt chaining, routing, multi-agent systems, memory management, RAG, and safety guardrails. It is a hands-on guide for building production-grade agents, with royalties donated to charity.

metadata.name: ponytail
metadata.description: Makes your AI agent think like the laziest senior dev in the room. The best code is the code you never wrote.

summary.zh: Ponytail 是一个针对 AI 编码代理的提示工程技能，使其像资深懒开发者一样输出极简代码，避免过度构建。实测减少54%代码、20%成本、27%时间，且保持安全。
summary.en: Ponytail is a skill for AI coding agents that instills the mindset of a lazy senior developer, ensuring agents write the least amount of code necessary and reuse existing solutions instead of over-engineering. Built as a prompt engineering technique, it works with Claude Code and 20+ other agents, preserving all safety guards. In realistic benchmarks on a FastAPI+React repo, it cut lines of code by 54% (up to 94% in over-building cases), token usage by 22%, cost by 20%, and time by 27% compared to a no-skill baseline.

metadata.name: deepwiki-open
metadata.description: Open Source DeepWiki: AI-Powered Wiki Generator for GitHub/Gitlab/Bitbucket Repositories. Join the discord: https://discord.gg/gMwThUMeme

summary.zh: DeepWiki-open是一个开源项目，旨在自动为任意GitHub、GitLab或Bitbucket仓库生成交互式维基。它分析代码结构，生成全面的文档、可视化图表和代码地图，帮助开发者快速理解代码库。
summary.en: DeepWiki-open is an open-source tool that automatically creates interactive wikis for any GitHub, GitLab, or Bitbucket repository. It analyzes code structure, generates comprehensive documentation, visual diagrams, and a code map for guided tours.

metadata.name: qiaomu-learning
metadata.description: 用苏格拉底式逐问学习把教材、截图、PDF、笔记、题目或一个主题变成主动推导对话。Use when the learner明确要求“苏格拉底式学习”“逐问带我学”“一次只问一个问题”“先别告诉我答案”“边问边引导我推出来”、interactive quiz、active recall or question-led tutoring。每个活跃回合只问一个简短、可回答的问题，并根据学习者上一步的推理调整难度；遇到陌生抽象概念时可使用具名人物的小故事，空间、因果、流程、几何或图形关系确有帮助时可调用 Codex 内置生图并提供文字替代。不用于只要直接解释、摘要、翻译、代做/解题、批量出题、评分、写苏

summary.zh: 苏格拉底式互动学习技能，将教材、PDF、截图、笔记或任意主题转化为一次一问的推导对话。通过12词知识地图建立骨架，渐进黑板与视觉搭架辅助理解，支持生成自包含网页，注重反馈自进化与来源忠实度。
summary.en: A Socratic interactive learning skill that turns textbooks, PDFs, screenshots, notes, or any topic into one-question-at-a-time guided dialogues. Features a 12-term knowledge map, progressive blackboard visualization, self-contained webpage generation, feedback-driven self-evolution, and source fidelity.

metadata.name: SkillDeck
metadata.description: Native macOS SwiftUI app for managing multiple AI code agent skills

summary.zh: SkillDeck 是一款原生 macOS SwiftUI 桌面应用，用于集中管理多种 AI 编码代理（如 Claude Code、Codex、Gemini CLI 等）的技能。它提供图形化仪表盘、技能浏览与安装、自动符号链接和锁文件更新、SKILL.md 编辑器、代理分配翻译等功能，大幅简化原本依赖命令行手工操作的工作流。
summary.en: SkillDeck is a native macOS SwiftUI desktop app for centrally managing skills across multiple AI coding agents like Claude Code, Codex, Gemini CLI, and more. It features a unified dashboard, skill registry browsing, one-click installation and updates, a split-pane SKILL.md editor, agent assignment via symlink management, and localization, eliminating tedious manual file edits and symlink juggling.

metadata.name: cli-delegate
metadata.description: Host-neutral skill: spawn grok, cursor, claude, or codex from any coding CLI. Resume the same child session. Spend a second subscription instead of another subagent on the same bill.

summary.zh: 跨宿主AI编程CLI委派工具，支持从Claude Code、Codex、Grok或Cursor任一环境启动其他模型CLI并恢复会话。以低成本利用现有订阅替代同厂商子代理，实现跨平台任务编排与统一参数映射。
summary.en: Host-neutral agent skill enabling Claude Code, Codex, Grok, or Cursor to spawn each other as child CLIs and resume sessions. It reduces costs by leveraging existing subscriptions instead of same-vendor subagents, offering cross-platform orchestration and unified effort mapping via a single Node.js script.

metadata.name: orca
metadata.description: Orca is the ADE for working with a fleet of parallel agents. Run any coding agent with your own subscription. Available on desktop, mobile and VPS.

summary.zh: Orca是一款面向并行AI代理的编排工具，支持在独立Git工作树中同时运行Codex、ClaudeCode等多个编码代理，并提供桌面、移动端和VPS部署。具备终端分屏、设计模式等特性，帮助开发者高效对比与合并多个代理的成果，显著提升编码自动化效率。
summary.en: Orca is an AI orchestrator for running multiple coding agents in parallel, each in isolated Git worktrees. It supports desktop, mobile, and VPS, featuring terminal splits and design mode to capture UI elements. Ideal for developers who want to compare and merge agent outputs efficiently.

summary.zh: 该项目为AI模型智商基准测试工具，通过18个参数化单元与求解器判分，量化评估认知反射、抗背题、空间作图等硬指标。用户可本地一键并行测评，并附带渠道鉴定，识别训练截止、联网嫌疑、Codex反代及降智渠道。基于TanStack Start构建，支持HTML报告导出。
summary.en: Mengdeng-145 is an AI model IQ benchmark tool designed to measure cognitive hard metrics, including cognitive reflection, worst-case guarantee, anti-memorization, spatial drawing, and instruction following. It uses 18 dynamically parameterized units with solver-generated answers, avoiding static test leakage. Users can run parallel evaluations locally by simply providing their API base URL and key, with all scoring and timing performed in the browser. The tool also includes a channel identification module that probes model knowledge cutoff, potential internet access, Codex reverse-proxy signatures, and IQ degradation. Built on TanStack Start, it provides detailed HTML reports and a public leaderboard, making it suitable for model comparison and channel quality auditing.

metadata.name: tailscale
metadata.description: The easiest, most secure way to use WireGuard and 2FA.

summary.zh: Tailscale是一款基于WireGuard协议的私有组网工具，极大简化了安全网络配置，并支持双因素认证。它能跨平台运行，让设备如同在同一局域网内互联，适用于远程办公、服务器管理及多设备协同等场景。其开源代码提供了透明、可靠的基础网络能力。
summary.en: Tailscale is a private networking tool built on WireGuard, simplifying secure network setup and incorporating two-factor authentication. It runs across major platforms, enabling devices to connect as if on a local network, which supports remote work, server administration, and multi-device collaboration. Its open-source code provides transparent and reliable core networking.

metadata.name: beszel
metadata.description: Lightweight server monitoring with historical data, docker stats, and alerts.

summary.zh: Beszel是一个轻量级服务器监控平台，提供友好的Web界面、Docker容器统计、历史数据与告警功能。支持多用户、OAuth认证、自动备份及API访问，资源占用小，配置简单，可监控CPU、内存、磁盘、网络、温度、GPU等指标，适合个人与团队快速部署。
summary.en: Beszel is a lightweight server monitoring platform that provides Docker statistics, historical data, and alerting. It features a user-friendly web interface, simple configuration, multi-user support, OAuth authentication, automatic backups, and API access. It tracks CPU, memory, disk, network, temperature, GPU, and more, making it easy to monitor multiple systems.

metadata.name: LearnGraph
metadata.description: LearnGraph 是一个 AI 驱动的智能学习平台。你只需说出一个真实的学习目标，AI 便会帮你生成可生长的知识路线图，并作为学习伙伴全程陪伴，引导你高效进入并掌握陌生领域。

summary.zh: LearnGraph 是一个 AI 驱动的智能学习平台，通过自然语言输入学习目标，生成可生长的知识路线图。AI Agent 全程陪伴，利用知识图谱、事件溯源记忆和 Docker 沙箱，提供交互式学习体验，支持多模型，可本地部署。
summary.en: LearnGraph is an AI-powered learning platform that turns real learning objectives into evolving knowledge roadmaps. AI agents accompany users through the learning journey, leveraging knowledge graphs, event-sourced memory, and Docker sandboxing. It offers interactive learning workflows, multi-model support, and self-hosting capabilities.

metadata.name: dsh-desktop
metadata.description: 为 DeepSeek Harness (DSH) 插件生态打造的现代化桌面端解决方案。万物皆「插件」，桌面本身也是「插件」。

summary.zh: 基于DeepSeek Harness的开源桌面客户端，支持Windows/macOS。集成本地Web UI与插件系统，主张“万物皆插件”，桌面本身也是插件。提供一键安装、开箱即用的体验，并推动开放可组合的插件生态，适合AI工具链定制与开发。
summary.en: An open-source desktop client for DeepSeek Harness, supporting Windows and macOS. It integrates local web UI and a plugin system, embracing the philosophy that everything is a plugin, including the desktop itself. One-click installation and out-of-the-box experience, fostering an open and composable plugin ecosystem for AI tooling.

metadata.name: ai-toolbox
metadata.description: Personal AI Toolbox

summary.zh: AI Toolbox 是一款跨平台桌面应用，用于集中管理多种 AI 编程助手（如 Claude Code、Codex、Gemini CLI 等）的配置。支持 MCP、Skills、供应商、会话管理，提供本机代理网关、WSL/SSH 同步、系统托盘快速切换和数据备份，帮助开发者高效统一 AI 工具链。
summary.en: AI Toolbox is a cross-platform desktop app for centrally managing configurations of various AI coding assistants like Claude Code, Codex, Gemini CLI, etc. It supports MCP, Skills, providers, sessions, local proxy gateway, WSL/SSH sync, system tray quick switching, and data backup, helping developers streamline AI toolchains efficiently.

metadata.name: TradingAgents
metadata.description: TradingAgents: Multi-Agents LLM Financial Trading Framework

summary.zh: TradingAgents是一个基于多智能体LLM的金融交易框架，通过模拟真实交易团队的多角色协作，实现从研究分析、情绪判断到投资决策的全流程自动化。它支持GPT、Claude、Gemini等多种主流大模型，提供结构化的输出、回测验证和决策日志，为量化交易提供高可扩展的AI驱动解决方案。
summary.en: TradingAgents is a multi-agent LLM framework for financial trading that simulates a real trading team's collaboration, automating research, sentiment analysis, and investment decisions. It supports multiple major LLMs (GPT, Claude, Gemini), offers structured outputs, backtesting, and decision logging, delivering a scalable AI-driven solution for quantitative trading.

metadata.name: pi-book
metadata.description: Source-backed architecture notes on building an agent

summary.zh: 本书从源码出发，深入解析 @earendil-works/pi-agent-core 库的架构设计，阐明 agent 循环的承诺、边界与关键支点。采用文件:行号引用并附引文，读者无需打开编辑器即可验证论断。适合有 TypeScript 与 LLM 基础、想理解 agent 系统实现原理的开发者。
summary.en: This book analyzes the architecture of @earendil-works/pi-agent-core from source code, clarifying the promises, boundaries, and pivots of an agent loop. Every claim is cited with file:line references and inline quotes, so readers can verify without opening an editor. Suitable for developers with TypeScript and LLM basics who want to understand agent implementation.

metadata.name: fund-guy-skill
metadata.description: 糟糕，我被基佬包围了！那么这个时候就有人要问了，主播主播，有没有什么简单好用的基佬筛选办法？有的兄弟，有的，快来看看jilaoskill吧！

summary.zh: 输入基金代码，审计基金经理8年每笔交易，以12个月后实际走势验证买卖决策，生成交互式报告，含买卖点胜率、独立性分析等模块。评分基于行为而非净值，数据免费零Key，支持多种AI Agent调用。
summary.en: Feed a fund code, audits every trade a fund manager made over 8 years, validates buy/sell decisions against 12-month forward returns, and produces an interactive HTML report with modules like trade win rates and independence analysis. Scoring is behavior-based, not NAV-based; all data free with zero API keys; integrates with AI agents like OpenClaw and Claude Code.

metadata.name: awesome-gpt-image-2
metadata.description: Prompt as Code | GPT-Image2 工业级提示词引擎与模板库，530+ 个案例逆向工程，20+ 套工业级模板，并提炼出Skills，持续更新中

summary.zh: GPT-Image2工业级提示词引擎与模板库，基于530+案例逆向工程，提炼20+套模板与Skills，践行'Prompt as Code'理念，提供高质量图像提示词复用方案，配套在线画廊与社区交流，覆盖多风格多场景，持续更新，助力AI绘画高效创作。
summary.en: GPT-Image2 is an industrial prompt engine and template library that reverse-engineers over 530 real-world cases to distill 20+ production-grade templates and reusable Skills. It promotes the 'Prompt as Code' philosophy, enabling developers and creators to generate high-quality images with consistent, maintainable prompts. The project includes an online gallery for browsing and filtering cases, copyable prompts, and community support. It is continuously updated and serves as a comprehensive resource for AI image generation, from rapid prototyping to scalable pipelines.

metadata.name: awesome-llm-apps
metadata.description: 100+ AI Agents, Agent Skills and RAG Apps - Free and Open Source.

summary.zh: 该仓库收录了100多个免费开源的AI智能体、智能体技能与RAG应用，覆盖旅行规划、欺诈调查、语音理赔等真实场景。所有项目均经过端到端测试，支持Claude、GPT、Llama等主流模型，并提供Streamlit快速部署与逐步教程，帮助开发者快速克隆、定制并上线自己的AI应用。
summary.en: This repository features 100+ open-source AI agents, agent skills, and RAG applications, covering diverse scenarios such as travel planning, fraud investigation, and real-time voice-enabled insurance claims. All projects are hand-built, end-to-end tested, and Apache-2.0 licensed, supporting major LLMs including Claude, GPT, DeepSeek, Llama, and Qwen. With Streamlit-based quick-start templates, reusable agent skills via npx, and step-by-step tutorials, this collection empowers developers to clone, customize, and ship production-ready AI apps in minutes.

metadata.name: headroom
metadata.description: Compress tool outputs, logs, files, and RAG chunks before they reach the LLM. 20% fewer tokens for coding agents, 60-95% fewer tokens for JSON, same answers. Library, proxy, MCP server.

summary.zh: Headroom是一个面向AI代理的上下文压缩层，在工具输出、日志、RAG块等到达LLM前进行内容感知压缩，可减少60-95%的JSON token和15-20%的编码代理token，同时保持答案质量。提供Python/TypeScript库、代理和MCP服务器，支持可逆压缩与跨代理记忆，本地优先，部署灵活。
summary.en: Headroom is a context compression layer for AI agents, reducing tokens in tool outputs, logs, RAG chunks, and files before reaching the LLM—cutting 60-95% for JSON and 15-20% for coding agents while preserving answer quality. It offers Python/TypeScript libraries, a proxy, and an MCP server with reversible, local-first compression.

metadata.name: AI-reads-books-page-by-page
metadata.description: AI reads books: Page-by-Page PDF Knowledge Extractor & Summarizer. script performs an intelligent page-by-page analysis of PDF books, methodically extracting knowledge points and generating progressive summaries at specified intervals

summary.zh: 本项目通过AI逐页分析PDF书籍，自动提取知识点并生成阶段性摘要。支持知识库持久化、Markdown输出、自定义分析间隔、跳过目录等智能过滤，便于高效读书笔记与文献研究。
summary.en: This project leverages AI to analyze PDF books page by page, extracting knowledge points and generating progressive summaries at user-defined intervals. The script processes each page individually, allowing for detailed content understanding while maintaining contextual flow. It generates interval-based summaries, stores extracted knowledge in a structured JSON knowledge base, and outputs Markdown-formatted summaries. With configurable models and analysis intervals, it supports both test mode and full-book processing. Smart filtering skips table of contents, index, and other non-content pages. This tool is ideal for researchers, students, and professionals who need to systematically extract key insights from lengthy PDF books.

metadata.name: outlook-auto-register
metadata.description: Microsoft Outlook Fluent Web API 协议注册工具（纯协议，无浏览器依赖）

summary.zh: 基于纯协议的 Outlook 批量注册工具，集成 PerimeterX 打码、代理池、账号池与 Web 控制台，实现从注册到测活的全流程可视化，无需浏览器依赖，支持 Graph API 读信验证，适用于账号注册与运营管理场景。
summary.en: This tool enables pure-protocol batch registration of Microsoft Outlook accounts using the Fluent Web API, without browser dependencies. It integrates PerimeterX captcha solving, a SQLite-backed proxy pool with pre-check and sticky binding, an account pool with status management, and a web console that provides real-time SSE logging. It supports account validation, IMAP keep-alive, email verification via Graph API, dry-run mode, combo export, and SQLite storage for accounts and proxies. With stage-based timing breakdown and live progress tracking, it is designed for efficient large-scale account registration and lifecycle management.

metadata.name: Prism-Browser-Community
metadata.description: Local-first open-source multi-profile fingerprint browser based on Chromium and Electron

summary.zh: Prism Browser是一个本地优先的开源多配置文件指纹浏览器，基于Chromium和Electron。它让每个环境拥有独立的Cookie、缓存、代理和指纹设置，实现多账号隔离与隐私保护。支持跨平台，提供环境复制、分组和本地迁移，无需远程服务器即可免费使用。对于开发者，可自行编译定制Chromium内核。
summary.en: Prism Browser is a local-first, open-source multi-profile fingerprint browser built on custom Chromium and Electron. It creates multiple isolated browser environments, each with independent cookies, cache, extensions, proxy and fingerprint settings, enabling secure multi-account management and anti-detection. The community version is completely free with unlimited local environments, and all data stays on user's device. It supports macOS and Windows, including environment cloning, grouping, batch operations, and local migration. Developers can compile their own Chromium fingerprint kernel using the provided scripts, ensuring full control and customization.

metadata.name: trueforge
metadata.description: The open-source agent harness - the runtime layer that turns an LLM into a working agent.

summary.zh: TrueForge 是一个开源智能体运行时框架，为 LLM 提供完整的执行循环，包括模型调用、MCP 工具、技能、沙箱、审批和会话管理。它支持多种主流模型提供商，并通过聊天界面、HTTP API 和 TypeScript SDK 三种方式灵活接入，帮助企业快速构建可靠的 AI 智能体应用。
summary.en: TrueForge is an open-source runtime for AI agents that manages the full execution loop — model calls, MCP tools, skills, sandboxing, approvals, and context. Supporting all major LLM providers, it offers a chat UI, HTTP API, and TypeScript SDK for flexible integration, enabling teams to quickly build production-ready agents.

metadata.name: firemailplus
metadata.description: 一个全功能的WEB邮件客户端

summary.zh: FireMail Plus是一款基于Next.js 15、React 19和Go构建的现代化Web邮件客户端，支持Gmail、Outlook、QQ、163等主流邮箱及自定义IMAP/SMTP。采用OAuth2认证、SSE实时同步、全文搜索和附件管理，提供响应式界面与Docker一键部署，适合个人和企业高效管理多邮箱。
summary.en: FireMail Plus is a feature-rich, modern web email client developed with a cutting-edge stack including Next.js 15, React 19, and Go for high-performance backend. It seamlessly integrates with Gmail, Outlook, QQ Mail, 163 Mail, and any custom IMAP/SMTP services. The platform offers OAuth2 authentication, JWT-based sessions, SSE-powered real-time email synchronization, full-text search with advanced filters, and comprehensive attachment handling. Designed with a responsive UI and dark/light theme support, it ensures a smooth experience across devices. With Docker containerization and easy configuration, FireMail Plus is a robust solution for individuals and enterprises seeking efficient multi-account email management.

summary.zh: 多智能体协作平台，类飞书界面。在聊天室 @ 不同智能体，即可让多个智能体在统一上下文协作、交接任务、调用工具、维护记忆并执行定时任务。支持多端，后端集成 LangChain，默认 SQLite，可容器化部署。
summary.en: TeamAgentX is a multi-agent collaboration platform with a Feishu/Lark-like interface. Users can @mention AI assistants in chat rooms, allowing multiple agents to work in the same context, hand off tasks, call tools, maintain room memory, and execute scheduled cron jobs. It features an agent execution queue with interruption and recovery, and real-time messaging via Socket.io. The monorepo project includes Web, Electron desktop, and Flutter mobile clients. The Fastify backend integrates LangChain and ACP, supports local-first SQLite, and can be deployed via Docker.

metadata.name: WindInput
metadata.description: 清风输入法 | 轻量、快速、可定制的开源中文输入法，专为五笔和码表输入方案设计（Windows / macOS）

summary.zh: 清风输入法是一款轻量、快速、可定制的开源中文输入法，专为五笔和码表输入方案设计。基于Rust实现，支持Windows和macOS，提供图形化设置、亮暗主题、五笔拼音混输等功能，资源占用低，启动迅速，适合追求高效输入的用户。
summary.en: WindInput is a lightweight, fast, customizable open-source Chinese IME designed for Wubi and table-based input schemes. Built with Rust, it supports Windows and macOS, offering graphical settings, light/dark themes, mixed Wubi-Pinyin input, and low resource usage with rapid startup.

metadata.name: i-have-adhd
metadata.description: A skill to stop your coding agent from burying the answer. ADHD-friendly output.

summary.zh: i-have-adhd 是一个针对 AI 编程助手的技能（Skill），通过 10 条规则强制输出以行动优先、步骤编号、避免废话的简洁结果，专为 ADHD 友好体验设计，可显著提升开发者在阅读 AI 回复时的效率与专注度。
summary.en: i-have-adhd is a skill for AI coding assistants that enforces ADHD-friendly output through 10 rules: action-first phrasing, numbered steps, and no fluff. It helps developers get concise, actionable answers, improving focus and efficiency when interacting with AI tools.

metadata.name: go-modern-guidelines
metadata.description: Help AI coding agents write modern Go

summary.zh: 面向AI编程代理的Go语言现代编码指南，由JetBrains官方维护，覆盖Go 1.0至1.27的特性，自动匹配项目Go版本，推荐使用新语法与标准库（如slices.Contains、cmp.Or），显著减少过时代码生成，提升代码质量与维护性。
summary.en: Official JetBrains guidelines to help AI coding agents write modern Go. Covers Go 1.0–1.27 features, auto-detects project version, and suggests modern APIs like slices.Contains and cmp.Or instead of outdated patterns. Targets new code generation to reduce tech debt.

metadata.name: core
metadata.description: :house_with_garden: Open source home automation that puts local control and privacy first.

summary.zh: Home Assistant 是一个开源家庭自动化平台，将本地控制和隐私保护置于首位。它基于 Python 构建，采用模块化架构，可轻松集成各种智能设备与服务，支持自动化规则和场景。适合在树莓派或本地服务器上运行，为用户提供完全自主的智能家居管理体验。
summary.en: Home Assistant is an open-source home automation platform that puts local control and privacy first. It is powered by a worldwide community of tinkerers and DIY enthusiasts, and is designed to run on a Raspberry Pi or a local server for complete data ownership. The system is built using a modular approach in Python, enabling seamless integration with a vast ecosystem of devices and services. Users can automate their homes with intuitive rules, scenes, and schedules, all managed through a user-friendly web interface. With hundreds of integrations and a strong emphasis on local processing, Home Assistant ensures that your data stays within your control. Whether you are a beginner or an advanced user, it provides a reliable and customizable foundation for modern smart living.

metadata.name: zoetrope
metadata.description: Watch a Claude Code session as a live flow graph, in your terminal or your browser.

summary.zh: Zoetrope用Rust将Claude Code会话的JSONL转录实时绘制为流程图，展示主代理、子代理与工具调用，支持终端/浏览器回放和实时跟随，数据仅在本地处理。
summary.en: Zoetrope: live flow graph for Claude Code sessions. Reads JSONL, shows agents/tools, with replay.
